schemeName: Right To Information Fellowship
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Right To Information Fellowship

SHORT TITLE:
RTIF

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Internship, Student, RTI, Journalism, Communication

DESCRIPTION:
Under this scheme, DOPT proposes to offer four short-term fellowships to researchers from the field of media / Civil Society professionals / RTI Trainers to conduct field-based research on themes relating to RTI. It is hoped that the research output will enhance their understanding of the RTI Act.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Department of Personnel and Training (DOPT), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India, is the nodal Ministry for the Right to Information Act. The primary goal of the "Right to Information Fellowship" scheme is to contribute towards more accountable and transparent government and it has several components including programmes for awareness generation, training and e-governance initiatives for RTI for achieving the purpose. Under this scheme, DOPT proposes to offer 4(Four) short-term fellowships to researchers from the field of media / Civil Society professionals / RTI Trainers to conduct field-based research on themes relating to RTI. It is hoped that the research output will enhance the understanding of the status of the implementation of the act, including its successes, constraints in its implementation and how those are being / could be overcome and what more needs to be done to help achieve the objectives of the Act. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a professional in the field of journalism (newspaper/ magazine/ radio/ TV), Civil Society and research and training in the field of RTI. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be between 25 and 40 years of age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have proven credentials in his / her professional area.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have some prior experience of work relating to the Right to Information.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have an aptitude for research.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Stipend'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A stipend of ₹ 50,000/- per month for three months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(subject to tax deduction at source)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Additional Grant'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '₹ 50,000/- for books, research material, travel, printing, production of creatives etc., sanctioned on the basis of the research proposal and released on production of actual bills.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'text': 'Five sets of the application with enclosures in the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'prescribed proforma'}], 'link': 'https://rti.gov.in/rti_fellowship.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' may be sent by post to:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Under Secretary (IR), Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India, North Block, New Delhi - 110 001'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'Five sets of the application with enclosures in the [prescribed proforma](https://rti.gov.in/rti_fellowship.pdf) may be sent by post to:\n**Under Secretary (IR), Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India, North Block, New Delhi - 110 001**\n', 'url': ''}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

REFERENCES:
{'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://rti.gov.in/rti_fellowship.pdf'}

SLUG:
rtif

schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Virasat ka Samvardhan
text:
SCHEME NAME: Pradhan Mantri Virasat ka Samvardhan SHORT TITLE: PM VIKAS CATEGORY: Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning, Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Minority Affairs SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Skill Development, Women Entrepeneurship, Education Of School Dropouts, Socio-economic Empowerment, Minorities DESCRIPTION: PM VIKAS is a Central sector scheme that focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minorities in the country through skilling & training, women leadership & empowerment and education. The scheme integrates erstwhile skilling & education schemes of the Ministry of Minority Affairs. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs which converges five erstwhile schemes viz. ‘Seekho Aur Kamao’, ‘Nai Manzil’, ‘Nai Roshni’ and ‘USTTAD’ & ‘Hamari Dharohar’ schemes and focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis) through the following:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'i.\tSkilling and Training (Non-traditional and traditional)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'ii.\tWomen Leadership and Entrepreneurship'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'iii.\tEducation (through National Institute of Open Schooling)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'iv.\tInfrastructure Development (through Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scheme Objectives'}, {'text': ':'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The initiative aims to empower minority communities through targeted skill training, formal education via open schooling, and improved livelihood opportunities. It promotes the preservation cultural heritage and traditional arts and crafts. Women from minority communities are empowered through leadership and entrepreneurship support. Market and credit linkages are provided to enhance employability and enterprise.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Salient Features:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1)\tAims at holistic development of minority communities through skilling, education, entrepreneurship, and cultural heritage preservation. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tMerges five earlier schemes: Seekho aur Kamao, USTTAD, Hamari Dharohar, Nai Roshni, and Nai Manzil. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3)\tFocuses on traditional and modern skill training, women’s leadership, education for school dropouts, and infrastructure development. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4)\tSpecial emphasis on women, youth, and persons with disabilities from six notified minority communities. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5)\tProvides financial support, market linkages, and credit access through convergence with other government schemes. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6)\t100% central funding for training, education, and entrepreneurship; infrastructure support via Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) on a cost-sharing basis.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Target Beneficiaries:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1)\tIndian nationals belonging to the six notified minority communities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis with following:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a.\tMinority individuals aged 14–45 years for skilling and education; 18–45 years for women leadership and entrepreneurship. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b.\tWomen beneficiaries: Minimum 33% in skilling, 50% in education, and 100% in women leadership and entrepreneurship component. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'c.\tPersons with Disabilities (PwDs): 3% reservation across all components. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tUp to 25% non-minority (EWS) candidates may be included in Traditional Skilling and 15% in other components to promote inter-community solidarity.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Benefits:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1)\tProvides skill development in both traditional crafts and modern sectors to enhance employability of minority youth. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tEmpowers minority women through leadership and entrepreneurship training, including support to start enterprises. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3)\tOffers bridge education for school dropouts to complete classes 8th, 10th, and 12th via open schooling. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4)\tFacilitates access to credit, market linkages, and e-commerce platforms for artisans and entrepreneurs. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5)\tPromotes preservation and promotion of traditional arts, crafts, and cultural heritage. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6)\tEnsures inclusive development by converging with other government schemes and leveraging existing infrastructure.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'text': '1)\tThe Age of the applicant should be 14 to 45 years for skilling and education component and 18 to 45 years for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\t33% of total seats in Skilling and Training component, 50% of total seats in Education component and 100% of total seats in Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component are earmarked for women. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3)\tThe education qualification for Skilling and Training component would be as per NSQF norms and Education component would be as per NIOS norms. Candidates with aptitude and leadership qualities will be selected for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'text': '1)\tSkill training (both traditional and modern)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tEducation support (8th std, 10th std. and 12th std.)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3)\tLeadership and entrepreneurship support for women'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4)\tStipend support to trainees'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' '}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'Register/Login'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Visit the SIDH Portal (https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/), register as a Learner/Participant (Candidate) or log in if already registered, and complete e-KYC using your personal details.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:Profile Setup'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Create your account password/PIN, verify your mobile number via OTP, and ensure all profile details (name, date of birth, and contact information) are accurate and updated.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:Explore Schemes & Courses'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Access your dashboard and search for PM VIKAS and job roles. Use filters such as scheme, mode, and sector to find suitable courses or batches.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Choose a batch for your preferred job role and submit your interest or application. You may select up to five batches, which will be reviewed by the training partner /training centre.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05'}, {'text': ':'}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'Finalise Enrolment & Status'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After approval from the training partner / training centre, accept the invitation through your portal to confirm enrolment. Track your application status under the “Applications” section.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** **Register/Login**\nVisit the SIDH Portal (https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/), register as a Learner/Participant (Candidate) or log in if already registered, and complete e-KYC using your personal details.\n
\n\n**Step 02:Profile Setup**\nCreate your account password/PIN, verify your mobile number via OTP, and ensure all profile details (name, date of birth, and contact information) are accurate and updated.\n
\n\n**Step 03:Explore Schemes & Courses**\n
\n\nAccess your dashboard and search for PM VIKAS and job roles. Use filters such as scheme, mode, and sector to find suitable courses or batches.\n
\n\n**Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch**\n
\n\nChoose a batch for your preferred job role and submit your interest or application. You may select up to five batches, which will be reviewed by the training partner /training centre.\n
\n\n**Step 05**:**Finalise Enrolment & Status**\nAfter approval from the training partner / training centre, accept the invitation through your portal to confirm enrolment. Track your application status under the “Applications” section.\n
\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'PM VIKAS', 'url': 'pmvikas.minorityaffairs.gov.in'} SLUG: pm-vikas

SCHEME NAME: Special Incentive to ST (P)/OBC/MOBC Meritorious Students SHORT TITLE: SISTPOMMS CATEGORY: Education & Learning LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Assam MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Incentive, Student, School, Education, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, Merit DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide financial grants to meritorious ST (P)/OBC/MOBC students in Assam who secure high marks in Matriculation, 10+2, Graduation, or Post Graduation. Benefits include fixed monetary assistance ranging from ₹10,000/- to ₹25,000/- based on educational level. The scheme offers monetary grants to students who achieve high academic marks in Matriculation, 10+2, Graduation, or Post Graduation examinations. To be eligible, the applicant must belong to the ST (P)/OBC/MOBC community and meet the specified percentage criteria for their respective educational level. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plains Tribes and Backward Classes, Assam. schemeName: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child

SHORT TITLE:
PG-IGSSGC

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning, Women and Child

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry of Education

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Scholarship, Girl Child

DESCRIPTION:
A scholarship scheme by the University Grants Commission for Girl students who are admitted in the first year of PG courses in any designated university or a postgraduate college, and happen to be the only girl child in the family. The amount of fellowship is ₹ 36,200/- per annum.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'A scholarship scheme by the University Grants Commission for Girl students who are admitted in the first year of PG courses in any designated university or a postgraduate college, and happen to be the only girl child in the family. The amount of fellowship is ₹ 36,200/- p.a. for the full duration of a PG course. Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates

PGSPCSCSTC

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning

LEVEL:
Central

All

MINISTRY:
Ministry of Education

Individual

TAGS:
Post Graduate, Scholarship, Professional Course, ST, SC, Student, UGC

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme has been initiated to provide opportunity to deprived sections of the society, viz. SC/ST for undertaking postgraduate level studies in Professional subjects like Engineering & Technology, Management, Pharmacy etc. in recognised Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Post Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates” has been initiated to provide opportunities to the deprived sections of the society, viz. the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) for undertaking postgraduate level studies in Professional subjects like Engineering & Technology, Management, Pharmacy etc. in recognized Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to 1000 SC/ST candidates to pursue postgraduate level studies in Professional courses.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The students should belong to the SC/ST category.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The candidate must have obtained a Graduate text:
SCHEME NAME:
Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students

SHORT TITLE:
DAMCYOBCS

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Himachal Pradesh

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Ambedkar, OBC, Student, Medhavi, Scholarship

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students” was started by Dept. of Education, H.P. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to top 1000 meritorious students of OBC declared as such in the result of Matric Examination conducted by H.P. Board.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students” was started by the Department of Education, Himachal Pradesh. Under the scheme, the Scholarship is given to the top 1000 meritorious students of Other Backward Classes (OBC) declared as such in the result of the Matric Examination conducted by the H.P. Board of School Education, Dharamshala, strictly on a merit basis to students studying in a recognized (including Professional/Technical) institution within or outside the State. The renewal in the 10+2 Class/2nd Year of course will be subject to satisfactory performance in internal examinations of the 10+1 Class/1st Year Course.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The student should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The student should belong to the Other Backward Classes Category declared as such by the Himachal Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scholarship will be given in case the eligible students take admission to any professional/technical course after matric, in a recognized Institution within or outside the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The scholarship is limited for a maximum of two successive years after matric.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The renewal in 2nd year of the course will be subject to satisfactory performance in 1st year of the course.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scholarship scheme, an amount of ₹18,000/- will be given to each eligible student per year for two successive years after matric.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' The students applying for the scholarship for the first time need to "Register" using the icon “New Registration” at the NSP Portal URL - '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://scholarships.gov.in/'}], 'link': 'https://scholarships.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ', by providing accurate and correct information as per their documents.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' After successfully get registration done, students will get their “Student Registration ID”.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' Through “Student Registration ID” students will be able to login into the account using the icon “Fresh Application” at NSP Portal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:'}, {'text': ' After successful login to the portal, the welcome page appeared. On clicking the “Application Form” icon, students will be directed to the application screen.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' Now, the students may fill out the complete application form and on clicking the “Final Submit” button, the application is finally submitted.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 06:'}, {'text': ' On successful submission of the application, a system-generated registration number is sent to the students which can be used for future reference.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The printed copy of the Online Scholarship Form (after successful online submission of the form), along with all requisite documents, needs to be submitted by the student to his/her Head of the Institute, who will retain it in the institution.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The Institution will further forward the duly attested printed form (after successful online verification) along with the Verified Candidate List(s) (on the prescribed format) to the concerned DDHE(in case of Govt./Private Recognized Schools within the state) & to this Directorate (in case of Professional/Technical institutes / Out of state institutes), frontline verification & cross-checking.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' After successful online verification, the DDHE shall retain the hard copies of the students of Private Recognized School(s), and return the remaining forms to the concerned schools. The DDHE also needs to forward the Verified Candidate List(s) in r/o their respective district(s) to this Directorate.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' In case, any offline application form is received by the Head of the Institute /DDHE, he/she is directed to return the same to the concerned student/institute, at his / her own level; & to direct the sender to fill the form online & submit the printed copy of the Online Application Form, afterward, through the same channel.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The students applying for the scholarship for the first time need to &quot;Register&quot; using the icon “New Registration” at the NSP Portal URL - [https://scholarships.gov.in/](https://scholarships.gov.in/), by providing accurate and correct information as per their documents.\n**Step 02:** After successfully get registration done, students will get their “Student Registration ID”.\n**Step 03:** Through “Student Registration ID” students will be able to login into the account using the icon “Fresh Application” at NSP Portal.\n**Step 04:** After successful login to the portal, the welcome page appeared. On clicking the “Application Form” icon, students will be directed to the application screen.\n**Step 05:** Now, the students may fill out the complete application form and on clicking the “Final Submit” button, the application is finally submitted.\n**Step 06:** On successful submission of the application, a system-generated registration number is sent to the students which can be used for future reference.\n**Note 01:** The printed copy of the Online Scholarship Form (after successful online submission of the form), along with all requisite documents, needs to be submitted by the student to his/her Head of the Institute, who will retain it in the institution.\n**Note 02:** The Institution will further forward the duly attested printed form (after successful online verification) along with the Verified Candidate List(s) (on the prescribed format) to the concerned DDHE(in case of Govt./Private Recognized Schools within the state) &amp; to this Directorate (in case of Professional/Technical institutes / Out of state institutes), frontline verification &amp; cross-checking.\n**Note 03:** After successful online verification, the DDHE shall retain the hard copies of the students of Private Recognized School(s), and return the remaining forms to the concerned schools. DESCRIPTION:
The Govt. of Maharashtra vide G.R. dated 26/6/2008 launched the scheme “Opening and Running Junior Colleges for VJNT Students Run by Voluntary Agencies” for the educational and social development of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Govt. of Maharashtra vide G.R. dated 26/6/2008 has started (11th and 12th class) Junior College education by upgrading the 148 secondary Ashram Schools for educational and social development of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students. The scheme “Opening and Running Junior Colleges for VJNT Students Run by Voluntary Agencies” is implemented by the Social Justice and special assistance department in Maharashtra. Under this scheme, the government provides academic educational facilities, free lodging, and boarding in Junior Colleges. It also provides medical facilities, bedding and clothing, and uniforms to residential students. This scheme is implemented on a grant-in-aid basis to voluntary organizations.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Students should be residents of Maharashtra.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students should belong to VJNT Category.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Voluntary Agency should have running Secondary Ashram School.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The result of Secondary School should not below than 60%.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Voluntary Agencies should be economically sound to run Junior Colleges.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Building, Water supply, Electricity etc. facilities should be available.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Most of Population should be VJNT nearby School place.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'There should not be more Junior Colleges around the Ashram School.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'There should not be any dispute / Court matter against the Voluntary Agency.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': ' The scheme "Kanyashree Prakalpa" by the Department of Women Development and Social Welfare and Child Development (DWD), Government of West Bengal, aims to improve the status and well-being of girls, specifically those from socio-economically disadvantaged families. Through this scheme, Conditional Cash Transfers are provided to incentivise girls to continue their education for a longer period and disincentivise early marriage. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Incentivising girls to continue in education for a longer period of time, and complete secondary, higher secondary, higher education, or equivalent in technical, vocational, or sports streams, thereby giving them a better footing in both the economic and social spheres.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Disincentivising marriage until at least the age of 18, the legal age of marriage, thereby reducing the risks of early pregnancies, associated risks of maternal and child mortality, and other debilitating health conditions, including those of malnutrition.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "It was also decided that the Scheme should confer more than just monetary support; it should be a means of financial inclusion and a tool of empowerment for adolescent girls. The schemes' benefits are therefore paid directly to bank accounts in the girls' names, leaving the decision of utilisation of the money in their hands."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' To reinforce the positive impact of increased education and delayed marriages, the scheme also works to enhance the social power and self-esteem of girls through a targeted behaviour change communication strategy. The communication strategy not only builds awareness of the scheme, but includes adolescent-friendly approaches like events, competitions and Kanyashree clubs, and the endorsement of strong women figures as role models to promote social and psychological empowerment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': Individual

Scholarship, Sainik School, Direct Benefit Transfer, Financial Assistance, Sainik School Imphal

DESCRIPTION:
The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently
residing in the States of studying at Sainik School Imphal, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Scholarship for Cadets of Sainik School Imphal Scheme is a program designed to provide financial assistance to the cadets studying in Sainik School Imphal, which is located in Manipur, India. The scholarship is provided by the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, with the aim of helping students who are facing financial constraints and are unable to bear the expenses of their education.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scholarship covers various expenses related to the education of the cadets, including tuition fees, boarding and lodging charges, uniforms, and other necessary expenses. {'children': [{'children': [{'text': ' Scholarship will be admissible to Mizo students permanently residing in the state of Mizoram studying at Sainik School, Imphal.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Student should not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' Scholarship for studying in any class will be available for only one year and renewable as per Rules/Conditions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If after the award of the scholarship the cadet is found medically unfit in any way which according to the appropriate medical authority, renders him unfit for his entry into the NDA, the scholarship awarded shall be discontinued from the date the cadet is declared unfit'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Financial Assistance: The scholarship provides financial assistance to cadets who are facing financial constraints and are unable to bear the expenses of their education. It helps them focus on their studies and achieve their academic goals.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Motivation: The scholarship acts as a motivation for the cadets to perform well academically and strive for excellence. DESCRIPTION:
This is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, for the students of Scheduled Tribe (ST) for studies in India. This scheme is for pursuing higher education starting from class XI to Post Graduation courses in India. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '"Post Matric Scholarship Scheme For The Students Belonging To Scheduled Tribe For Studies In India" is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, for the students of Scheduled Tribe (ST) for studies in India. This scheme is for pursuing higher education starting from class XI to Post Graduation courses in India. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective of the scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To enable eligible Scheduled Tribe students to undertake quality education from Post Matric to Post Graduate level by providing them financial assistance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To create an error free platform ensuring that the targeted beneficiaries receive scholarship on time. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Scholarship under the Scheme will be available to ST students for studies in India and will be directly transferred to the account of students.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scope of the scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'These scholarships are available for studies in India only and are awarded by the Government of the State/Union Territory Administration to which the applicant actually belongs i.e. were permanently settled.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scholarships are open to nationals of India. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'These scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation post-secondary courses pursued in recognized institutions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Only those candidates who belong to Scheduled Tribes so specified in relation to the State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (i.e. permanently settled) and who have passed the Matriculation or Higher Secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary Education, will be eligible. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students studying in Class XI of Higher Secondary Schools which have a continuous school course of 12th class will not be eligible. However, in cases where the X class examination of such courses is treated as equivalent to Matriculation and students after passing the tenth class can join other courses, such students will be treated as post-matric students and will be eligible for the award of scholarships. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students pursuing post-graduate courses in medicine will be eligible if they are not allowed to practice during the period of their course. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students who after failing or passing the undergraduate/post-graduate examinations in Arts/Science/Commerce join any recognized professional or technical certificate/diploma/degree courses will be awarded scholarships if otherwise eligible. No subsequent failure will be condoned except for courses in Group ‘I’, and no further change in the course will be allowed. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students who pursue their studies through correspondence courses are also eligible. The term correspondence includes distant and continuing education. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Employed students who take leave without pay for the entire duration of the course and study as full-time students will be eligible for scholarships. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'From the academic year 1980-81, employed students whose income combined with the income of their parents/guardians does not exceed the maximum prescribed income ceiling are made eligible for post-matric scholarships to the extent of reimbursement of all compulsorily payable non-refundable fees.  '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All children of the same parents/guardians will be entitled to receive the benefits of the scheme. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If awarded any other scholarship/stipend, the student can exercise his/her option for either of the two scholarships/stipends, whichever is more beneficial to him/her, and should inform the awarding authority through the Head of the Institution about the option made. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this scheme from the date he/she accepts another scholarship/stipend. The student can, however, accept free lodging or a grant or Adhoc monetary help from the State Government or any other source for the purchase of books, and equipment or for meeting the expenses on board and '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'lodging in addition to the scholarship amount paid under this scheme. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Income Criteria:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents/guardians’ income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,00,000/- per annum.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE 1:'}, {'text': ' So long as either of the parents (or husband in the case of a married unemployed girl student) is alive, only the income of the parents/husband, as the case may be, from all sources has to be taken into account and of no other member even though they may be earning. In the form of income declaration, income is to be declared on this basis. Only in the case where both the parents (or husband in the case of a married but unemployed girl student) have died, the income of the guardian who is supporting the student in his/her studies is to be taken. Such students whose parental income is affected due to the unfortunate death of one of their earning parents and resultantly comes within the income ceiling prescribed under the scheme shall become eligible for the scholarship, subject to their fulfilling other conditions of eligibility, from the month in which such sad incidence takes place. Applications for scholarships from such students can be considered even after the lapse of the last date of receipt of applications, on compassionate grounds.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE 2:'}, {'text': ' House rent allowance received by the parents of a student shall be exempted from the computation of ‘income’ if the same has been permitted to be exempted for purpose of Income-tax. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE 3:'}, {'text': ' Income certificate is required to be taken once only i.e. at the time of admission to courses that are continuing for more than one year. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE 4: '}, {'text': 'The revised income ceilings account for Consumer Price Index for Industrial workers up to October 2009. The income Ceiling would be revised once every two years linking it with Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers for the month of October of the year, preceding the year of revision, and will be made effective from April.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Stipend: '}, {'text': 'The student will be entitled to stipend as per rates listed below. Annually: 3800'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Monthly: 230; Annually: 2300'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}], 'type': 'table_row'}], 'type': 'table'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 1: '}, {'text': 'It needs to be clarified that the stipend is a sort of incentive provided to a student for pursuing a particular course and in no way meant to provide for reimbursement of boarding and lodging charges like mess, hostel or other similar charges.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 2:'}, {'text': ' Additional Disability Allowance: -In addition to stipend provided above, an additional Stipend of Rs. 800/-per month (Rs. 9600 annually) will be given to the Divyangjan student who is hosteller and Rs.600 (Rs 7200 annually) to Day scholar. The disability as defined under the relevant ‘Disabilities Act’ has to be certified by competent medical authority of the State Govt./UT Administration. The provisions of Disability allowance will also apply to leprosy-cured and students having sickle cell Anemia or Thalassemia as notified by Ministry of Social Justice and empowerment '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 3:'}, {'text': ' Under “National fellowship & Scholarship for Higher Education of ST students” Scheme [Top class Scholarship], MoTA is providing Scholarships to students for pursuing graduation and post-graduation courses in Top Class Institutes (currently 252) across India. To avoid duplicity, students pursuing courses in such Institutes will not be entitled for benefit under Post Matric Scholarship. Scholarship holder under this scheme can hold only one scholarship/stipend at a time.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A centrally sponsored scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for students from scheduled tribes pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Components of the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scholarship has two components: '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Component 1: Payment of compulsory fees charged by educational institutions subject to the limit fixed by the concerned State. Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs

SHORT TITLE:
IP-MEA

Education & Learning

LEVEL:
Central

All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of External Affairs

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Internship

DESCRIPTION:
The Ministry of External Affairs launched the first edition of the Internship Programme in 2022. The internship policy aims to take foreign policy closer to the people. A total of 75 internships will be offered in the year 2022 in a single term of three months during April to June 2022.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Ministry of External Affairs of the Govt. of India launched the first edition of its Internship Programme in 2022. The internship policy aims to take foreign policy closer to the people; bring in more focus on MEA; provide value to the interns; ensure better gender inclusivity and increase diversity in terms of qualifications, domicile, and socio-economic status in the cohort of interns engaged by the MEA. During the course of the internship, the Interns would be introduced to various aspects of the functioning of the Ministry, its attached offices, the public interface of the Ministry and its role in helping Indian citizens, as well as a possible visit one of the Missions abroad, subject to prevailing conditions. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'text': '1.  The internship shall generally be open to Indian citizens with a minimum educational qualification of a graduate degree from a recognized university at the time of applying.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.  The internship shall also be open to student who is presently in the final year of their graduation, where an internship is a mandatory part of the final year curriculum. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.  The age of the candidate should not exceed 25 years as on 31 December of the year of internship. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 1: Diversity:'}, {'text': ' In line with the goal of taking the Ministry and foreign policy closer to the people from all parts of the country, the policy aims to ensure increased diversity amongst the group of interns with respect to gender, underprivileged sections, geographical domicile, and representation from both urban and rural areas. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 2: Priority:'}, {'text': ' Candidates from districts under the Transformation of Aspirational Districts Programme (TADP) and those belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories shall be given priority at different stages in the selection process. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'An '}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'honorarium of ₹ 10,000 per month'}, {'text': ' will be paid to each intern to defray basic costs. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Introduction to the various aspects of the functioning of the MEA, its attached offices, the public interface of the Ministry, and its role in helping the Indian citizens.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Possible visit one of the Missions abroad, subject to prevailing conditions. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Cost of '}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'one-time to and fro air travel'}, {'text': ' subject to a ceiling of the prevailing economy class airfare between the State capital and Delhi, from the domicile State or from the college/university of the selected candidates will be provided. The interns would be responsible for their boarding and lodging in Delhi during the period of their internship. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Interns will be assigned specific topics of work by the concerned Head of the Division (HOD) and may be required to conduct research, write reports, analyze evolving developments, or carry out any other task entrusted to them by the HOD.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A total of '}, {'bold': True, 'text': '75 internships'}, {'text': ' will be offered in a year in a single term of three months from April to June.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture SHORT TITLE: SPASSEOGFAC CATEGORY: Education & Learning, Sports & Culture LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Student, Art, Culture, Education, Scholarship, Training DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage young talents in Goa to achieve the highest possible standard in fields of Art and Culture by providing financial support for training outside the State. Assistance is provided to eligible students for basic or advanced education in art. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture" was launched by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and give opportunity to the young talents in the State to excel their talent to reach the highest possible standard/merit under the guidance of a renowned teacher/artist outside the State. The scheme provides financial support to students seeking to get basic or advanced education/training in any field of Art and Culture, such as music, dance, theatre, fine arts, folk arts, or photography (fields of visual and performing art). The applications for this scheme are accepted when the Directorate of Art and Culture releases an advertisement/press note on local daily newspapers thereby inviting applications. The scheme shall remain in force up to 31st March 2027.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must intend to seek advanced education in any field of Art and Culture, such as music, dance, theatre, fine art, folk art, photography, etc. (fields of visual and performing art).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must seek this education outside Goa or outside India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have outlined knowledge about the art form in which the education is desired.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be born in Goa.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be residing in Goa for a substantial period or at least for the last fifteen years to the date of application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant shall cost of the education.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Relaxation/Exception', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, be considered depending upon his/her contribution or merit. The decision regarding this exception is to be taken by the committee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Financial Assistance', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Financial assistance is given to acquire basic or advanced education in any field of Art and Culture (like music, dance, theatre, fine arts, folk arts, photography, etc.) at State, National, and International levels.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Maximum assistance up to ₹1,20,000/- is provided for acquiring education outside Goa or the actual cost of the education, whichever is less.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Maximum assistance up to ₹3,00,000/- is provided for acquiring education outside India or the actual cost of the education, whichever is less.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Disbursement', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The committee may scrutinize and decide upon the quantum of assistance, from case to case, depending upon the nature of training, reputation of the Institution/Guru, and eligibility of the applicant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The assistance shall be disbursed by the Director of Art and Culture only after obtaining Government approval for the names selected by the Sub-Committee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Conditions', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The student shall undergo training on full time or part time basis.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The student must maintain 75 % attendance for the total course period or for one year period of the course (whichever is less). This shall not be applicable where there are regular examinations recognized by the University or Board or Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The student can apply for assistance for a maximum of five years (initially for three years and upon review if showing progress, extended for two years).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A review report of the student shall be taken every six months.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The student shall be bound to present performance as and when asked by the Directorate of Art and Culture.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scholarship amount shall be recovered if the student fails to maintain 75% attendance (where applicable).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The amount shall be recovered from the student if the course is not completed.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Step 1: Notification of Application Cycle ', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Directorate of Art and Culture releases an advertisement or press note on local daily newspapers, officially inviting applications from eligible students for availing benefits under this scheme. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants are advised to monitor the local daily newspapers for the release of this advertisement, as it signals the official opening of the application window.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Step 2: Submission of Application and Supporting Documentation ', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Interested students shall prepare all the requisite supporting documents and formally apply directly to the Director of Art and Culture. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "This submission package must comprehensively include the applicant's photograph, age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), residence certificate, reports of previous training and competition participation, income certificate, and a recommendation letter from a recognized person or Institution working in the field of Art and Culture."}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Step 3: Disclosure of Personal Contribution and External Grants ', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The application requires the student to clearly mention the amount of contribution or capital that they are personally putting forth for the particular course they are undertaking. releases an advertisement or press note on local daily newspapers, officially inviting applications from eligible students for availing benefits under this scheme. \n- Applicants are advised to monitor the local daily newspapers for the release of this advertisement, as it signals the official opening of the application window.\n\n##### ***Step 2: Submission of Application and Supporting Documentation*** \n\n- Interested students shall prepare all the requisite supporting documents and formally apply directly to the Director of Art and Culture. \n- This submission package must comprehensively include the applicant's photograph, age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), residence certificate, reports of previous training and competition participation, income certificate, and a recommendation letter from a recognized person or Institution working in the field of Art and Culture.\n\n##### ***Step 3: Disclosure of Personal Contribution and External Grants*** \n\n- The application requires the student to clearly mention the amount of contribution or capital that they are personally putting forth for the particular course they are undertaking. \n- Furthermore, if the student is receiving any grant or scholarship from other Government or non-Government bodies for the same training, a document in that regard, along with the detailed breakdown of the financial grants, must be submitted while applying for assistance.\n\n##### ***Step 4: Scrutiny and Recommendation by Sub-Committee*** \n\n- The application and supporting documentation will be processed and reviewed by the designated Sub-Committee. \n- This committee is responsible for scrutinizing the application, assessing the eligibility of the applicant, the nature of the training, and the reputation of the Institution or Guru to decide upon the quantum of assistance to be recommended.\n\n##### ***Step 5: Obtaining Government Approval and Fund Disbursement*** \n\n- Once recommendations are officially received from the Sub-Committee, the Director of Art and Culture shall proceed to obtain the necessary Government approval for the names of the students selected for assistance under the scheme. \n- Following this formal approval, the Director shall then disburse the sanctioned amount of assistance to the eligible students.\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://artandculture.goa.gov.in/pages/schemes-programmes/assistance-to-students-seeking-education-outside-goa-in-any-field-of-art'} SLUG: spasseogfac

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Each selected student receives ₹1,000/- per month for a duration of 10 months.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To appear in the scholarship examination, students can obtain the application form from the office of the Block Education Officer or download it from the School Education Department’s website ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in'}], 'link': 'https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ') or SCERT Uttarakhand’s website ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://scert.uk.gov.in'}], 'link': 'https://scert.uk.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ') during September–October every year. A photocopy of the application form is also valid. No application or examination fee is charged.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'While filling out the application form, students must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 7 mark sheet, caste certificate, and disability certificate (if applicable). All information must be filled in correctly, and the completed form should be submitted to the Principal of the school where the student is enrolled.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Principal will verify the form based on the attached documents and school records, attest the photograph, and forward the verified form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the tentative date of 12 November.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After submission, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. Students can collect the admit card either from their school or the Block Education Officer’s office.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The examination is conducted every year in the month of January.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After the successful completion of the process, the school Principal informs the student. The student must provide their Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked bank account details to the school, following which the scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '\n - To appear in the scholarship examination, students can obtain the application form from the office of the Block Education Officer or download it from the School Education Department’s website ([https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in](https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/)) or SCERT Uttarakhand’s website ([https://scert.uk.gov.in](https://scert.uk.gov.in/)) during September–October every year. A photocopy of the application form is also valid. No application or examination fee is charged. - While filling out the application form, students must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 7 mark sheet, caste certificate, and disability certificate (if applicable). All information must be filled in correctly, and the completed form should be submitted to the Principal of the school where the student is enrolled.\n - The Principal will verify the form based on the attached documents and school records, attest the photograph, and forward the verified form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the tentative date of 12 November.\n - After submission, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. Students can collect the admit card either from their school or the Block Education Officer’s office.\n - The examination is conducted every year in the month of January.\n - After the successful completion of the process, the school Principal informs the student. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Young Faculty Research Fellowship (YFRF)” is a component of the “Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT”, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to promote R&D, create an innovative ecosystem, and enhance India’s competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. MeitY.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A detailed performance assessment/review of award would be conducted annually and decision on continuation of YFRF would be taken accordingly.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowship, the institution should inform Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme immediately. SHORT TITLE:
ICSSR DOCTORAL FELLOWSHIP

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning

Central

All

MINISTRY:
Ministry of Education

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
ICSSR Fellowships, Doctoral Fellowship, Social Science Research, PhD, Research Scholars

DESCRIPTION:
The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Doctoral Fellowships to support full-time Ph.D. scholars engaged in high-quality research in the field of social and human sciences. These fellowships are awarded to Indian research scholars registered in Ph.D. programs at UGC-recognized u

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': "The Fellowship is aimed at promoting original, socially relevant, and policy-focused research in the social sciences. The fellowship provides financial support through a monthly grant of ₹20,000 and an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 for up to two years, with an initial award period of one year, which is renewed for the second year subject to fulfilment of requisite criteria. It also offers institutional and short-term fellowships including a six-month short term fellowship for scholars nearing Ph.D. submission (minimum three years of completed PhD research) and a standalone contingency grant of ₹62,500 for specific research needs. Applications are invited through ICSSR’s website and social media platforms. Fellows are expected to pursue full-time research, submit regular progress reports, and provide a final submission that includes published work, a book-length thesis, and audited financial records.  Given India's social science ecosystem, it seeks to promote research excellence, evidence-based research, and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'text': '1)\tApplicant must be an Indian citizen.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tMust be a full-time bonafide Ph.D. scholar in a social science discipline in a UGC-recognized university, deemed-to-be university, institute of national importance, ICSSR Research Institute, or college with approved Ph.D. programme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3)\tThe Ph.D. topic must have been confirmed by the DRC/authorised statutory body of the institution on or before the last date of call for applications.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4)\tAge must be below 40 years as on the last date of application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5)\tAge relaxation of 5 years allowed for SC/ST/OBC-(NCL) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6)\tMust have secured a minimum of 55% marks in post-graduation, with 5% relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC-(NCL)/PwD).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': '1)\tMonthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.20,000 per month'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2)\tContingency Grant @ Rs.20,000 per annum'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad

SHORT TITLE:
FATSSFSHSA

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Delhi

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
College, Scheduled Caste, Student, Scholarship, Abroad, Foreign, Education

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to support SC students for higher education abroad in fields like Engineering, Sciences, and Humanities. Benefits include up to ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. and ₹10,00,000 for Masters, with eligibility criteria including residency and income below ₹8,00,000/-.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 2020, the scheme "Financial Assistance To SC Students For Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi aims to provide financial support to 100 selected Scheduled Caste (SC) students for pursuing Masters and Ph.D. programs abroad in specified fields such as Engineering, Pure Sciences, and Humanities. The scheme offers up to ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. and ₹10,00,000/- for Masters, disbursed in installments. Eligible candidates must be below 30 years, have a family income under ₹8,00,000 annually, and be bonafide residents of Delhi for at least five years. The scheme is implemented by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Government of NCT of Delhi.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a citizen of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a domicile of Delhi or a bonafide resident of Delhi for at least 5 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be the only child eligible under this scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Employed applicant should submit their application through their employer with a No Objection Certificate (NOC).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have already completed the same level of education (Master’s/Ph.D.) in India or abroad.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants for the Ph.D. Course should have secured at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in relevant Master’s Degree.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants for the Master’s Degree Course should have secured at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a relevant Bachelor’s Degree.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be below 30 years old as of the cutoff date.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant’s total family income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/- per annum.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': 'Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000/- per annum, up to a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. (4 years) and ₹10,00,000/- for Masters (2 years).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Funds are Disbursed in Installments', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'First installment after admission confirmation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Subsequent installments every six months/one year based on progress reports.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Covers tuition and living expenses at accredited foreign universities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Conditions', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Recipients must return to India after completion and stay for at least 5 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Violations may require refund of the entire amount with 15% compound interest.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' The interested applicant should take print of the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'prescribed format'}], 'link': 'https://scstwelfare.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/scstwelfare/circulars-orders/abroad.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' of the application form.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields in English/Hindi (block letters). Paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required) and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' Send the hard copy of the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the required documents to the Department for Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Vikas Bhavan, New Delhi.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Post-Application Processes', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' The applications received within the deadline will be reviewed for eligibility and placed before the Selection Committee. The shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interview. In case of a tie, preference will be given to the older candidate (as per the date of birth in the Secondary School Certificate).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' Upon selection, the first installment is released after admission confirmation. Subsequent installments require progress reports.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take print of the [prescribed format](https://scstwelfare.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/scstwelfare/circulars-orders/abroad.pdf) of the application form.\n**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields in English/Hindi (block letters). Paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required) and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).\n**Step 3:** Send the hard copy of the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the required documents to the Department for Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Vikas Bhavan, New Delhi.\n> **Post-Application Processes**\n\n**Step 1:** The applications received within the deadline will be reviewed for eligibility and placed before the Selection Committee. The shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interview. In case of a tie, preference will be given to the older candidate (as per the date of birth in the Secondary School Certificate).\n**Step 2:** Upon selection, the first installment is released after admission confirmation. Subsequent installments require progress reports.\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Candidates already studying abroad before the advertisement date.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Those who have already acquired the same qualification (Masters/Ph.D.) in India or abroad.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

{'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://scstwelfare.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/scstwelfare/circulars-orders/abroad.pdf'}

Internship, Law, Information Technology, Student, Vigilance

DESCRIPTION:
CVC initiated an Internship Scheme in the year 2016. This Scheme seeks to engage Indian Nationals, who are Graduates (awaiting final year results) /Post Graduate or Research Students enrolled in reputed Universities/Institutions in India or abroad.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Central Vigilance Commission initiated an Internship Scheme in the year 2016. This Scheme seeks to engage Indian Nationals, who are Graduates (awaiting final year results) /Post Graduate or Research Students enrolled in reputed Universities/Institutions in India or abroad and preferably studying Law, IT, MBA, Social Sciences and associated subjects as “Interns”. The interns shall be attached to the Commission and would be expected to supplement the process of analysis within the Commission through the desirable empirical collection and collation of in-house and other information. For the Interns, the exposure to the functioning of the Commission may be an add-on in furthering their own career goals in other Sectors or International Organizations.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives\x0c'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To allow young academic talent to be associated with the Commission’s work for mutual benefit.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Interns may benefit by getting exposure to the Commission’s functioning and the vigilance issues involved and contribute to the policy formulation of the Commission by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis, briefing reports, policy papers etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The commission may benefit from the additional resources in the form of young talent and their output which will add to its policy formulation base.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The period of Internship shall be for a minimum period of one month extendable to two months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Number of Interns'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A minimum of three Interns are to be permitted to work in the Commission between May to August.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Declaration of Secrecy'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The interns will be required to furnish a Declaration of Secrecy prior to the commencement of the internship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

SCHEME NAME: Lakshya Scheme SHORT TITLE: LS CATEGORY: Education & Learning LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Tripura MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Scholarship, Financial Assistance, UPSC, Exam, Interview DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide financial support in the form of scholarships to candidates who are permanent residents of Tripura and clear the Civil Service Examination (Prelims/Mains) conducted by UPSC. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The state scheme "LAKSHYA" was launched by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Tripura. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support in the form of Scholarship to the candidates having permanent residence in Tripura, clearing Civil Services Examination (CSE) conducted by Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) to adequately equip them, to mould them to acquire such knowledge and skill to compete with the candidates of other states in the civil services examination. The intervention will be in the form of direct financial support to candidates clearing the Civil Services, which includes Part I (Prelims to main), candidates who cleared prelims and are appearing for the mains.
