schemeName: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program

SHORT TITLE:
RGSAIP

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning, Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Panchayati Raj

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Internship, Research Scolars, Students

DESCRIPTION:
The 'Internship Program' as part of the Framework for Implementation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) (2022-23 to 2025-26) of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), Government of India (Gol), seeks to engage 'Students'.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'For Implementation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme of "'}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan"'}, {'text': " (RGSA) (2022-23 to 2025-26), the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), seeks to engage Students enrolled/pursuing undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate degree programs and 'Young Research Scholars' enrolled/pursuing Doctoral (Ph.D.) or post-doctoral degrees in given academic disciplines below from recognized/reputed University(s)/Institution(s) within India or abroad for short-term (maximum of 3 months only) through an Internship program. The engagement of 'Selected Candidates' as 'Interns' will work in various Units, Cells, and Programmes of different Divisions of MoPR under the Revamped RGSA Scheme for the period of FY 2022-23 to 2025-26. The "}, {'bold': True, 'text': '‘Internship Program’'}, {'text': ' is specifically focusing on the ‘Office set-up of MoPR’. A detail list of intended domains/subject areas of research for which the ‘Interns’ are invited and shall be engaged is enclosed in ‘'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Annexure – A'}], 'link': 'https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s316026d60ff9b54410b3435b403afd226/uploads/2023/09/202403121034313656.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '’ of detailed guidelines.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives of the Program'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': "To engage 'Students' and 'Research Scholars for tapping academic talents, knowledge, skills, and techniques to be best utilized and associated with the MoPR's Policy and Action Research work for mutual benefits."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The 'Interns' shall have an opportunity to know and get in-hand experience on the Stier Local Self-governments and other Government functioning, policies, schemes, development initiatives, and interventions for rural development in context to the socioeconomic, cultural, and political aspects."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The 'Interns' will have to provide relevant and logical inputs, suggestions, and recommendations through Data Analysis, Situational Analysis, Empirical and Evidence-Based Research through Quantitative & Qualitative Data Analysis, Desk Reviews, and Policy Analysis at the 'Office setup of MoPR' for preparing Policy Briefs and Working Papers."}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicants i.e., ‘Students’ are enrolled/pursuing Undergraduate/Graduate/Postgraduate degree programme or ‘Research Scholars’ enrolled/pursuing Doctoral (Ph.D.)/Post-Doctoral degree in recognised/reputed University(s)/Institution(s) or completed any of the mentioned course , within last 2 years from India or Abroad are eligible to apply for the Internship Program. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The preferred academic disciplines of Public Policy Studies, Social Policy Studies, Development Studies, Economics, Governance and Public Administration Studies, Rural Development Management, Business Administration, Environment and Energy Studies, Public Health Studies, Sociology, Political Science, Social Work, Statistics, Data Analysis, and other relevant Social Sciences, Management, and Engineering streams.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of the Internship Program shall be at least 15 days, but ‘NOT’ exceeding six (6) months. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'MoPR shall provide them working space, Internet facility, library access, and other necessary requirements for their assignment(s) and deliverables. Interns will be required to have their own laptop. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The candidates those who are not expecting any stipend/honorarium, may also join by the approval of DH of Program Division for Pro bono manner. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The selected candidates will receive a certificate of completion.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Internship Program, MoPR shall provide a flat rate/amount of Rs.7,000/- per month as ‘stipend’ to the ‘Intern’, depending on the best applicants.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

\n\n> ***Instruction for Educational Institutions under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme:***\n\n\n- All educational institutions must register on the departmental scholarship portal within the stipulated time to be covered under the scheme.\n- Institutions/colleges must submit the required documents as specified by the Tribal Welfare Commissioner, Jharkhand, Ranchi.\n- A prescribed form for registration will be made available on the scholarship portal by the Commissioner.\n- Only those institutions that maintain the prescribed academic standards are eligible under this scheme.\n- Institutions/colleges must possess a valid AISHE (All India Survey on Higher Education) or U-DISE (Unified District Information System for Education) code to qualify.\n- Institutions/colleges must register once on the portal, and the registration will remain valid for the duration of the course's recognition period.\n- Institutions must update their NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) or NBA (National Board of Accreditation) details on the portal.\n- The Tribal Welfare Commissioner will verify these details via the NAAC/NBA portal.\n- Institutions must submit a self-audited report every six months in a prescribed format to the Tribal Welfare Commissioner.\n- Each institution must designate a Nodal Officer (Institute Nodal Officer - INO) to handle all scholarship-related tasks and provide necessary information to the District Welfare Officer.\n- Institutions and hostels housing students benefiting from the scheme must upload geo-tagged photographs to the departmental scholarship portal.\n- A two-member inspection team constituted by the Tribal Welfare Commissioner will conduct physical inspections of out-of-state institutions every three years.\n- If irregularities or errors are found during inspections, the Commissioner has the authority to take necessary actions.\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/downloads/Post_Matric_Scholarship_sankalp_2022.pdf'}, {'title': 'Official Website', 'url': 'https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/'} SLUG: jscpmss

SCHEME NAME: Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII) SHORT TITLE: PMSSSO CATEGORY: Education & Learning LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Student, Schedule Caste, Other Backward Class, Stipend, Scholarship, Pre Matric, School DESCRIPTION: "Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)" was introduced by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support parents of children belonging to Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Classes for the education of their wards. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to help improve participation, minimize dropout rates, especially during the transition from primary to next level and elementary to secondary stage, enhance performance, and increase chances of progressing to Post-matric education. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. \n\n**For Application**\n**Step 1:****** Upon successful registration, visit the [Official Website](https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/) of the Chief Minister Scholarship Portal, Government of Goa.\n**Step 2:****** At the top right corner of the landing page, click "[Login](https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/flogin.aspx)". \n**Step 3:****** On the login page, fill in your username, password, captcha code, and click "Login".\n**Step 4:****** Upon logging in, a list of eligible schemes will be displayed. Click the scheme that you intend to apply for.\n**Step 5:****** In the "Apply" section on the side navigation bar, click "Fresh Application". \n**Step 6:****** Fill in all the mandatory fields of the Application Form and upload all the required documents in the specified format and size and click "Submit".\n
\n\n**Post Application Process**\n1. After successful submission of the application, your school/institution will verify the application and submit it to the directorate for further scrutiny.\n2. In case of an issue in the application form or documents uploaded, the school/institution can send back the application to the student for necessary corrections and resubmission.\n
\n\n**Track Your Application**\n**Step 1:****** In the side navigation bar, click "[Track Application](https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/fhome.aspx#Track)".\n**Step 2:****** On the next page, provide your Aadhaar Number and Date of Birth, and click "Submit".\n

text:
SCHEME NAME: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Fellowship Programme SHORT TITLE: SHRDS-FP CATEGORY: Sports & Culture, Education & Learning LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Fellowship, Training, Sports Law DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The "Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Fellowship Programme" by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India. The scheme aims to sporting excellence by modernizing and augmenting the overall sports eco-system, developing a large pool of specialists in sports science, sports medicine, sports technology, sports nutrition, sports physiotherapy, and high-performance coaching, refereeing, and psychology. Under this scheme, fellowships for specialised studies, financial support for participation in and holding of seminars, workshops, clinics, and conferences, assistance for appearing in qualifying examinations and specialised training, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to officials of the Ministry, the Sports Authority of India, National Sports Federations, athletes, coaches, technical officials, students, and researchers. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scheme Implementation:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme is implemented by the Department of Sports in association with its Autonomous Bodies, namely the Sports Authority of India, the Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, the National Dope Testing Laboratory, the National Anti Doping Agency, and the National Sports University.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Components of the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme will have the following components:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(i) Fellowship Programme'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(ii) Exchange of Knowledge/ Research/ Ideas'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a) For attending seminars/ workshops/conferences of repute in India or abroad'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b) For holding training programmes/ seminars/ workshops/ clinics and conferences within the country'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(iii) Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Supporting Personnel'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(iv) Assistance for Research'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(v) Publication of Outstanding Works on sports related Subjects'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be an Indian national currently based in India. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) are not eligible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be more than 55 years of age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should take admission in an institute approved by the UGC or the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in India, and by the respective Government Bodies for institutions outside India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should possess an admission or offer letter from the institution, with a break-up of the fee structure for the entire course.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Preference is given to candidates who have received financial assistance, in part, from the institution offering admission or any other institution or body.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Special conditions for long-term fellowship', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Only permanent employees of autonomous bodies under the Department of Sports, such as the Sports Authority of India (SAI), the Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE), the National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL), the National Anti Doping Agency (NADA), and the National Sports University (NSU), are considered for the long-term programme of up to 2 years on the DoP&T pattern. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The candidate must secure admission in a reputed institute or university in India or abroad.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, Kinesiology, Anthropometry, Exercise Physiology, Sports Psychology, General Theory and Method of Training, Sports Medicine, Anti-doping, Sports Informatics, Sports Statistics and Sports Modelling, Sports Genetics, Sociology of Sports, Sports Management, and Sports Law.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Employees of the Central Government, State Governments, and Autonomous Bodies SCHEME NAME: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi SHORT TITLE: PMSSOBCD CATEGORY: Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Delhi MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Pre Matric Scholarship, OBC Students, Other Backward Classes, Financial Assistance, Day Scholars, Hostellers DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to school-going students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000/- to support their pre-matric education. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Department, Government of NCT of Delhi, under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, to support the education of students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) through scholarship assistance and ad-hoc grants. The scheme covers day scholars studying from Class I to Class X and hostellers studying from Class III to Class X. Scholarships are awarded to eligible students whose parents\' or guardians\' annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. The scholarship is tenable only in recognized institutions and is payable for 10 months in an academic year. Eligible students also receive an annual ad-hoc grant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': {'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'A Fellowship Scheme by the All India Council for Technical Education, Ministry of Education. This Component focuses on attracting students to pursue doctoral degree. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'INSPIRE Fellowship is one of the components of INSPIRE scheme implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India to strengthen the Science and Technology base of the country. Widow

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, aims to provide financial assistance to widows aged between 18-59 years. The scheme offers ₹1,000/- per month to help meet their basic needs, ensuring public assistance for widows in need of support to maintain a dignified life.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Pension Scheme to Widow” is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Eligible beneficiaries should be domiciles of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, with an annual income not exceeding ₹1.5 lakh. The pension is discontinued if the widow remarries or enters a live-in relationship. Additionally, beneficiaries should not be receiving financial assistance under any other widow pension scheme. > **Step 04:** Verification using Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP)- Family ID:

> a) Forget/not having Family ID: If you do not have PPP ID or forget the PPP ID, then you have to select that radio button and you are redirected to the [PPP Portal](https://meraparivar.haryana.gov.in/) for getting their PPP ID.

> b) Having a Family ID: If you have a family ID, then only you can move to the next step for registration. To proceed further, follow the given steps:

> • Select the “I have family ID” radio button

> • Enter Parivar Pehchan Patra number - Family ID

> • Click on “Fetch Family Details” which displays the family members registered under the given Family ID

> • Select a family member for registration

> • Enter the OTP that is being sent to the selected family member for verification

> • Click on “Click to Verify”

> **Step 05:** Aadhaar Verification before Registration: Provide your Aadhaar number and tick mark the checkbox for the declaration. Click on the “Continue” button.

> **Step 06:** After verification, fill out the complete registration form and submit the form.

> **Step 07:** Login into the account: After the final submission of the registration form, a worker can login into his/her account using their username and password but unable to avail of any benefit. 

> **Step 08:** To avail of the benefits, a worker has to pay the registration fee and add a work experience of a minimum of 90 days of the preceding year.

> **Step 09:** Now, the worker needs to add work experience, to add 90 days of experience, the applicant has to fill in all the details where he/she has worked.

> **Step 10:** The schemes and other benefits can be availed once the 90 days’ work experience is approved by the

> Officer.

**Apply for Scheme: Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:**
> **Step 01:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the workers need to visit Official Portal -[Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)

> **Step 02:** If the worker is not registered on the portal, then he/she gets registered on the portal. 

> **Step 03:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’.

> **Step 04:** The worker will receive the login ID on their mobile number.

**Login to Apply for the Scheme:**
> **Step 01:** Visit the Official Portal -[Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)

> **Step 02:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Applicant needs to fill in their credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button.

> **Step 03:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list” and a list of schemes will appear on the screen.

> **Step 04:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”.

> **Step 05:** Fill in all the details asked in the online application form and submit the application form.

DESCRIPTION:

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Financial Assistance to Destitute Children Scheme (FADCS)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana in the year 1984. This is a state scheme under which parents/guardians of children up to the age of 21 years who are deprived of parental support or care by reason of death, continued absence from the home of father for the last 2 years, or father/mother has been sentenced to imprisonment for a period not less than one year or physical or mental incapacity of a parent, are paid financial assistance subject to the maximum for two children of one family as per eligibility criteria laid down in the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': '          Initially the rate of financial assistance of ₹200/- per month per child w.e.f. 01.03.2009. The rate of pension under this scheme is ₹500/- per month per child from January 2014, ₹700/- w.e.f. 01-11-2016, ₹ 900/- w.e.f. 01-11-2017, ₹1100/- w.e.f. 01-11-2018, ₹1350/- w.e.f. 01.01.2020, ₹1600/- w.e.f. 01.04.2021 and ₹1850/- (one child) w.e.f. 01.04.2023.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'text': '1.\tDomicile of Haryana and residing in Haryana State.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tA child under twenty-one years of age.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tIncome of parents/guardians from all sources should not exceed ₹2, 00,000/- per annum.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tChildren have been deprived of parental support or care for the following reasons:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tReason of Death or;'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tContinued absence from home of his father for the last 2 years, or;'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tFather/Mother has been sentenced to imprisonment for a period not less than one year, or;'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tPhysical/Mental incapacity of the Parent.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Rate of Allowance:'}, {'text': ' ₹1850/- per month per child subject to the maximum for two children of one family.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Higher Education For Persons With Special Needs SHORT TITLE: Hepsn CATEGORY: Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Education, Persons With Disablities, Higher Education, Learning DESCRIPTION: The Persons with Disabilities Act 1995 indicates that differently-abled persons should have access to education at all levels. In the higher education sector, the University Grants Commission (UGC) is supporting universities and colleges in the country to involve in special education activities. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The Higher Education for Persons with Special Needs (HEPSN) scheme is meant for creating an environment at higher education institutions to enrich the higher education learning experiences of differently-abled persons. Creating awareness about the capabilities of differently-abled persons, construction aimed at improving accessibility, purchase of equipment to enrich learning, etc., are the broad categories of assistance under this scheme. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Specific Objectives of HEPSN'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': ' '}, {'text': 'The specific objectives of the HEPSN Scheme are as follows: '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To provide equal educational opportunities to differently-abled persons in higher education institutions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To create awareness among the functionaries of higher education about the specific educational needs of differently-abled persons. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To equip higher education institutions with the facilities to provide access to differently-abled persons.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To provide special devices to higher education institutions that will augment the learning experiences of differently-abled persons. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To monitor the implementation of all existing and future legislation and policies, which are about higher education of differently-abled persons. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The college applying for a grant for any one of the components of the scheme should have enrolled disabled persons, including persons with visual impairment, hearing impairment, locomotor disability, etc., in various courses of the institute. The definitions of disability are in accordance with the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'Persons with Disabilities Act 1995'}], 'link': 'https://thenationaltrust.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/Persons%20with%20Disability%20Act%201995.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' Institutions applying for the scheme should have been approved by the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'UGC under Sections 2(f) and 12'}], 'link': 'https://www.ugc.gov.in/recog_college.aspx#:~:text=**%20Apart%20from%20inclusion%20of,funds%20from%20the%20Central%20Government.', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' B. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The college should have constituted an expert committee involving faculty members, experts in the field and differently-abled persons themselves. The committee should meet at least once a year to review the activities related to the concerned scheme(s). '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Provision of Facilities and Financial assistance'}, {'text': ' '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The HEPSN scheme has three components. They are enumerated as follows: '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Component 1: Establishment of Enabling Units for differently-abled Persons '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To develop awareness in the higher education system and also to provide necessary guidance and counseling to differently-abled persons, it is proposed to establish resource units in colleges in the country, which will be called Enabling Units. The functions of this Enabling Unit will be to: '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1. Facilitate admission of differently-abled persons in various courses; '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2. Provide guidance and counseling to differently-abled individuals; '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3. Create awareness about the needs of differently-abled persons, and other general issues concerning their learning; and '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4. Assist differently-abled graduates to gain successful employment in the public as well as private sectors. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The special unit will be coordinated by a faculty member to be nominated by the head of the institution. He/she will work as an honorary coordinator for which a token honorarium of Rs. 4000/- per month will be paid. The unit will also have a budgetary provision of ₹ 50,000/per year towards general administration, stationery, and contingencies, and to avail the services of experts and personnel for organizing awareness programs, counseling sessions, etc., for efficient and independent functioning in order to achieve its objectives.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Component 2: Providing Access to Differently-abled Persons'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The UGC will make a one-time grant of up to ₹ 5,00,000 per college during the Plan period so that the colleges can address the accessibility issues pertaining to disability and make special arrangements in the environment for their mobility and independent functioning.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The colleges address accessibility-related issues as per the stipulations of the Persons with Disabilities Act 1995.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The colleges ensure that all existing structures as well as future construction projects in their campuses are made disabled-friendly. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The institutes create special facilities such as ramps, rails, and special toilets, and make other necessary changes to suit the special needs of differently-abled\xa0persons.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Component 3: Providing Special Equipment to Augment Educational Services for Differently-abled Persons '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Differently-abled persons require special aids and appliances for their daily functioning. These aids are available through various schemes of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. In addition to the procurement of assistive devices through these schemes, higher education institutions may also need special learning and assessment devices to help differently-abled students enrolled in higher education. In addition, visually challenged students need Readers. schemeName: Aapki Beti Hamari Beti
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Aapki Beti Hamari Beti

SHORT TITLE:
ABHB

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Haryana

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Beti, Girl Child, Investment, LIC, Financial Assistance, Grant

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Aapki Beti Hamari Beti” was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Haryana on 24th August 2015.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Aapki Beti Hamari Beti” was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Haryana on 24th August 2015. Under the scheme, the State Government will invest a sum of ₹21000/- with Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) in the name of the 1st Girl child of SC/BPL families, and the 2nd child of a family belonging to any other caste. On attaining 18 years of age, the girl child will be paid the amount. This scheme was launched by the state government with the aim that every girl child has a right to be born and have access to education to develop her potential. The scheme guidelines shall come into force w.e.f. 22nd January 2015.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To bring about change in the societal attitude towards the birth of the girl child.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To improve the child-sex ratio in the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To improve enrolment and retention of girl children in schools and to assist the girls to undertake income-generating activities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To raise the age of marriage of girls.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To ensure survival, and proper health and promote the education of girls in the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Coverage:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme shall be implemented in both rural and urban areas of the state, covering 1st girl child born in families belonging to Schedule Caste, and all Below Poverty Line (BPL), and 2nd/twin/multiple girls born on or after 22nd January 2015 in any family in the State of Haryana satisfying the eligibility criteria. The LADLI scheme is merged into “Aapki Beti Hamari Beti Scheme” and 2nd /twin/multiple girls born on or before 2Ist January 2015 in any family in the State of Haryana, satisfying the eligibility criteria of the Scheme, will be paid benefits as per the rules of erstwhile LADLI Scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Monitoring of the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Monitoring of this scheme shall be done at the level of the Women and Child Development Department, Haryana, and also by 3rd Party audit, as decided by the State Government from time to time.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The following will be the eligibility criteria for beneficiaries under the scheme:-'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'All Scheduled Caste families whose first girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015 shall be eligible to receive a one-time grant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All Below Poverty Line (BPL) families whose first girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015 shall be eligible to receive a one-time grant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All families whose second girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015, will receive a one-time grant irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In cases, twin/multiple girls born on or after 22nd January 2015, will receive a one-time grant per girl child in any family satisfying the eligibility conditions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All families whose second girl child is born on or before 21st January 2015, will receive a one-time grant per girl child per annum for five years irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons. '}, {'bold': True, 'text': '(This is applicable for those cases who are eligible for benefit under the Ladli scheme).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In cases, when twin/multiple girls are born on or before 21st January 2015 will receive a one-time grant per girl child per annum for five years irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons in any family of the State of Haryana satisfying the eligibility conditions. '}, {'bold': True, 'text': '(This is applicable for those cases who are eligible for benefit under Ladli scheme).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All parents resident of Haryana or having a Haryana domicile and at least one of the parents along with the girl child should be residing in Haryana.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The pregnant women should be registered at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or with the Health Department.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The birth of all girl children shall be registered.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The girl child shall have an Aadhaar number. However, at the time of enrolment, the Aadhaar number of the parents is also accepted.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The parents should ensure proper and timely immunization of the girl children and immunization records (as per age of the girl children) should be attached with the application form.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Beneficiaries should be enrolled in Anganwadi Centre as per their age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Change of address: '}, {'text': 'It shall be obligatory for the parents/guardian of the girl children to intimate any change of address to the Women and Child Development Project Officer/ District Programme Officer and Civil Surgeon concerned.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility to encash Membership Certificate:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'In order to obtain the maturity value of the investment in the Membership Certificate at the time of applying the beneficiary girl must be:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '18 years of age'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Unmarried'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Keeping in view the aims of the Scheme, the Government will provide benefits/financial assistance to each girl child beneficiary. This will be provided in the following manner:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'All Scheduled Caste families whose first girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015 shall be eligible to receive a one-time grant of ₹21,000/- only.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All Below Poverty Line (BPL) families whose first girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015 shall be eligible to receive a one-time grant of ₹21,000/- only.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All families whose second girl child is born on or after 22nd January 2015, will receive ₹21000/- (One Time) irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In special cases, when twin/multiple girls are born on or after 22nd January 2015 will receive ₹21000/- (One Time) per girl child in any family of the State of Haryana satisfying the eligibility conditions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All families whose second girl child is born on or before 21st January 2015, will receive ₹5000/- girl child per annum for five years irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons. (This is applicable for those cases who were eligible for benefit under the Ladli scheme),'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In special cases, when twin/multiple girls are born on or before 21st January 2015 will receive ₹2500/- per girl child per annum for five years irrespective of their caste, creed, religion, income, and number of sons in any family of the State of Haryana satisfying the eligibility conditions. (This is applicable for those cases who were eligible for benefit under the Ladli scheme).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The money is to be invested with LIC of India under the Scheme 'Aapki Beti Harnari Beti' in the name of the girl child beneficiary through her mother. In case, the mother is not alive then the money would be deposited in the name of the beneficiary girl child through the father. If both the parents are not alive then this money would be deposited in the name of the beneficiary girl child through her guardian."}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' The money shall be released within one month of submission of the completed application of the beneficiary through her mother/father/guardian.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Withdrawal of Benefit:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The benefit sanctioned under the scheme shall be withdrawn by the competent authority at any stage if it is found that it was sanctioned incorrectly or received by providing false information/fabricated documents.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In case of wrong information, deliberately given by the applicant, he/she shall be liable for prosecution as per law.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'he investment made in the shape of a membership certificate under this scheme shall not be liable for attachment under any law.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If the beneficiary dies after attaining the age of 18 years then the parents of the beneficiary will be eligible for receiving benefits.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The beneficiary would not be eligible for the benefit under the scheme in case she gets married before the age of 18 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' In case of the death of the beneficiary before 18 years of age, her enrolment as a beneficiary under the Scheme Aapki Beti Harnari Beti, would be cancelled with immediate effect, and funds invested against this enrolment would be taken back from Scheme Aapki Beti Hamari Beti with interest and deposited in the receipt Head of the Department.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

SCHEME NAME: Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers) SHORT TITLE: FASUW-ECW CATEGORY: Social welfare & Empowerment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Gujarat MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Funeral, Unorganized, Worker, Death, Financial, Support DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers for funeral expenses. It offers ₹10,000/- to eligible heirs of e-Shram card holders. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)", launched by the Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare Board, Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to the heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers to help with funeral expenses and last rites, addressing the financial burden faced by families during such distressing times. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to one heir of the deceased worker and is specifically designed for e-Shram card holders in the unorganized sector. The applicant must be an heir of an e-Shram card holder (except e-Nirman card holders and Scheduled Caste individuals) and must have an annual income within specified limits of ₹1,20,000/- for rural areas and ₹1,50,000/- for urban areas. DESCRIPTION:
"Chikitsa Pratipoorti Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance to the Registered Workers for the treatment of serious illnesses (cancer, heart disease, kidney disease, etc.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': '"Chikitsa Pratipoorti Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides financial assistance to the Registered Workers for the treatment of serious illnesses such as cancer, heart disease (including surgery), kidney disease (including surgery), incurable mental disease (including surgery), AIDS, etc. The scheme\'s benefits are applicable once per disease per beneficiary.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The applicant should be a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be 18 years or above in age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masons, carpenters, electricians, porters, painters, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The scheme's benefits are applicable once per disease per beneficiary."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be suffering from one of the following serious illnesses: Cancer, heart disease (including surgery), kidney disease (including surgery), incurable mental disease (including surgery), AIDS, total hip replacement, spinal surgery, major vascular disease, bone marrow transplant, liver transplant, hepatoma, advanced cirrhosis of the liver, retinal detachment, proliferative diabetic retinopathy, reflux disease, reflux disease.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE:'}, {'text': ' The list of diseases and the maximum limit of medical expenditure and modifications/modifications made in the list of listed hospitals by the Department of Health, Medical, Education and Family Welfare from time to time and the modifications/modifications made in the list of listed hospitals will be considered applicable for the purpose of this scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

text:

Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chattar Sansodhit Yojna

Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Haryana

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Social Welfare, Financial Assistance,, The Scheme Of Masses, Parity Among Students, Education

DESCRIPTION:
This scheme is being implemented to encourage the merit amongst the students of Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Nomadic, DNTs, Semi-Nomadic, Vimukt Jaati and Tapriwas Jaati and to produce a feeling of competition amongst them and motivate them to earn more and more marks from the middle to post.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Haryana government has prepared a scheme to provide scholarship to the meritorious students of Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Nomadic, DNTs, Semi-Nomadic, Vimukt Jaati and Tapriwas Jaati of classes 11th to postgraduate level. SHORT TITLE:
US

State

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Entrepreneurship, Loan, Social Welfare, Citizen Empowerment, Women, Subsidy

DESCRIPTION:
Udyogini is an innovative scheme to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment, mainly through trade and the service sector. It also provides for a subsidy on loans for undertaking business activities/ micro enterprises through banks, etc.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Started in the year 1997-1998 (and amended in the year 2004-2005), Udyogini is an innovative scheme sanctioned by the Government of Karnataka to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment, mainly through trade and the service sector. It also provides for a subsidy on loans from the Karnataka State Women’s Development Corporations for undertaking business activities/ micro enterprises through banks and other financial institutions. Loans are disbursed through financial institutions like commercial banks, district cooperative banks, and Regional Rural Banks (RRBs). '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In absence of a structured credit system, women would take loans from private borrowers and end up paying a high rate of interest. Hence, there was felt a need to have in place formal channels of credit which are accessible to women. Profitable business activities are approved and supported under this scheme. They may be bookbinding and notebooks manufacturing, chalk and crayon manufacture, jam, jelly, pickles manufacture, papad manufacture, saree, and embroidery work, printing and dyeing of clothes, and woolen weaving, amongst others. Udyogini gives adequate opportunities to such women to help them be self-employed. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists

SHORT TITLE:
Sfava

CATEGORY:
Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Culture

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Artists, Pension, Veteran, Culture, Senior Citizen, Financial Assistance

DESCRIPTION:
A pension scheme by MoC improves the financial and socio-economic status of the old artists and scholars who have contributed significantly in their specialized fields. Still, due to old age, they have to lead a miserable life or are in penury condition.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Scheme for Financial Assistance for Veteran Artists”, earlier known as “Scheme for Pension and Medical Aid to Artists” was launched by the Ministry of Culture. The Scheme is meant for improving the financial and socio-economic status of the old artists and scholars who have contributed significantly in their specialized fields of arts, letters, etc. in their active age or are still contributing in the field of arts, letters, etc. but due to old age, they have to lead a miserable life or are in penury condition.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Under the scheme, financial assistance from the Government may be given in the form of a monthly allowance. Such allowance given to the artists recommended under the center-state Quota will be shared by the Centre and State Government/UT Administration concerned.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'The following two types of cases/requests will be covered under the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Existing beneficiaries getting monthly artistes pension under the 1961 Scheme of ‘Financial Assistance to Persons Distinguished in Letters, Arts and such other walks of life who may be in indigent circumstances’ as amended from time to time; and'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Fresh cases of artists, writers, etc. who are eligible for a grant/monthly financial assistance under the extant guidelines of the Scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Administration of the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Scheme will be implemented by the Ministry with the support of all Zonal Cultural Centres and SCZCC, Nagpur will be the main coordinator. The Ministry reserves the right to modify the provisions of the Scheme at any time. In order to implement the Scheme in a better perspective, the Scheme Guidelines will be circulated widely through State Governments/UT Administrations along with sharing the data of beneficiaries of the Central Government with them.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

The beneficiaries will have to furnish any other requisite information/document(s) as sought by the Ministry from time to time. In case the requisite documents sought by the Ministry are not received from a beneficiary, the pension will not be released to him/her. Further, if any discrepancy is found in the documents furnished by the beneficiary, the pension may not be released or stopped forthwith till such time the discrepancy is rectified.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Renewal of financial assistance to existing beneficiaries:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Subject to the above provisions the recurring monthly allowance sanctioned under the Scheme to the existing beneficiaries shall be for such period as may be determined by the Central Government and/or may be continued on a year-to-year basis on receipt of Digital Life Certificate (DLC) and Income Certificate from them.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Discontinuance of allowance:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "If the financial means of a recipient improve beyond ₹4000/- (Rupees four thousand only) per month or annual income of ₹48,000/- (Rupees forty-eight thousand only) [This excludes artiste pension assistance amount already getting by a beneficiary from the Government (i.e. concerned State Govt./UT Administration and/or Ministry of Culture)], allowance under the Scheme will be discontinued forthwith without any notice to the recipient. The government may also at its discretion terminate the allowance after giving three months' notice to the recipient."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '       Any recipient may also relinquish his/her right to receive allowance by giving written notice to the Government. In such cases, the allowance will be discontinued with effect from the date of his/ her letter of relinquish.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Contact Details:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Section Officer, 210, IInd, ‘D’Block, Puratatva Bhawan, G.P.O. Complex, I.N.A. New Delhi-110023. : (011)-24642165.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Manager (P & GS), Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), 6th & 7th Floor, Jeevan Parkash, 25, Kasturba Gandhi Marg, New Delhi- 110001.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Contact Nos. for Enquiries: 23708275, 23705953, Fax No. 23350832, Email: bo_g103[at]licindia[dot]com'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Application Procedure:**\nThe application may be made online through using the Registration/login Page of &quot;[Culture Scheme Monitoring System (CSMS)](http://csms.nic.in/login/index.php)&quot; on the [website of the Ministry of Culture](https://indiaculture.gov.in) under the heading of &quot;MOC Schemes Application&quot;.\n**Selection of Applicants for Award of Artists Pension:**\n**Step 01:** The applications of eligible artists found to be complete in all respects will be placed before Expert Committee constituted by the Ministry of Culture under the Scheme after getting physical inspection/verification of the applicants done by officer(s) of the Ministry of Culture or one of the organizations of Ministry of Culture.\n**Step 02:** The Expert Committee will consider the applications in terms of extant guidelines of the Scheme and recommend the names of deserving candidates for the award of Artists&#39; Pension solely on merit considering the financial position and eminence etc. of the applicant artist.\n**Step 03:** The recommendations of the Expert Committee are to be examined by the Administration Division with reference to the Scheme guidelines and the rules of the Govt. as also the availability of funds under the Scheme to facilitate an appropriate decision by the Competent Authority.\n**Step 04:** The cases of all the recommended candidates will be submitted finally for getting approval of the Competent Authority which will be one level above the Chairperson of the Expert Committee. Before the release of financial assistance to the approved candidates, the concurrence of the Internal Finance Division shall be obtained.\n**Disbursement of artist&#39;s pension:**\nMonthly Artist Pension to the approved existing beneficiaries (i.e. pensioner) and new artists to be included in the beneficiaries list subsequent to the recommendation of the Expert Committee and thereafter approval of the Competent Authority, will be disbursed by the Ministry of Culture through Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/Direct Benefit Transfer(DBT) or through Service Provider (appointed by Ministry of Culture for disbursement of Artists Pension) directly into their bank account subject to receiving the following documents mandatorily online on the email of Artistes Pension Section of the Ministry i.e. documents.moc@gmail.com or artistspension.moc@gmail.com and after examination/scrutiny, the same are found to be in order:\n\n   1. Every Year in November, the Digital Life Certificate (DLC) of the beneficiary is processed through the Jeevan Pramaan Portal (https://jeevanpramaan.gov.in) by using necessary information like Aadhaar number, Mobile number, and Pension Payment Order (PPO) displayed by the Ministry on its website [Till the time the Aadhaar Card is made mandatory by the Government for an individual residing in the State of Assam, Meghalaya, and Jammu &amp; Kashmir, they may submit a colored scanned copy of their original Life Certificate]; and\n   1. Every Five (05) Years, a Coloured scanned copy of the original Income Certificate in the prescribed format is issued by the concerned Competent Authority of the States/UTs. In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)".\n**Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register".\n**Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again.\n**Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.\n
\n\n**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update**\n**Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login".\n**Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration.\n_*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._\n
\n\n**Steps for Scheme Application**\n**Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. \n**Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. \n**Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox.\n**Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button.\n_*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._\n
\n\n**Application Printing and Modification**\n\n- If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” \n- If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.\n\n
\n\n**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal**\n\n- Call 9909926280 / 9909926180.\n- Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.\n

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
MGPSS

CATEGORY:
Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Gujarat

MINISTRY:

Individual

Yarn, Subsidy, Silk, Jute, Freight, Handloom

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 2007, the "Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme", implemented by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide quality yarn at subsidized rates to handloom weavers, ensuring affordability and improved product quality. The scheme offers freight reimbursement (1–8.5% based on yarn type and region) and a 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC-recognized depots. Eligible beneficiaries include handloom cooperatives, NGOs, and development centers. The scheme is implemented through District Industries Centers (DICs) and aims to sustain employment for economically weak weavers, especially from Scheduled Castes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for emergencies like medical treatment, marriage, and education. Benefits include aid up to ₹2,00,000/and scholarships for dependents. Eligible journalists must be registered and working in Goa for at least three years.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 2010, the scheme "Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)" by the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa aims to provide immediate financial assistance to needy journalists in indigent circumstances for various emergencies such as medical treatment, marriage expenses, funeral costs, and self-employment ventures. The scheme offers benefits like financial aid up to ₹2,00,000/per case and scholarships for journalists\' wards. Eligible applicants must be journalists born or working in Goa for at least three years and registered with the Department of Information and Publicity. The scheme is implemented by a Sub-Committee constituted by the Government of Goa, which includes representatives from the Goa Union of Journalists and the Goa Editors Guild.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a journalist.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have been born and brought up in Goa.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be working in a newspaper establishment in Goa for at least three years continuously.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be registered with the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa, and renew registration by June 30th every year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be engaged in any other profession.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' The interested applicant should take print of the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'prescribed format'}], 'link': 'https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/The-Patrakarb-Kritadnyata-Nidhi-Scheme.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' of the application form.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Post-Application Processes', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' The Director will scrutinize the application and forward it to the Sub-Committee for review. The Sub-Committee will decide the quantum of assistance and seek government approval.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:', 'underline': True}, {'text': ' Once approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed via cheque to the eligible applicant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take print of the [prescribed format](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/The-Patrakarb-Kritadnyata-Nidhi-Scheme.pdf) of the application form.\n**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).\n**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa.\n> **Post-Application Processes**\n\n**Step 1:** The Director will scrutinize the application and forward it to the Sub-Committee for review. The Sub-Committee will decide the quantum of assistance and seek government approval.\n**Step 2:** Once approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed via cheque to the eligible applicant.\n'}

{'children': [{'text': 'Journalists who have availed benefits under other government schemes (e.g., Kanyadan Scheme, Mediclaim, CMRY, Disaster Management Scheme) for the same purpose are ineligible.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe differently abled parents for the marriage of their daughters should be eligible to apply under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tWhile submitting the application for marriage assistance the bride should have completed 18 years of age.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tThe combined annual family income should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01: '}, {'text': 'Applications for assistance can be submitted for the marriage of two daughters.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': " The financial assistance for a second child's marriage can be submitted only after 3 years after the initial grant of allowance."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' After receiving the financial aid as per these terms, if the marriage has to be separated for any reason and the girl has to marry a second time, then the financial aid can be given for the second marriage. {'children': [{'text': '1. A one-time assistance of ₹30,000/- is provided to differently-abled parents for the marriage of their daughters.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Kanyadaan Scheme” is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, the Board provides financial assistance in the form of Kanyadaan to registered construction workers on the occasion of the marriage of their daughters. This assistance is available for up to three daughters of the worker.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons

SHORT TITLE:
MATIDP

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Tamil Nadu

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Financial Assistance, Social Welfare, Person With Disability

DESCRIPTION:
The 'Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to intellectually disabled persons.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The "Maintenance Allowance Scheme for Intellectually Disabled Persons," implemented by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu, addresses the distinct needs of this population group. This program offers a targeted form of monthly financial assistance, ensuring greater financial security for those diagnosed with a significant intellectual disability.  The scheme not only promotes their well-being but also fosters their increased participation within their communities. This initiative underscores the government\'s dedication to building a more inclusive society, one where every individual, regardless of their intellectual abilities, has the opportunity to flourish. By providing this crucial support, the program empowers intellectually disabled persons to achieve greater independence and lead more fulfilling lives.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be an intellectually disabled person.  '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The percentage of disability should be 40% and above.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': 'Financial Assistance of ₹2,000/- per month. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE: '}, {'text': 'The allowance is sent through ECS to their accounts directly from the Treasury.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1: '}, {'text': 'The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Differently Abled Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:'}, {'text': ' In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3:'}, {'text': ' Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 4:'}, {'text': ' Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Differently Abled Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.\n**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).\n**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.\n**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons

SHORT TITLE:
MATNPMVIP

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Tamil Nadu

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Financial Assistance, Marriage, Differently-abled Person, Visually

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide marriage assistance to a normal person marrying a visually Impaired Person.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'In recognition of the distinct considerations inherent in marriages where one partner is visually impaired, the "Marriage Assistance Scheme for Individuals Marrying Visually Impaired Persons" provides targeted financial assistance. This program aims to mitigate potential economic burdens associated with visual impairment, such as the requirement for specialized equipment or additional support services. This intervention not only fosters a more inclusive social environment but also empowers couples to embark on their marital journey with greater financial stability, thus solidifying the foundation for a prosperous and fulfilling union. Furthermore, the program serves as a testament to societal acceptance of diverse family structures, celebrating the richness that such diversity brings to the community. By alleviating potential financial barriers, the scheme encourages the formation of strong and enduring relationships between individuals, irrespective of their visual abilities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'A normal person should marry a speech and visually impaired person.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The age of the couple (both) should be above 18 years. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Additional Eligibility:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The normal person and visually impaired person individuals holding a degree or diploma are eligible to receive increased assistance. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Marriage assistance amount: ₹25,000/- as'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': ' ₹12,500/- National Savings Certificate.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' ₹12,500/- cheque/Demand Draft for marriage expenses.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Additional benefit if either spouse has a degree/diploma: Increased amount to ₹50,000/-'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': ' ₹25,000/- National Savings Certificate.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' ₹25,000/- cheque/Demand Draft.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Other Benefits:'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Certificate of appreciation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': '8 gram gold coin for Tirumangalyam (a traditional South Indian symbol of marriage for women).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1: '}, {'text': 'The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Differently Abled Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2:'}, {'text': ' In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3:'}, {'text': ' Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 4:'}, {'text': ' Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Differently Abled Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.\n**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).\n**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.\n**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme (GBOCWWB)

GGTWS(GBOCWWB)

Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State
