Gujarat

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Building Worker, Construction Worker, Labour, Subsidy, Three Wheelers, E-rickshaw, Tricycle, Person With Disability, PwD

DESCRIPTION:
Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of battery-operated tricycle (e-rickshaw) vehicles to registered construction disabled workers. Also, assistance will be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time of the new Three-Wheeler.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme” is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB), Labour, Skill Development & Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of battery-operated tricycle (e-rickshaw) vehicles to registered construction disabled workers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If a registered construction worker becomes disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction site, the income of the construction worker ceases. So the construction worker is permanently financially unable to support the family. In such a situation, the use of three-wheelers is intended to help the construction workers as a source of income so that they can find other employment and support their families.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The construction workers should be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The registered construction workers who become disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction site will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should have purchased a lithium-ion battery-operated vehicle in his own name.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should hold a tri-cycle license to operate a tri-cycle.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The benefit of this scheme will be available once per registered construction disabled worker.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period (PBAOCWWB)

SHORT TITLE:
RUNCPP-PBAOCWWB

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Puducherry

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Pandemic, Calamity, Disaster, Financial Assistance, Relief

DESCRIPTION:
The Board provides financial assistance of ₹ 2,000/- to the registered worker as a relief during a natural calamity/pandemic. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The "Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of ₹ 2,000/- to the registered worker as a relief during a natural calamity/pandemic. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a citizen of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': '₹ 2,000/- credited as Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1: '}, {'text': 'The interested construction worker should visit the Office of the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (Industrial Estate, Thattanchavady, Puducherry - 605 009) and obtain the prescribed format of the application form free of cost from the concerned authority exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2: '}, {'text': 'In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3: '}, {'text': 'The interested construction worker should submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the concerned authority.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 4: '}, {'text': 'Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application form has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** The interested construction worker should visit the Office of the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (Industrial Estate, Thattanchavady, Puducherry - 605 009) and obtain the prescribed format of the application form free of cost from the concerned authority exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.\n**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).\n**Step 3:** The interested construction worker should submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the concerned authority.\n**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application form has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).\n'}

DESCRIPTION:

text:
SCHEME NAME:
The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
ANIDAS

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Disability, PwD, Financial Assistance, Persons With Disability, Unemployed, Allowance

DESCRIPTION:
The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Persons who are permanent residents of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for more than 10 years at the time of making the application. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A person of age 01 month or more and having 40% & above disability is eligible under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'There is no income ceiling to avail this allowance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant is neither in receipt of any other financial assistance/allowances nor employed anywhere.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Cancellation of Assistance:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The sanctioning authority i.e. Director (Social Welfare) shall have the right cancel to the sanction of assistance at any stage if it is found that it was sanctioned on a mistaken ground or false information tendered or the conditions under which the assistance was granted no longer exist.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The assistance shall be stopped if the beneficiary gets employment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The quantum of Disability Allowance shall be ₹2500/- per month subject to eligibility.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The financial assistance sanction shall be payable to a disabled person till his/her death subject to the conditions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Disability allowance shall become payable from the month following the one in which it is sanctioned. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' Assistance shall be stopped on the death of the disabled person, if the disabled person dies, before receiving assistance for a particular period, the same shall lapse.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Mode of Payment:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Payment of allowance shall be made through Bank Account on a monthly basis.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Application Process:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' The application form shall be available free of cost at the Directorate of Social Welfare, Port Blair, and the sub-divisional offices of CDPOs. The '}, {'children': [{'text': 'application form'}], 'link': 'http://andssw1.and.nic.in/socialwelfare/pdf/allowances_form.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' can also be downloaded from the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'official website'}], 'link': 'http://andssw1.and.nic.in/socialwelfare/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' Application for "Financial Assistance" shall be submitted in the prescribed format in the offices of the concerned Child Development Project Officers located at Port Blair, Ferrargunj, Rangat, Diglipur, and Car Nicobar.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Verification:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Application for sanction of allowance under the scheme shall be verified by the Mukhya Sevikas with a counter signature or the CDPO concerned and forwarded to the Director (Social Welfare) for sanction.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Change of Address/Employment Status:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'It shall be obligatory for the person receiving assistance to inform about the change of address/employment status, if any, to the Director of Social Welfare within days of such change.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '> **Application Process:**\n\n**Step 01:** The application form shall be available free of cost at the Directorate of Social Welfare, Port Blair, and the sub-divisional offices of CDPOs. The [application form](http://andssw1.and.nic.in/socialwelfare/pdf/allowances_form.pdf) can also be downloaded from the [official website](http://andssw1.and.nic.in/socialwelfare/). \n**Step 02:** Application for &quot;Financial Assistance&quot; shall be submitted in the prescribed format in the offices of the concerned Child Development Project Officers located at Port Blair, Ferrargunj, Rangat, Diglipur, and Car Nicobar.\n> **Verification:**\n\nThe Application for sanction of allowance under the scheme shall be verified by the Mukhya Sevikas with a counter signature or the CDPO concerned and forwarded to the Director (Social Welfare) for sanction.\n> Change of Address/Employment Status:\n\nIt shall be obligatory for the person receiving assistance to inform about the change of address/employment status, if any, to the Director of Social Welfare within days of such change.\n'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Tirth Barat Yojana

SHORT TITLE:
TBY

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment, Travel & Tourism

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Chhattisgarh

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Tirth Yatra, Senior Citizen, PwD, Pilgrim, BPL, Pilgrimage

DESCRIPTION:
The objective of this scheme is to provide government assistance for pilgrimage to the senior citizens & Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), who are residents of Chhattisgarh, to visit one or more of the various designated pilgrimage sites outside the state, once in their lifetime.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Tirth Barat Yojana" was launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh on 4th December 2012. The objective of this scheme is to provide government assistance for pilgrimage to the senior citizens (60 years & above) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), who are residents of Chhattisgarh, to visit one or more of the various designated pilgrimage sites outside the state, once in their lifetime.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, 80% of the beneficiaries will be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category, including cardholders of the Antyodaya and Chief Minister Food Grain Schemes. The remaining 20% will be senior citizens and disabled individuals above the poverty line who are not income taxpayers.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Of the total beneficiaries, 25% will be from urban areas, while 75% will be from rural areas.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be either a senior citizen or a person with disabilities (including visual impairment, deaf-mute, hearing impairment, or locomotor disabilities).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Senior citizens should be 60 years of age or older.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Persons with disabilities must be 18 years of age or older.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have previously traveled under this scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be physically and mentally able to travel.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be suffering from any infectious diseases, such as tuberculosis, congestive cardiac or respiratory obstruction-related diseases, coronary insufficiency, coronary thrombosis, mental illness, leprosy, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Groups of Pilgrims:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The journey will be conducted only in groups. The above groups will be determined by the government or the authority/agency authorized by the government. The journey to any pilgrimage place will be started only when the minimum number of passengers determined by the government is available. Mere selection under the scheme will not oblige the government to arrange a journey for any person.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Restrictions on other persons traveling:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Only the person selected to travel under this scheme is permitted to go on the journey. They should not bring any additional person with them, even if that person is willing to cover the journey expenses. Only the selected individuals are allowed to travel in trains and vehicles, and each seat/berth will be occupied by only one person.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Regarding additional expenses:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'If anyone, during the journey, wants to avail of facilities in addition to the norms/facilities prescribed by the government, then he/she will have to pay for the same himself/herself.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Expectations from the pilgrims during the trip:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Pilgrims will not be able to carry any inflammable substance or intoxicating substance in any form.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Pilgrims will not be able to take jewelry etc. with them.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The pilgrims will behave as per the dignity of the pilgrimage so that the image of the state is not otherwise affected.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Pilgrims will follow the instructions of their designated contact officer.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The concerned beneficiaries will submit their application forms in the prescribed format to Gram Panchayat/District Panchayat/Deputy Director, Panchayat and Social Welfare of their respective District. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 1:'}, {'text': ' The selection of beneficiaries from the received applications will be done through a lottery system conducted by the Collector.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 2: '}, {'text': "If the name of any of the disabled applicant's spouse is selected, then his/her life partner will also be able to go on the journey, at the time of applying, the applicant will have to attach the application of the life partner along with the applicant's application."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 3:'}, {'text': ' Five or more disabled people will also be able to apply as a group. The entire group will be considered as one application and will be included in the lottery. It will be mandatory for every disabled pilgrim to be accompanied by an assistant on the pilgrimage. The assistant should be close to the disabled person or someone of his choice.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 4:'}, {'text': ' A person above 65 years of age, who has applied to travel alone, will be eligible to take one assistant with him on the journey. On application by a group of persons, a group of 3 to 5 persons will be eligible to take 1 assistant along with the said group, provided that every person in this group is above 65 years of age. In large groups, assistants will be recognized at the rate of 1 per 05 passengers. There will be no facility to take an assistant if the spouse is traveling together, provided one of them is below 65 years of age. This will not be applicable in the case of persons with disabilities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 5:'}, {'text': " If the name of any of the applicant's spouse is selected, his/her life partner will also be able to accompany him on the journey. Even if the age of the applicant's life partner is less than 60 years, he/she will be able to travel with the applicant. While applying, the applicant will have to mention that his/her life partner is also willing to travel with him/her. In such a situation, the application of the said life partner will also have to be attached with the applicant's application. If there is eligibility to take an assistant along with him on the journey, then the application of that assistant will also be submitted along with the applicant. This will not be applicable in case of persons with disabilities."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 6:'}, {'text': ' If a group of individuals apply together, the entire group will be considered as one application and included in the lottery. The said group can be of a maximum of 25 applicants. One applicant of the group will be called the head of the group. Applications of all other applicants will be submitted attached with his/her application. If the persons included in the said group are eligible to take helpers, then the applications of the proposed helpers will also be attached with this application. The number of people included in the group, including assistants, will not exceed 25. It will be necessary to provide the mobile number of at least one of your nominees.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '\n  - The concerned beneficiaries will submit their application forms in the prescribed format to Gram Panchayat/District Panchayat/Deputy Director, Panchayat and Social Welfare of their respective District. \n\n**Note 1:** The selection of beneficiaries from the received applications will be done through a lottery system conducted by the Collector.\n**Note 2:** If the name of any of the disabled applicant&#39;s spouse is selected, then his/her life partner will also be able to go on the journey, at the time of applying, the applicant will have to attach the application of the life partner along with the applicant&#39;s application.\n**Note 3:** Five or more disabled people will also be able to apply as a group. The entire group will be considered as one application and will be included in the lottery. It will be mandatory for every disabled pilgrim to be accompanied by an assistant on the pilgrimage. The assistant should be close to the disabled person or someone of his choice.\n**Note 4:** A person above 65 years of age, who has applied to travel alone, will be eligible to take one assistant with him on the journey. On application by a group of persons, a group of 3 to 5 persons will be eligible to take 1 assistant along with the said group, provided that every person in this group is above 65 years of age. In large groups, assistants will be recognized at the rate of 1 per 05 passengers. There will be no facility to take an assistant if the spouse is traveling together, provided one of them is below 65 years of age. This will not be applicable in the case of persons with disabilities.\n**Note 5:** If the name of any of the applicant&#39;s spouse is selected, his/her life partner will also be able to accompany him on the journey. Even if the age of the applicant&#39;s life partner is less than 60 years, he/she will be able to travel with the applicant. While applying, the applicant will have to mention that his/her life partner is also willing to travel with him/her. In such a situation, the application of the said life partner will also have to be attached with the applicant&#39;s application. If there is eligibility to take an assistant along with him on the journey, then the application of that assistant will also be submitted along with the applicant. This will not be applicable in case of persons with disabilities.\n**Note 6:** If a group of individuals apply together, the entire group will be considered as one application and included in the lottery. The said group can be of a maximum of 25 applicants. One applicant of the group will be called the head of the group. Applications of all other applicants will be submitted attached with his/her application. If the persons included in the said group are eligible to take helpers, then the applications of the proposed helpers will also be attached with this application. The number of people included in the group, including assistants, will not exceed 25. This will not be applicable in case of persons with disabilities.\n**Note 7:** The envelope in which the application form is to be sent should be prescribed as “Application for a visit to the place under Mukhyamantri Teerth Yatra Yojana Year -----, the year in which the pilgrimage place is being applied for. That should be mentioned.\n**Note 8:** The applicant will also have to mention the names and other particulars of any two nominees with whom they can be contacted immediately in case of any emergency, in the prescribed space in the application form. It will be necessary to provide the mobile number of at least one of your nominees.\n'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Additional Pension to Widow of Ex-Serviceman having Children" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. This scheme covers Andhra Pradesh all 13 districts, to meet the funeral expenses of the deceased Brahmi. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (ABC), a Government of Andhra Pradesh undertaking, is announcing the "Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses" (GS- FE) for the poor Brahmins in Andhra Pradesh. Click on ‘Submit’.\n**Step 04:** Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process.\n**Login to Apply for the Scheme:**\n**Step 01:** Now, to avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official Portal -[Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) and login through the email ID that is used while registering.\n**Step 02:** Enter Password &amp; Captcha and click on ‘Login’.\n**Step 03:** After successful login, click on ‘Apply for Services’ and then ‘View all Available Services’\n**Step 04:** Now, search for the ‘Sewing Machine Scheme - Haryana Labour Welfare Board’ and click on the scheme to proceed to fill out the application form.\n**Step 05:** Enter Parivar Pehchan Patra number - Family ID and Click on “Click here to Fetch Family Data” which displays the family members registered under the given Family ID.\n**Step 06:** Select the beneficiary/applicant name and enter the OTP that is being sent to the selected family member for verification. Click on “Click to Verify”\n**Step 07:** Fill in all the mandatory details and upload all the mandatory documents.\n**Step 08:** Preview the application form and click on ‘Submit’.\n'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants - Centre for Aromatic Plants SHORT TITLE: GSCAP CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Aromatic, Farmer, Aromatic Plants, Cultivation, Grant DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage farmers to adopt the cultivation of commercially valuable aromatic crops such as lemongrass, citronella, palmarosa, khus, damask rose, mint (except Japanese mint), geranium, black cumin, rosemary, bay leaf, timur & sandalwood by providing financial assistance to them. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants” scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the cultivation and expansion of aromatic plant species across the state by providing financial assistance to farmers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a farmer.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The nine selected species eligible for the grant must have been cultivated by the farmer at their own expense.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, the maximum grant limit for any individual farmer shall be ₹1.00 lakh or the grant amount admissible for the cultivation of up to 2 hectares of land (based on the survival rate of plants), whichever is less. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The grant is provided for the cultivation of nine selected aromatic crops, namely aromatic grasses (lemongrass, citronella, palmarosa, khus, etc.), damask rose, mint (except Japanese mint), geranium, black cumin, rosemary, bay leaf, timur, and sandalwood, undertaken by the farmer at his or her own expense.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To apply for under the grant scheme, a farmer must submit an application addressed to the Director, Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, either by post or in person at the CAP headquarters. The application should be accompanied by land records, Aadhaar card, and mobile number.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After receiving the application, CAP field personnel will conduct a field inspection of the applicant’s land. Based on the region’s agro-climatic conditions, they will recommend suitable aromatic crops from the nine species selected under the scheme and submit their report to the Director, CAP.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Upon approval, the farmer will begin cultivation of the recommended crops at their own expense. It is mandatory for the farmer to register with the CAP office within three months of starting aromatic cultivation. Within six months of receiving the registration form or registration number, the farmer must apply to the CAP office for the first installment of the subsidy in the prescribed format, along with bank account details. The application format can be downloaded from the CAP website ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'www.capuk.in'}], 'link': 'https://www.capuk.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ').'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After receiving the application, a committee headed by the District Coordinator will conduct another field inspection in the presence of the farmer and recommend the grant based on the actual cultivated area. The Grant Approval Committee at the Director level will then scrutinize and approve the grant applications.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Finally, 75% of the approved amount will be transferred directly to the farmer’s bank account by CAP as the first installment, and the remaining 25% will be released in the third year of aromatic cultivation, subject to plant survival verification. The application for the remaining 25% grant must be submitted following the same procedure as above.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'To apply for under the grant scheme, a farmer must submit an application addressed to the Director, Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, either by post or in person at the CAP headquarters. The application should be accompanied by land records, Aadhaar card, and mobile number.\nAfter receiving the application, CAP field personnel will conduct a field inspection of the applicant’s land. Based on the region’s agro-climatic conditions, they will recommend suitable aromatic crops from the nine species selected under the scheme and submit their report to the Director, CAP.\nUpon approval, the farmer will begin cultivation of the recommended crops at their own expense. It is mandatory for the farmer to register with the CAP office within three months of starting aromatic cultivation. Within six months of receiving the registration form or registration number, the farmer must apply to the CAP office for the first installment of the subsidy in the prescribed format, along with bank account details. The application format can be downloaded from the CAP website ([www.capuk.in](https://www.capuk.in/)).\nAfter receiving the application, a committee headed by the District Coordinator will conduct another field inspection in the presence of the farmer and recommend the grant based on the actual cultivated area. The Grant Approval Committee at the Director level will then scrutinize and approve the grant applications.\nFinally, 75% of the approved amount will be transferred directly to the farmer’s bank account by CAP as the first installment, and the remaining 25% will be released in the third year of aromatic cultivation, subject to plant survival verification. The application for the remaining 25% grant must be submitted following the same procedure as above.\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 231)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf'} SLUG: gscap

schemeName: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
text:
SCHEME NAME: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana SHORT TITLE: MMGKY CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Silage, Animal Feed, Fodder, Livestock Farmer, Cattle Rearer DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmers, especially women, in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, silage is made available to livestock farmers at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana” was introduced by the Cooperative Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmers, especially women, in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be residing in a hilly area of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a woman engaged in livestock farming.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme is applicable only in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Packed silage and complete mixed animal feed are prepared by blending nutrients with green maize and are made available to cattle rearers in the remote rural and hilly areas of Uttarakhand at the rate of ₹2.75 per kg. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Under the scheme, a 75% subsidy is provided on the selling price of silage, which is ₹9.00 per kg, and the State Government also provides financial assistance of ₹3.00 per kg towards expenses such as loading, transportation, and handling. As a result, silage is made available to beneficiaries at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 2, "label": "In Kind", "value": "in-kind"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Livestock owners or women beneficiaries can request silage directly from the secretary of the concerned cooperative society by submitting a written application. text:
SCHEME NAME: Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme SHORT TITLE: MSKS CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Farmer, Youth, Dairy, Subsidy, Cattle DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy Unit, to promote self employment in the Dairy Sector. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy Unit, to promote self employment in the Dairy Sector, and to boost the milk production in the State and to make the State self sufficient. The scheme provides subsidy on the cost of the animal, where the unit cost is limited to ₹70,000/- per animal, which is expected to yield 2,700 liters of milk per lactation for the purpose of subsidy release. Beneficiaries can purchase cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes, and indigenous breed cows (Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi, and Tharparkar) in one or more phases. The applications for this scheme are accepted through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer in a prescribed application form, along with a non-refundable processing fee.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, insure the animals for Transit Insurance. SCHEME NAME: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil) Gujarat SHORT TITLE: DSMPHSFCCLOMUK CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Gujarat MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Adivasi Farmers, Crop Production, Livelihood, Castor Cake, Fertilizer, Subsidies DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to help tribal farmers improve their livelihood by increasing agricultural crop production. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided on high-yield and hybrid seeds, fertilizers, and other agricultural inputs to Scheduled Tribe farmers. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" is introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to help Adivasi farmers in Tribal Areas (TASP) and tribal cultivators outside these areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided on various agricultural inputs such as high-yield variety seeds, hybrid seeds, and fertilizers. Farmers are also provided with plant protection equipment, tarpaulins, field demonstrations, micronutrients, water carrying pipelines, and pump sets to increase their crop yield and improve their livelihoods. schemeName: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists

SHORT TITLE:
SPEBJ

CATEGORY:
Transport & Infrastructure, Agriculture,Rural & Environment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Goa

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Subsidy, Transport, Journalist, Environment, Pollution, Road

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for purchasing e-bikes at a subsidised rate. The benefits include making it more convenient for journalists to gather and disseminate news, with the intended beneficiaries being eligible Goa-based journalists.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists” by the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa, aims to provide journalists based in Goa with e-bikes at a subsidised rate, facilitating easier access to essential technology for their profession. This initiative acknowledges the crucial role of journalists in educating the public and the time they spend gathering news. Two significant benefits of the scheme are providing financial assistance for purchasing e-bikes and empowering journalists with better means to disseminate information vital for a democratic system. Two significant eligibility criteria include being a resident of Goa for at least 15 years and being a full-time working journalist for at least eight years. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Information and Publicity. Every year, the Government will grant subsidies to purchase 65 e-bikes to 65 beneficiaries based on their years of working.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a journalist.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The sole livelihood of the applicant should be through journalistic activities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be residing in Goa for at least 15 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be working for a Media organisation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be more than 58 years of age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have availed benefit to purchase an e-bike (two-wheeler) under any other Government scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Subsidy up to 50% of the value on quotation or ₹ 50,000/-, whichever is less, and the remaining 50% value shall be borne by the beneficiaries. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The payment shall be effected directly to the beneficiaries upon receipt of the purchase of the e-bike document. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The subsidy shall be disbursed in a single instalment to the beneficiary, i.e., 100% on the purchase of the vehicle and production of purchase documents, i.e., the Registration Certificate book and insurance by the Beneficiary.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Disbursement of subsidy for the purchase of e-bikes will be done on a first-come-first-served basis or a maximum of two for each organisation per meeting, also considering eligibility criteria.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and enclose the copies of all the mandatory documents (endorsed, if required).\n**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director, Department of Information and Publicity, Udyog Bhavan, 3rd floor, Panaji.\n> **Post-Application Processes**\n\n**Step 1:** After approval of the application, the Beneficiary will have to provide purchased documents (Registration Certificate book and insurance) along with bank details to release the subsidy directly to the beneficiary.\n**Step 2:** The Screening Committee, constituted under the Chairmanship of the Director of Information and Publicity, will scrutinize/sanction applications and may ask for additional documents if required.\n**Step 3:** The subsidy will be disbursed in a single instalment upon purchase of the vehicle and production of the necessary documents.\n'}

{'children': [{'text': 'Beneficiaries who have availed the benefit from any other such Government schemes shall not be entitled to this scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

TAGS:

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yojana” is a State Owned Priority Development (SOPD) scheme for farmers launched by the Assam government in FY 2018-19.  The main purpose of launching this scheme for farmers is their holistic development by implementing several farm mechanization schemes.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Agriculture occupies the primary position in the economy of the state of Assam. Over 70% of the state’s population relies on agriculture as farmers, as agricultural labourers, or both for their livelihood. Although agriculture in Assam is characterized by stagnation, low productivity and frequent occurrence of floods, and low levels of public and private investment. The small and fragmented land holdings and frequent floods in the state are a causative factor for farmers to have lower income and agricultural activities become non-remunerative in the State. To boost agricultural productivity, it is pertinent to make interventions through financial assistance to poor farmers. Hence, the finance minister of Assam had announced to assist the farmers to promote the use of scientific farm implements. To encourage the farmer to procure and use such implements, the Department of Agriculture proposed a scheme “Mukhya Mantri Sa Sajuli Yojana” (Chief Minister Farm Tool Scheme) for the purpose and launched in FY 2018-19. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yojana” is a State Owned Priority Development (SOPD) scheme and the main purpose of launching this scheme for farmers is their holistic development by implementing several farm mechanization schemes. With the help of “Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yojana” the government aims to increase farm productivity in the limited land to meet the expanding demand for farm produce and ensure higher income for farmers. As of now, the usage of scientific tools in cultivation is very limited in the state of Assam. So, the state govt. of Assam is making every possible effort through Chief Minister Farm Tool Scheme to ensure the economic growth of rural farmers. Under this scheme, the following is proposed:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\t₹ 5000/- will be provided to each farmer'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe number of beneficiaries will be a total of 5 lakh farmers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tThe assistance is to procure farm tools/farm implements.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tScheme will be implemented on Direct Benefit Transfer by electronic transfer into the accounts of the beneficiaries.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5.\tThe Selection of beneficiaries will be done by the District Level Committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner of the District. Individual

TAGS:
Goat Farming Scheme, Animal Husbandry, Financial Assistance, Rural Development

DESCRIPTION:
The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna" with the aim to increase income generation opportunities for economically weaker segments of the society as well as to increase meat production.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "'}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna'}, {'text': '" with the aim to increase income generation opportunities for economically weaker segments of the society as well as to increase meat production. Goat farming is a traditional occupation of economically weaker segments of the society (small and marginal farmers, mainly nomads and landless laborer\'s) in Himachal Pradesh. This species is considered to be major source of economic sustenance for these categories of people. Adaptability of goats to wide range of agro climatic conditions has rendered it suitable for poor farmers. Under this scheme it has been proposed to distribute units of 11 goats (10 females +1male), 5 goats (4 females +1 male) and 3 goats (2 females +1 male) of Beetal/Sirohi/Jamanapari/White Himalayan breeds on 60% subsidy.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives of this scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Increase Income Generation:'}, {'text': ' The scheme aims to enhance income generation opportunities for economically weaker sections through goat farming.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Boost Meat Production:'}, {'text': ' By providing high-quality goat breeds, the scheme aims to increase meat production in the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Support Economically Disadvantaged Families:'}, {'text': ' The scheme offers a 60% subsidy on goat units, making it easier for financially weaker families to start goat farming.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Promote Rural Development:'}, {'text': ' Encouraging goat farming contributes to the overall development of rural areas in Himachal Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Ensure Sustainable Livelihoods:'}, {'text': ' The scheme provides a sustainable livelihood to small farmers and landless laborers, reducing their economic vulnerability.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

Concerned Senior Veterinary Officer will provide training to interested persons/applicants.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Training/awareness in skills of goat husbandry is mandatory for all applicants. The Scheme is intended to generate equitable entrepreneurial opportunities in rural as well as urban areas of the State, particularly among the educated unemployed youth to become self employed by setting up Manufacturing/Service/Business/Cooperative/Agriculture & allied activities by availing loan (category wise) with back ended subsidy assistance from the State Government @ 50% for BPL and @ 35% for rest on financially viable/ bankable Projects cost. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2. SCHEME NAME:
Kisan Credit Card

SHORT TITLE:
KCC

CATEGORY:
Agriculture,Rural & Environment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Kisan, Credit Card, Farmer, Farming, Banking

DESCRIPTION:
The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998 for issue of Kisan Credit Cards to farmers on the basis of their holdings for uniform adoption by the banks so that farmers may use them to readily purchase agriculture inputs and draw cash for their production needs. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'The KCC Scheme was introduced with the objective of providing adequate and timely credit to the farmers for their agricultural operations. The Government of India provides interest subvention of 2% and Prompt Repayment Incentive of 3% to the farmers, thus making the credit available at a very subsidized rate of 4% per annum. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'The scheme was further extended for the investment credit requirement of farmers viz. allied and non-farm activities in the year 2004 and further revisited in 2012 by a working Group under the Chairmanship of Shri T. M. Bhasin, CMD, Indian Bank with a view to simplify the scheme and facilitate issue of Electronic Kisan Credit Cards. The scheme provides broad guidelines to banks for operationalizing the KCC scheme. Implementing banks will have the discretion to adopt the same to suit institution/location-specific requirements.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective / Purpose'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'The Kisan Credit Card scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit support from the banking system under a single window with the flexible and simplified procedures to the farmers for their cultivation and other needs as indicated below :'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'align': 'justify', 'children': [{'text': 'To meet the short term credit requirements for the cultivation of crops;'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'align': DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'SHC can be downloaded by the farmers from the SHC portal or through SMS link received on mobile. Based on this, the SHC will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': SCHEME NAME:
Promotion of Intensive Aquaculture through Introduction of Bio-floc Technology

SHORT TITLE:
PIAIBFT

CATEGORY:
Agriculture,Rural & Environment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Odisha

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Bio-floc Technology, DBT, Intensive Aquaculture, Fish & Shrimp Farming, Back-ended Subsidy

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to promote sustainable intensification of the freshwater fish and brackish water shrimp farming for boosting productivity and generating high income in a limited area & subsidy assistance is provided to farmers, hatchery operators, private entrepreneurs, and unemployed youth.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Promotion of Intensive Aquaculture through Introduction of Bio-floc Technology" was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development Department, Government of Odisha. It aims to promote sustainable intensification of the freshwater fish and brackish water shrimp farming for boosting productivity and generating high income in a limited area. Through this scheme, subsidy assistance at 40% of the unit cost for the General Category and at 60% of the Unit Cost for the SC / ST / Women Category is provided to farmers interested in taking up grow-out tanks, nursery and seed tanks; fish and shrimp hatchery operators; private entrepreneurs; and unemployed youth. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Fisheries through District Fisheries Officers and the field functionaries under the supervision of the Zonal Deputy Director of Fisheries. The total outlay under the said programme is Rs.2525.00 lakh. During the current year, 5000 nos. of Bio-floc tanks will be developed under this programme with subsidy support under the state plan. Subsidy amount shall be released to Aadhaar linked Bank Account of the beneficiary in two phases. The beneficiary shall construct the Bio-floc unit as per the minimum design and specification shown in the tables in the guideline pdf.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To promote high-yielding intensive fish farming in a small area using Bio-floc technology.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To encourage farmers, entrepreneurs, and unemployed youth into income generation through the small-scale Bio-floc farming system.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the state of Odisha.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant shall be a farmer interested in taking up grow-out tanks, nursery, and seed tanks. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant shall be a fish and shrimp hatchery operator. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant shall be a private entrepreneur.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant shall be an unemployed educated youth. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The eligible brackish water shrimp farms/nurseries and seed tanks/hatchery beneficiaries must have a license from the Coastal Aquaculture Authority. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The assistance under the special package shall be available to the above categories of beneficiaries with a minimum of 2 tanks and a maximum of 6 tanks. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If a beneficiary has availed a subsidy earlier for the installation of a Bio-floc unit under different schemes of the Government of India and State Government, for less than 6 nos. of tanks, he/she shall also be eligible to avail further subsidy under this scheme. However, in such cases, the subsidy shall be limited to a maximum of 6 tanks, which will include the installation of tanks earlier. BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Subsidy Assistance'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Subsidy assistance is provided at 40% of the unit cost for the General Category and at 60% of the Unit Cost for the Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) / Women Category. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
MARVS

CATEGORY:
Agriculture,Rural & Environment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Meghalaya

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Agriculture, Response Vehicle, Farmer, Financial Aid, Farmers Associations, Entrepreneur

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to provide Small Commercial Vehicles and pickups at each CD Block across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid from the Government of Meghalaya.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya, aims to provide 50% financial aid to buy commercial vehicles by 200 selected beneficiaries for agriculture transport. These vehicles will help the community involved in agriculture and allied sectors to transport their agricultural products and raw materials. The scheme also focuses on the economic upliftment of farmers by providing them with transportation at a competitive cost.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To increase the profitability of farmers by providing access to the market by supporting them with a mobility solution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To provide a mobility solution to various registered farmer’s associations which will increase aggregation and their market reach.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To lower the transportation cost for farmers by introducing agriculture response vehicles for farmers at each CD Block of the State.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To encourage individual entrepreneurship among the rural community by supporting them to buy commercial vehicles thereby creating livelihood opportunities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Individual applicants:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Individuals who are permanent residents of Meghalaya and are above 18 years and below 58 years of age are eligible for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must have a valid commercial driving license before buying the vehicle from the dealer.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must provide valid government ID proof with an address such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, and Passport, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be a defaulter at any financial institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Any registered farmer’s association:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Any association of farmers involved with agricultural products and legally registered with the government of Meghalaya such as Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Companies (FPC), Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO), etc. are eligible to apply for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The association of farmers must provide an Incorporation Certificate or a registration certificate whichever is applicable.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Association of farmers should not be a defaulter at any financial institution. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'The following benefits are provided under the scheme:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '200 agriculture transport vehicles to be distributed across Meghalaya for individual entrepreneurs and any registered farmer’s organizations with 50% financial aid.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Vehicles will be pre-fitted with GPS devices.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Farmers will have access to more vehicles dedicated to agriculture transportation services.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Project Management Unit will help in the connection between the farmers and agriculture response vehicles when demand arises.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Financing Plan:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Financing of the vehicles to the selected beneficiaries of the scheme shall be done through any branch of Meghalaya Rural Bank (MRB).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The bank will sanction 50% of the on-road vehicle cost of the beneficiary in the form of a term loan.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Rate of interest and repayment schedule:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Prevailing rate of interest shall be charged by the bank and the repayment schedule will be 5 years. MRB will keep the rate of interest as fixed for the complete loan term.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Quantum and Nature of Financial Assistance:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'a) Down payment Support:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1. Total down payment will be 50% of the on-road cost of the vehicle.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Out of which, the Agriculture Department, Government of Meghalaya shall pay 90%.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'And the remaining 10% shall be paid by the beneficiary.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'b) EMI support:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2. To reduce the burden of the operational cost on the beneficiaries in the first two years of his business, the Agriculture Department, GoM will support the beneficiary by paying:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '85% of the EMI in the first 6 months'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': '45% of the EMI for 7-12 months'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': '35% of the EMI for 13-24 months.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': '3. For the rest of the EMIs after 24 months, the beneficiary shall bear 100% of the EMI/month.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4. Overall, EMI support from the government is 20% of the total EMI to be paid.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5. The maximum support from the government shall be based on the value of the selected models mentioned above.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'If the beneficiary selects a model which has a lower value than the selected model, support shall be 50% of the value of that model.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If the beneficiary selects a model which has a higher value than the selected model, the beneficiary shall bear the extra cost associated with it.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': '6. The vehicle shall be fitted with a GPS tracking device which will be included in the on-road price of the vehicle.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:

text:
SCHEME NAME: National Gopal Ratna Award SHORT TITLE: NGRA CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Dairy Farmer, Milk, Award, AI Technicians, Dairy Organizations, Monetary Incentive DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to promote scientific dairy practices and AI coverage. It provides awards, recognition, and monetary incentives to farmers, dairy organizations, and AI technicians. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “National Gopal Ratna Award” has been launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Government of India. aims to motivate farmers to enhance the productivity of indigenous milch animal breeds scientifically, encourage Artificial Insemination (AI) Technicians for 100% AI coverage under Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM), and promote growth and competitiveness among dairy cooperatives and milk producer companies. Through this scheme, awards including certificates of merit, mementoes, and monetary prizes are provided to dairy farmers, dairy organisations, and AI technicians. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD). A total of 12 awards are given annually across 3 categories. The applications are screened, verified, and shortlisted through agencies like the Quality Council of India (QCI) and the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB). Final selection is carried out by designated committees constituted by DAHD. The awardees are announced on 25th November and awarded on National Milk Day (26th November).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:', 'underline': True}], 'type': text:
SCHEME NAME: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing by Women - Gujarat SHORT TITLE: PFSPFSRWGUJ CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Women and Child LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Gujarat MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Fish, Fish Activities, Fish Production, Scheduled Tribes, Fisherman, Self-Employment DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to increase fish production through inland fisheries and provide employment opportunities, particularly to Scheduled Tribe women engaged in fish seed rearing. text:

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Scheme for Fencing in Gardens” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme provides financial support for fencing gardens to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals, offering a subsidy of 50% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹1.00 lakh per hectare.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Applications for garden fencing must be submitted to the officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. Currently, the application process is offline.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If a farmer faces difficulty in filling out the application, personnel at the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. Once submitted, the application is forwarded by the Centre to the district level, which then sends it to the Directorate. Upon approval of the farmer’s proposal by the Directorate, a government order is issued, authorizing the district to grant approval/work orders accordingly.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Upon acceptance, the district officer sends the farmer an approval letter and informs them via phone. The fencing is then carried out in the presence of departmental officials, followed by an on-site inspection. The application should include land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Udhyan card, bank account details, and mobile number. Currently, the application process is offline.\n - If a farmer faces difficulty in filling out the application, personnel at the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. Once submitted, the application is forwarded by the Centre to the district level, which then sends it to the Directorate. Upon approval of the farmer’s proposal by the Directorate, a government order is issued, authorizing the district to grant approval/work orders accordingly.\n - Upon acceptance, the district officer sends the farmer an approval letter and informs them via phone. The fencing is then carried out in the presence of departmental officials, followed by an on-site inspection. After verification, the subsidy is disbursed directly into the farmer’s account.\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 220)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf'} SLUG: sfguk

schemeName: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme SHORT TITLE: SSRPPES CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Sugarcane, Sugar, Sugarcane Seed, Farmer, Sugarcane Seed Replacement DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity & improve sugar recovery by promoting cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, & newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, & access to advanced agricultural technology. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar Industry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity and improve sugar recovery by promoting the cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, and newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, and access to advanced agricultural technology.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Sugarcane Seed Modification and Varietal Balance:'}, {'text': ' A plan has been prepared to replace sugarcane varieties that have been cultivated for a long time and are currently grown (such as Ko.Sha.-767, Ko.-1148, Ko.Sha.-97264, Ko.Sha.-94257, and Ko.Sha.-8436, etc.) with better quality, high-yielding, and certified varieties. Newly developed quality sugarcane varieties include Ko.Pant. 12221, Ko.Sha. 8272, Ko. 0118, Ko.P.K. 5191, Ko. 15023, Ko.P.B. 91, Ko.P.B. 92, Ko.P.B. 96, Ko.P.B. 98, Ko. 13035, Ko.LKH. 9709, Ko.LKH. 12207, Ko.LKH. 14201, Ko.Sha. 13235, Ko.LKH. 15201, and Ko.LKH. 16202, etc. For low-lying areas, these high-yielding varieties should be cultivated in sufficient quantities to increase the success rate of sugarcane cultivation and enhance sugar recovery in mills. Sugarcane seed from research centers attracts a 20% premium over the government-declared sugarcane price. Farmers will be given an incentive for sugarcane seed purchased above the mill gate price. It is also proposed to provide farmers with a 100% subsidy on harvesting, loading, and transportation costs when sourcing sugarcane seed from research centers at the mill gate rate per quintal.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Subsidy on Base/Primary Nursery:'}, {'text': ' To encourage farmers, it is proposed to provide a subsidy of ₹50/- per quintal to base nursery holders and ₹25/- per quintal to primary nursery holders for the distribution of sugarcane seeds. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Latest Methods of Sugarcane Sowing'}, {'text': ': For sugarcane sowing, the latest trench method or row-spacing method should be adopted, under which the furrow-to-furrow distance should be 4 feet, the depth 1 foot, and the distance between two-eyed pieces should be 4–6 inches or 6–9 inches. To encourage farmers, it is proposed to provide a subsidy of ₹10,000/- for demonstration of 1 hectare of early variety, single-eye/two-eye planting, and mixed farming on farmers’ fields.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Weed Management System:'}, {'text': ' A 50% subsidy is proposed on herbicides for effective weed control in sugarcane crops. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Protection of Crops from Insects and Diseases:'}, {'text': ' A 50% subsidy is proposed on agricultural chemicals, including high-quality insecticides and pesticides, to protect sugarcane crops from insects and diseases. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Providing Information About Latest Technology to Farmers:'}, {'text': ' From time to time, technical information related to higher yield and improved sugarcane varieties will be provided to farmers. The Sugarcane Development Department and the Sugarcane Farmers Institute & Training Center, Kashipur, provide training to farmers, employees, and officials, and organize district-level farmers’ seminars.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Providing Access to Modern Agricultural Equipment to Farmers:'}, {'text': ' Farmers will be provided with modern agricultural equipment suitable for sugarcane cultivation, including battery-operated or petrol-powered sprayers, harrows, and cultivators. It is proposed to distribute drone sprayers and trench openers in the coming years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To select sugarcane farmers eligible for the benefits of this scheme, the selection is carried out after discussions with public representatives in the Gram Sabha (village assembly) meeting at the village level, followed by a survey conducted by the sugarcane supervisor, and subsequent approval by departmental officers (Sugarcane Development Inspector, Senior Sugarcane Development Inspector, and Assistant Sugarcane Commissioner).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'To select sugarcane farmers eligible for the benefits of this scheme, the selection is carried out after discussions with public representatives in the Gram Sabha (village assembly) meeting at the village level, followed by a survey conducted by the sugarcane supervisor, and subsequent approval by departmental officers (Sugarcane Development Inspector, Senior Sugarcane Development Inspector, and Assistant Sugarcane Commissioner).\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 254)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-30-01-2025-04-25-16.pdf'} SLUG: ssrppes
