An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login". Click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Use the registered email-id to log in. An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes

SHORT TITLE:
VCF-SC

CATEGORY:
Business & Entrepreneurship

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Entrepreneur, Finance, Capital, Investment, Technology, Startup

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste individuals by providing concessional finance. Benefits include investment ranging from ₹10,00,000/- to ₹15,00,00,000/- as debt or equity for eligible Private Limited or Public Limited companies.

Fill in all the mandatory fields and register. \n_*If required, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP._\n_*If you are prompted to create a password, ensure the password meets security requirements._\n##### ***Application***\n**Step 1:** Navigate to the [official link for online application](https://foa.vcfsc.in/#/signin). Use the credentials you created during registration to log in. Navigate to the online form of the scheme you intend to apply for.\n**Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Make any necessary corrections.\n**Step 3:** Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. You'll receive a confirmation message.\n_*The online application shall remain valid for a period of 6 months._\n<br>\n\n##### ***Post-Application Processes***\n**Step 1:****** ***Screening Committee Review (Preliminary Stage)***\nThe proposals shall be put up before the Screening Committee on a first-come, first-served basis for an initial analysis.\n**Step 2:****** ***Detailed Appraisal and Due Diligence***\nA site visit of the project site shall be carried out by officials or authorized representatives of IFCI Venture Capital Funds Limited.\n**Step 3:****** ***Investment Committee Review (Final Stage)***\n\n- The detailed proposal prepared by the Asset Management Company (AMC) shall be considered by the Investment Committee for final sanction.\n- The Investment Committee determines the quantum of assistance and may defer, reject, or sanction the proposal based on its merit.\n\n**Step 4:****** ***Issuance of Letter of Intent and Legal Documentation***\n\n- Following approval/sanction from the Investment Committee, a Letter of Intent (LOI) and term sheet, along with a legal checklist, shall be issued to the Company.\n- After the Company accepts the LOI and term sheet, the necessary legal documentations shall be prepared and executed by the Asset Management Company (AMC).\n\n**Step 5:****** ***Valuation and Title Search Initiation***\n\n- Post acceptance of the Letter of Intent (LOI) and term sheet, the assignment for a Valuer and Lawyer shall be initiated for conducting valuation and title search of the property(ies).\n- The fees for this first valuation and title search are borne by the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC).\n\n<br>\n\n##### ***Disbursement of Funds***\n\n- Disbursement shall be made as per the terms and conditions of the sanction, once the above process is complete.\n- The disbursement shall be made to the companies post execution of the complete legal documents at the office of IFCI Venture Capital Funds Limited situated in Delhi.\n- The disbursement is made in tranches and is subject to the successful completion of the sanctioned terms, pre-disbursement conditions, Valuation, and Title Search Report (TSR).\n\n<br>\n\n<br>\n\n'}

[{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '##### ***Step 1: Registration Under The Umbrella Scheme***\n\n- The applicant must first register under the Umbrella Scheme using the common application form appended to the scheme as [Schedule ‘E’](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/umbrella-amendment.pdf).- This form requires detailed unit information, including registration details such as the Permanent Registration Certificate, Entrepreneurs Memorandum–II, or Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum number and date.\n- It also requires details regarding the Cumulative Capital Investment and information about the proprietor or promoter, including their Aadhaar Number and whether they are claiming benefits under the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Woman category.\n\n##### ***Step 2: Filing Application For Target Schemes***\n\n- After registering under the Umbrella Scheme, the applicant must apply to the Director, Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), giving details as per the prescribed proforma for the specific Target Scheme.\n- The application must be filed according to the timeline mentioned in Schedule A for the respective target scheme.\n- The applications for each target scheme shall only be accepted and placed before the Task Force Committee during the specific time period as specified in Schedule A.\n\n##### ***Step 3: Scrutiny And Recommendation By The Task Force Committee***\n\n- The submitted application will be reviewed and scrutinized by the Task Force Committee (TFC), which is constituted under this Umbrella Scheme.\n- The Committee comprises several common members, including the Chief Executive Officer of the Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board as the Chairman, and the General Manager (DIC) of the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce as the Member Secretary.\n- The Task Force Committee is responsible for recommending the benefits to be granted under the target schemes.\n\n##### ***Step 4: Financial Sanction By Competent Authority***\n\n- The competent financial authority shall sanction or reject the benefits based on the recommendation of the Task Force Committee within one month of receiving such recommendation.\n- Financial sanctions of up to ₹10,00,000/- per disbursement per scheme shall be accorded by the Director of Industries, Trade and Commerce.\n- Financial sanction for amounts above ₹10,00,000/- up to ₹20,00,000/- per disbursement per scheme shall be accorded by the Secretary, Department of Industries, and benefits above ₹20,00,000/- per disbursement per scheme shall be approved by the Government.\n\n##### ***Step 5: Fund Disbursement To Beneficiary***\n\n- The payment shall be released to the beneficiary from the Savings Bank Account of a Nationalized or Commercial Bank maintained by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, subject to the availability of funds.\n- The funds shall be released within fifteen days of receiving the sanction order from the competent financial authority, provided the applicant submits the necessary documentation/details along with an affidavit cum self-declaration in the format appended to the respective target scheme.\n\n

text:
SCHEME NAME: Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017 SHORT TITLE: ESS-2017 CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Industry, Tourism, Enterprise, Employee, Subsidy, Employment, Investment DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to create an environment conducive for attracting investment in Goa, incentivise existing units, and boost local employment. It provides a subsidy based on the percentage of Goan employees hired, restricting reimbursement to ₹7,000/- per Goan employee per month. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The “Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create an environment conducive for attracting investment in the State of Goa and to incentivise existing units to be competitive while giving boost to local employment. The scheme provides a proportional subsidy based on the percentage of Goan manpower employed, ranging from 60% to 100%. The applicant must be a Micro, Small, Medium, or Large manufacturing industry, or a Hinterland Eco tourism project, and must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the application for at least one claim to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': text:
SCHEME NAME: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans SHORT TITLE: GSLWIS-STAIRPL CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Subsidy, Interest, Loan, Finance, Entrepreneur DESCRIPTION: The subsidy aims to support the logistics and warehousing sector by reimbursing 50% of the annual interest paid on construction loans. The benefit is capped at ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs) annually per project and is available for up to 05 consecutive years for eligible entities. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The “Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The “Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans” component of the scheme offers financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The component provides a reimbursement of 50% of the annual interest amount payable by the eligible entity on loans taken for the construction of projects. This subsidy is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), which also monitors effective implementation and ensures sanctioning is completed within 90 days from the date of application. Applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register/Signup".\n**Step 4:****** Login to the website using your Login Name and Password. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Login".\n**Step 5:****** In the top ribbon, click on "Services", then click on "[IT Services](https://goaonline.gov.in/AllServices?cat=IT)". Click on **"Incentives on Logistics and Warehousing Sector"**. You will be taken to the application form for the scheme. Fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents.\n**Step 6:****** Submit the application. A unique registration number will be generated. Note this number for future reference.\n
\n\n##### ***Post-Application Processes***\n**Step 1:** Upon receiving the application, the DITC should raise any queries to the applicant regarding shortfalls in the application form or submitted documents. After verification, the DITC designates an official to inspect the Entity, verify all records/documents, including verifying the list of structures created and civil works completed as per the Civil Engineer Certificate (Annexure X). The inspecting officers are required to upload the inspection reports to the portal within 48 hours.\n**Step 2:** The application and Inspection Report are subsequently marked to the Chief Executive Officer, Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board (Goa-IPB) for due diligence. Following the recommendation from the CEO (Goa-IPB), the DITC prepares an appraisal note to be placed before the Incentive Review Committee (IRC).\n**Step 3:** The DITC calls for the IRC meeting where the committee deliberates on the incentive application, scrutinizes the details, and sanctions the claims. The decisions of the IRC are final and binding in sanctioning the incentives and deciding the eligible investment.\n
\n\n##### ***Disbursement of Funds*** \nAfter receiving IRC recommendations, DITC prepares an approval note for the Accounts Department to process the disbursement. The DITC disburse funds to the entities, observing the chronological order of sanctions approved by the IRC. The entire process, from application receipt until amount disbursement, must be completed within a maximum period of 90 days.\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://goaprintingpress.gov.in/downloads/2526/2526-27-SI-OG.pdf'} SLUG: gslwis-stairpl

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme enables artisans and handicraft organizations to participate in government-sponsored melas across Gujarat and other states, fostering market access and preserving traditional crafts. Benefits include subsidized stall fees, promotional support, sales opportunities for handmade products.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Handicraft Mela Participation" by the Industrial Extension Cottage (iNDEXT-C), Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote traditional handicrafts by providing artisans and organizations with platforms to showcase and sell their products at state and national-level fairs. The scheme facilitates participation in designated melas (fairs) by covering logistical support and stall allocations. Eligible applicants include individual artisans, self-help groups (SHGs), and registered handicraft organizations. The scheme is implemented by Indext-C (Industrial Extension Bureau, Gujarat), and applications are accepted offline through district offices or the Indext-C portal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

DESCRIPTION:
The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu introduced the scheme "Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)" which aims to mitigate the unemployment problems of socially and economically weaker sections of the society.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu introduced the scheme "Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)" which aims to mitigate the unemployment problems of socially and economically weaker sections of society, particularly among the educated and unemployed youth of the state. The youth of the state will become self-employed by setting up Manufacturing/ Service / Business enterprises by availing loans up to the maximum of ₹15 Lakhs, ₹5 Lakhs, and ₹5 Lakhs respectively with subsidy assistance from the State Government up to 25% of the project cost (Maximum to a limit of ₹2.50 Lakhs). The objective of the programme is to assist marginalized youths to become entrepreneurs.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe applicant should be a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age; and'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '     (a) '}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'for the General category:'}, {'text': ' maximum of 35 years of age.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '  (b) '}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'for Special category (SC/ ST/MBC/ BC/ Minorities/ Ex-Servicemen/ Differently abled/ Transgender): '}, {'text': 'maximum of 45 years of age.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tThe applicant should have passed the 8th standard.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tThe family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹5 lakhs per annum.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "5.\tThe applicant's contribution should be 10% of the project cost for the General category; or 5% for the Special category."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6.\tEntrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training is mandatory.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '7.\tProject cost should not be more than ₹15 lakhs for manufacturing, and ₹5 lakhs for Trading / Service projects.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under the scheme, subsidy assistance will be provided by the State Government up to 25% of the project cost (Maximum to a limit of ₹2.50 Lakhs) for setting up Manufacturing/ Service / Business enterprises.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme to Dependents of Crime Victims” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme to Dependents of Crime Victims” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. As part of strengthening the victim support services in the State, the Government of Kerala has started this scheme which provides financial aid to dependents as well as victims of crime. The assistance would benefit those who were struggling to make a living, including dependents of the victims of the crime and those with serious injuries. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '      When a crime is committed it can have significant, yet varying consequences, on the individual who became the victim of the crime and his family. The devastating impact of crime results in emotional, psychological, and physical as well as financial consequences. If the head of the family is killed or injured in a crime, the family is left without the main breadwinner. Killing or seriously injuring the earning member of the household as a result of the crime will deprive a family of their livelihood.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

Under the scheme, financial assistance in the form of loans and subsidies is provided by banks to individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. This assistance is aimed at enabling them to purchase business premises or shops in urban areas for business development.

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Scheme for Small Business Owners of Scheduled Castes to Buy a Place of Business/Shop" was launched by the Director of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat, in the year 1991. This assistance is aimed at enabling them to purchase business premises or shops in urban areas for business development.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector. The Gatidhara scheme was outlined by the Finance Minister in the budget in February. Families with a monthly income of ₹25000/- or less would qualify for financial support under the scheme. The transport department will interview applicants and draw up a list of eligible candidates. Small Business in Service/Trading Sector for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana)

Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship

State

Haryana

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

Small Business, Trading Sector, Service Sector, PwD, Loan, Disability, Divyang, Swavalamban

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme offers loans up to ₹50 lakhs for self-employment to disabled persons in sectors like Agriculture, Small Business/Artisan & Traditional Occupations, Transport & Service Sectors, etc. Eligible individuals can access loans with interest rates ranging from 5% to 9% per annum.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Small Business in Service/Trading Sector for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana)" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, loans up to ₹50 lakhs are provided for self-employment to persons with disabilities in a wide range of income-generating activities under Agriculture and Allied Activities, Small Business/Artisan & Traditional Occupations, Transport Sector & Service Sector, and Technical & Professional Trades/Courses. Loans are provided to individuals falling under OH/VH/HH/MR categories at different rates of interest ranging from 5% to 9% per annum. Permanent residents of Haryana aged between 18 and 55 years, with a disability of 40% or more, are eligible to avail the benefits under this scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

SCHEME NAME: Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs SHORT TITLE: PLISJDP CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Textiles SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Jute, Manufacturer, Exporter, Enterprise, Incentive, Reimbursement, Subsidy, Export DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to make Indian Jute Diversified Products globally cost-competitive and increase their export market share. It provides a financial reimbursement of up to ₹12,00,000/- per annum on raw material costs for Jute Mill Companies and MSME units engaged in exporting JDPs. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs" was launched by the National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles. The scheme aims to make Indian Jute Diversified Products cost-competitive globally, increase market share, attract more entrepreneurs, and increase export values to ₹16,00,00,00,000/- by 2026. The scheme provides a financial incentive by reimbursing five percent of the cost of jute raw material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products, limited to three percent of the sales value, subject to a maximum of ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum. The applicant must be a Jute Mill Company or Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise unit set up within India engaged in manufacturing and exporting Jute Diversified Products. SCHEME NAME: Jute Diversification Scheme SHORT TITLE: JDS CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Textiles SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Artisan, Entrepreneur, Training, Employment, Subsidy, Equipment, Incentive DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to set up production centres to promote eco-friendly jute products and generate sustained employment. It provides skill training, machine subsidies, and financial incentives to collaborating agencies, targeting artisans, women self-help groups, and entrepreneurs. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Jute Diversification Scheme" was launched by the National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. The scheme aims to spread jute diversification programs, provide training, and create sustained employment by setting up Jute Resource-cum-Production Centres across the country. The scheme provides basic, advanced, and design training in jute diversified products manufacturing, financial incentives for collaborating agencies, and subsidies for procuring machinery. The applicant must be a registered agency or entrepreneur with at least three years of experience in product identification, bulk production, skill training, and marketing of jute diversified products. The scheme is implemented by the National Jute Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website, followed by a hard copy submission.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} schemeName: Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
BIG

CATEGORY:
Business & Entrepreneurship

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Biotechnology, Ignition Grant, BIRAC, BIG, Entrepreneur, Start-up

DESCRIPTION:
The “Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme (BIG)” is a flagship scheme of BIRAC which recognizes and invests in innovative ideas in the biotech sector. BIG scheme supports individual entrepreneurs/ start-ups from ideation to Proof of Concept.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme (BIG)” is a flagship scheme of the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), (a not-for-profit Section 8, Schedule B, Public Sector Enterprise, set up by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India), which recognizes and invests in innovative ideas in the biotech sector. The ideas should have clear potential to translate into commercial products/technologies. BIG supports individual entrepreneurs/ start-ups from ideation to Proof of Concept (PoC).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Purpose of the BIG scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Supports ideation to Proof of Concept'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Nurtures entrepreneurship to enable translation of ideas into commercially viable products/ technologies to address unmet need'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Enables Biotech Startup Ecosystem in the country to become globally competitive'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Types of projects supported:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIG scheme supports innovation under Healthcare, Lifesciences, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Drugs, Vaccines, Drug Formulations and delivery systems, Industrial Biotechnology, Agriculture, Secondary agriculture, Waste Management, Sanitation, Clean Energy, and related areas.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'The project proposals can be submitted in any of the following seven categories:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Devices & Diagnostics'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Drugs including drug delivery'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Industrial Biotechnology including Secondary Agriculture'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Agriculture'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Biosimilars & Stem Cells'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Vaccines'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Bioinformatics & facilities'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC encourages proposals involving integration of Biotech with applied sciences that may include Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Sensors, Big Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, Automation, Robotics, and related disciplines to potentially facilitate transforming healthcare, life sciences, agriculture, secondary agriculture, and other bio-based industry/ markets.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Types of projects not supported:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Basic/exploratory research projects'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Projects having a low element of novelty'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Projects involving systematic clinical trials, field trials or late-stage validation/certification of the technology.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' BIG grant is not a research fellowship and cannot be used to support PhD or any other academic research.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Project Duration:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The funding is provided for a period of up to 18 months. The project is implemented in a milestone-based manner.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility criteria for an Individual:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe individual applicant should be an Indian citizen.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe primary applicant should be the Project Leader.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tThe applicant has to be incubated in an incubator (Incubator could be located anywhere in the country and may/may not be supported by BIRAC). At the time of application, the applicant is expected to have identified a preferred incubator. The Call for Proposals is typically open for a period of up to one and a half months.\n**Step 02:** Application for BIG needs to be submitted online ONLY through the BIRAC website [www.birac.nic.in](https://birac.nic.in/login.php).\n**Step 03:** For proposal submission, the applicant can register on the BIRAC website under “BIG User”. \n**Step 04:** The eligible applicants can fill up and submit their applications by visiting the official website.\n**Note 01:** The BIG Scheme is implemented across the country through BIRAC’s BIG Partners. Names of the BIG Partners and their responsibilities are mentioned in Annexure 2.\n**Note 02:** Applicants are advised to provide sufficient details in their applications to allow for an informed and fair evaluation/review.\n**Note 03:** Requests for changes in a proposal once submitted will not be entertained.\n**Note 04:** Providing incorrect information intentionally is viewed adversely and may lead to disqualification.\n> **Selection process:**\n\nBIG selection is a multi-tier process involving the following steps:\n**Step 01:** Eligibility Check: BIG Partners screen the applications for eligibility requirements as laid out in the scheme document and appropriateness under the BIG scheme.\n**Step 02:** Examination by Preliminary Selection Committee (PSC): The PSC examines all eligible proposals on the following contours:\n•\tScheme fit\n•\tAvailability of adequate technical details which are minimally required for online review\n•\tPlagiarism\n**Step 03:** Online review by subject matter experts: Proposals recommended by PSC are reviewed online by 3 or more subject matter experts.\n**Step 04:** Presentation before Thematic Technical Expert Panel (TEP): Based on expert reviews, shortlisted applications are called for a Face-to-face presentation before the Technical Expert Panel (TEP). The TEPs are conducted in a thematic manner where all proposals of a particular theme are evaluated together by a common committee. All proposals are scored by individual TEP Experts and the Geometric Mean of Individual Scores is used to arrive at the final score for a particular proposal.\n•\tProposals with score ≥60 are considered at the next step (ESC)\n•\tProposals with score &lt;60 are not considered further\n**Step 05:** Scoring Cut-off decision by the Expert Selection Committee (ESC): ESC takes the final decision with regard to the cut-off score for final selection. Proposals above the decided cut-off will be considered for further due diligence. ESC may choose to have either the same or differential scoring cut off across the themes.\n**Step 06:** ESC-recommended applications are then subjected to final financial and technical due diligence by the BIG Partner. This may require a visit by BIG partner representative(s) to the applicant’s site and involves the following steps:\n•\tReconfirming eligibility by verification of original documents\n•\tLegal, technical, and financial due diligence\n• Confirming applicant’s claimed resources: Space, equipment, manpower, advisors, incubation services, samples, etc.\n•\tConfirming compliance strategy with regard to safety, ethics, waste disposal, etc.\n•\tConfirming for any special guidance by ESC\n•\tJustification of budget (usually by verifying quotations); meeting budget caps and other requirements\n•\tFinalization of milestones, budget, and payment schedule; defining clear measurable milestones.\n> **Indicative evaluation criteria:** BIG Proposals are reviewed on the following parameters during online review and TEP Stage:\n\n1.\tUnmet Need (max 20)\n2.\tValue Proposition/Differentiation (max 20)\n3.\tTechnical Viability (max 30)\n4.\tTeam Strength/Passion (max 15)\n5.\tBusiness Perspective (max 15)\n•\tPotential\n•\tClarity/Team’s view\n•\tCommercialization Potential (Yes/No)\n[Registration guidelines for BIG Scheme(Company/Individual)](https://birac.nic.in/webcontent/1547451412_big_registration_guidelines_14_01_2019.pdf)\n'}

schemeName: Coir Udyami Yojana
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Coir Udyami Yojana

SHORT TITLE:
CUY

CATEGORY:
Business & Entrepreneurship

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Credit Linked Subsidy, Coir Production, Enterprises, Coir Board

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme "Coir Udyami Yojana" by the Coir Board, Ministry of MSME, Government of India, aims to modernize the coir industry and generate rural employment. It offers credit-linked financial assistance to establish coir units by eligible applicants.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Coir Udyami Yojana is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up coir units with a project cost up to ₹10,00,000/- plus one cycle of working capital, which shall not exceed 25% of the project cost. Working capital will not be considered for subsidy. Coir Udyami Yojana is a Central Sector Scheme to be administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. The Scheme will be implemented by the Coir Board a statutory organization under the Ministry of MSME, as the Nodal Agency at the national level.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Financial Institutions providing loan under CUY'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'All the Scheduled Commercial Banks listed in the 2nd schedule of the RBI Act'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All Regional Rural Banks'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Co-operative Banks that are Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) of the Credit Guarantee Trust Fund for MSME, as well as through SC/ST/OBC Finance and Development Corporations.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility conditions of the Beneficiaries:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be an individual above 18 years of age with Indian Citizenship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant will not be subject to any income ceiling for receiving assistance under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must set up a project related to the production of coir fibre, yarn, or products under the coir sector.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant may be an individual, a Company, Self self-help group (SHG), a Non-Governmental Organization (NGO), Institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, a Production Co-operative Society, a Joint Liability Group, or a Charitable Trust.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must not have already availed a government subsidy under any other scheme of the Government of India or the State Government for the same purpose.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Other eligibility conditions:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant belonging to special categories must produce a certified copy of the caste/community certificate issued by the competent authority.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant, if applying as an institution, must submit a certified copy of the bylaws wherever applicable.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must ensure that the project cost includes capital expenditure such as building and machinery.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant may include one cycle of working capital in the project proposal, but it will not be considered for subsidy. The loan for working capital will only be sanctioned and released after the unit is set up, and the working capital must not exceed 25% of the total project cost.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant, if already owning a work shed, will have the cost of only the required machinery considered as the project cost under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note :', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Special focus on SC/ST and beneficiaries from the North Eastern Region (NER).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme encourages women and youth participation in rural areas.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Beneficiary’s contribution (of Project Cost): '}, {'text': '5%'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Bank credit: '}, {'text': '55%'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Rate of Subsidy (of project cost): '}, {'text': '40%'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note', 'underline': True}, {'bold': True, 'text': ': '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The maximum admissible cost of the project is ₹10,00,000/- plus working capital. Working capital shall not exceed 25% of the project cost. Subsidy will be computed excluding the working capital component.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Bank will sanction 95% of the project cost after adjusting 5% beneficiary contribution deposited and disburse the full amount of the project cost, including the beneficiary contribution, in installments for setting up the project.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"label": "Cash", "value": "Cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must fill out the prescribed application form and attach all required documents.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Apply to the nearest Field Office of the Coir Board.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Undergo a mandatory 5-day Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) before or after submission, but before bank recommendation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The application is scrutinized and forwarded to the Regional Level Selection Committee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The committee evaluates and forwards approved cases to the bank.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'On bank approval, the applicant deposits 5% beneficiary contribution within 30 days.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Coir Board deposits a subsidy (40%) with the bank.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The bank disburses a term loan within 30 days of the subsidy deposit.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The project must be completed within 6 months.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Coir Board and the bank conduct physical verification before final subsidy adjustment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'process_md': '\n1. The applicant must fill out the prescribed application form and attach all required documents.\n1. Apply to the nearest Field Office of the Coir Board.\n1. Undergo a mandatory 5-day Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) before or after submission, but before bank recommendation.\n1. The application is scrutinized and forwarded to the Regional Level Selection Committee.\n1. The committee evaluates and forwards approved cases to the bank.\n1. On bank approval, the applicant deposits 5% beneficiary contribution within 30 days.\n1. Coir Board deposits a subsidy (40%) with the bank.\n1. The bank disburses a term loan within 30 days of the subsidy deposit.\n1. The project must be completed within 6 months.\n1. Coir Board and the bank conduct physical verification before final subsidy adjustment.\n\n', 'url': 'https://www.coirservices.gov.in/frm_login.aspx'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The units that have already availed Govt. subsidy under any other Scheme of the Govt. of India or the State Govt. for the same purpose are not eligible to claim a subsidy under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' Working capital will not be considered for subsidy.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Cases of inflated costing on machinery/building, and other elements of a project to avail a higher amount of subsidy will not be allowed, and such applications will be summarily rejected, or the committee will have the authority to consider such applications by reducing the cost of the project.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

REFERENCES:
{'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'http://coirboard.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/OperationalGuidelines_CUY.pdf'}

If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again.\n**Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.\n
\n\n**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update**\n**Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login".\n**Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration.\n_*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._\n
\n\n**Steps for Scheme Application**\n**Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. \n**Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. \n**Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox.\n**Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button.\n_*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._\n
\n\n**Application Printing and Modification**\n\n- If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” \n- If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.\n\n
\n\n**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal**\n\n- Call 9909926280 / 9909926180.\n- Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.\n
\n\n**Check Application Status**\nVisit the [Application Status](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx) page Provide the Application Number of the scheme, and your Date of Birth. schemeName: Providing Latest Technology to Group of Pottery Artisans (Energy Efficient Kiln)
text:
SCHEME NAME: Providing Latest Technology to Group of Pottery Artisans (Energy Efficient Kiln) SHORT TITLE: PLTGPA-EEK CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Gujarat MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Technology, Artisan, Pottery, Energy, Equipment, Kiln DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide latest technology and equipment to pottery artisans for better productivity, improved quality and reduce health risks. It provides 100% financial assistance for energy-efficient kilns to groups of registered clay artisans and potters in Gujarat state. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Providing Latest Technology to Group of Pottery Artisans (Energy Efficient Kiln)" by the Gujarat Matikam Kalakari & Rural Technology Institute, Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide latest technology and equipment to pottery artisans for better productivity, improved quality and reduce health risks. The scheme provides 100% financial assistance on development of the kiln with unit cost of ₹83,000/- and energy-efficient furnaces to groups of registered clay artisans and potters. The applicant must be directly involved in the pottery business and be in the age group of 18 to 58 years, with at least 800 to 1000 square feet of open space available for pottery business. The scheme is implemented by the relevant Gujarat State Government Department and applications are accepted through prescribed application forms with required details and certificates.'}], 'type': In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)".\n**Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register".\n**Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again.\n**Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.\n
\n\n**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update**\n**Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login".\n**Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration.\n_*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._\n
\n\n**Steps for Scheme Application**\n**Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. \n**Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. \n**Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox.\n**Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button.\n_*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._\n
\n\n**Application Printing and Modification**\n\n- If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” \n- If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.\n\n
\n\n**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal**\n\n- Call 9909926280 / 9909926180.\n- Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.\n
\n\n**Check Application Status**\nVisit the [Application Status](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx) page Provide the Application Number of the scheme, and your Date of Birth. Then click "View Status".\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines [e-Kutir]', 'url': 'https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx?ServiceID=15'}, {'title': 'Incentives For Cottage And Rural Industries, Cottage And Rural Policy', 'url': 'https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/StaticAttachment?AttachmentFileName=/pdf/IncentiveDetails/11_Incentives_for_Cottage_and_Rural_Industries.pdf'}, {'title': 'Cottage & Rural Industries Policy', 'url': 'https://mbsirda.gujarat.gov.in/documents/State-Policies/Cottage_Rural_Industries_Policy_Book_BPG_6.pdf'} SLUG: pltgpa-eek

State

Assam

Individual

Aamar Dukan, Wheels, Business, Startup

DESCRIPTION:
The Assam Government proposes to introduce a new module of “Aamar Dukan” namely “AAMAR DUKAN ON WHEELS” in the same line as the existing ‘Aamar Dukan’ on 22.02.2017.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Details'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Government proposes to introduce a new module of “Aamar Dukan” namely “AAMAR DUKAN ON WHEELS” in the same line as the existing ‘Aamar Dukan’. Under the new module, 22 Non-PDS items (which may increase to 36) will be delivered to the doorstep of the consumer at below MRP with a minimum profit margin. Eco-friendly E-rickshaws will be used as the transportation mode under the Scheme. Through this scheme, Government plans to promote cashless transactions as the E-Rickshaws will have a GPS-enabled smart phone, and Bluetooth billing printer which will be connected to the smart phone.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The basic objective of the Scheme Aamar Dukan on Wheels is to control the price of essential commodities by avoiding the middleman. Through this scheme, the consumers will get their daily requirements of essential commodities at their doorstep at a reasonable price and shall also contribute to the removal of the unemployment problem. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

SCHEME NAME: Special Incentives for Wildlife Resorts SHORT TITLE: SIFWR CATEGORY: Travel & Tourism, Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Madhya Pradesh MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Subsidy, Capital, Investment, Tourism, Infrastructure DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of wildlife resorts within the boundaries of notified National Parks, Tiger Reserves, and Sanctuaries in the state to promote balanced and sustainable tourism. The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 20% on the fixed capital investment. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Special Incentives for Wildlife Resorts" was launched by the Tourism Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of wildlife resorts within the boundaries of notified National Parks, Tiger Reserves, and Sanctuaries in the state to promote balanced and sustainable tourism. The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 20% on the fixed capital investment, with a maximum ceiling ranging from ₹1,00,00,000/- to ₹3,00,00,000/- depending on the specific forest area category. The applicant must establish a resort meeting the minimum capital expenditure and room capacity requirements specific to the classified forest zones. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state investment portal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [https://pipdic.in/grievance_form](https://pipdic.in/grievance_form) ##### ***Registration Process*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Registration and Profile Creation*** Visit the [PIPDIC website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login". Click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Use the registered email-id to log in. An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login". Click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Use the registered email-id to log in. An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login". Click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Use the registered email-id to log in. An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must not have received benefits under the Capital Subsidy Scheme towards the purchase of energy conservation equipment, if claiming the Energy Conservation Equipment Capital Reimbursement under this scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Commercial loans not backed by any State/Central scheme where interest is less than 10% shall not be taken into consideration for calculating the total subsidy received due to a subsidized rate of interest.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/target-schemes.pdf'} SLUG: igis

schemeName: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
text:
SCHEME NAME: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency SHORT TITLE: GCRSUREDA CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: UREDA, Grid Connected Rooftop, Electricity, Solar Rooftop Plant DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II)” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under Department of Energy, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'All domestic consumers, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand are eligible for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'By installing a rooftop solar plant, households can significantly reduce their electricity bills by utilizing the power generated by the system. Any surplus electricity can be fed into the grid, allowing consumers to earn additional income. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For individual domestic consumers, the Government of India provides a subsidy of ₹17,662/- per kW for solar plants up to 3 kW capacity and ₹8,831/- per kW for plants up to 10 kW, directly credited to the consumer’s account. Additionally, the Uttarakhand State Government offers a subsidy of ₹17,000/- per kW for installations up to 3 kW. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For group housing societies and residential welfare associations, the Government of India provides a subsidy of ₹8,831/- per kW for rooftop solar plants up to 10 kW capacity.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'After registering on the MNRE portal '}, {'children': [{'text': 'www.solarrooftop.gov.in'}], 'link': 'https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ', the consumer can submit an online application, for which the NOC is also issued online by UPCL. The solar plant can then be installed through any UPCL-registered vendor. After installation, UPCL connects the plant to the grid by installing a net meter, and all related records are uploaded on the portal. Finally, the consumer provides their bank account details on the portal, through which the grant amount is directly released.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'After registering on the MNRE portal [www.solarrooftop.gov.in](https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in/), the consumer can submit an online application, for which the NOC is also issued online by UPCL. The solar plant can then be installed through any UPCL-registered vendor. After installation, UPCL connects the plant to the grid by installing a net meter, and all related records are uploaded on the portal. Finally, the consumer provides their bank account details on the portal, through which the grant amount is directly released.\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 175)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf'} SLUG: gcrsureda
