text:
SCHEME NAME:
Back-To-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme

SHORT TITLE:
BTLPDFP

CATEGORY:
Education & Learning, Women and Child

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Kerala

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Woman, Scientist, Post-Doctoral, Fellowship, Unemployed

DESCRIPTION:
The “Back-to-Lab” programme of Women Scientists Division offers Research and Post-Doctoral Fellowship to women who have break in their career, to facilitate their re-entry in science research. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Back-to-Lab” programme of the Women Scientists Division offers Research and Post-Doctoral Fellowship to women who have a break in their career, to facilitate their re-entry in science research. The fellowship is provided normally for a period of 2 years. The scheme is open to unemployed women who are permanent residents of Kerala and qualified with PhD in Science or Engineering. The objective of the scheme is to support women having career breaks, facilitating their re-entry in scientific research by providing a Post-Doctoral Fellowship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '        Back-To-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme is aimed to support women in Science in Kerala. The programme focuses on addressing the issue of the under-representation of women in higher academics and professions particularly in Science. The programme will facilitate the re-entry of women in Science after a career break necessitated due to family commitments. Active participation of more number of women in Science is socially relevant and significant, especially in a developing economy. Further, the programme would benefit qualitative interventions in Science research by effective utilization of human resource potential.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Necessary conditions as per the scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'There should be a Scientist Mentor who is a regular faculty/staff of the institution under whose guidance the researcher should carry out the work. The Scientist Mentor should have at least 5 or more years of service left in the Institution before retirement. The Scientist Mentor should constantly monitor the progress of the project, facilitate smooth implementation of the programme and ensure timely submission of financial utilization certificates by the institute to KSCSTE.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Post-Doctoral Fellow availing financial assistance/stipend from other State/Central funding agencies or other sources will not be simultaneously eligible for KSCSTE Back-to-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship. The Post-Doctoral Fellow should furnish an undertaking to the effect that she is not availing financial assistance/stipend from any other source simultaneously.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The implementing Institute should provide full infrastructural facilities such as a laboratory, computer, library, communication, accommodation, water, electricity, etc. for smooth implementation of the project.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The unutilized portion of the grant (along with the interest accrued) at the end of the project period should be refunded to Council by DD in favour of Member Secretary, KSCSTE.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Scientists who publish technical/ scientific papers based on the research work done under the project should acknowledge the assistance received from KSCSTE.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Post-Doctoral Fellow should not enter into collaboration with a foreign party (individual/ industry) without prior approval of the Council.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tOnly women candidates are eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tApplicant should be a Permanent Resident of Kerala.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tApplicant should be unemployed and should be under career-break due to family commitments or other related matters, at the time of application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tApplicant should not receive any emoluments from any source at the time of application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5.\tThose who have availed KSCSTE Back-to-Lab Fellowship earlier for their PhD programme are not eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6.\tAge limit: 40 years - as on the date of application, relaxable for 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '7.\tApplicant should have qualified Ph.D. in Science/Engineering subjects.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '8.\tApplicant should have scored a minimum of 60% marks for post-graduation.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '9.\tApplicant should have chosen an institution as Research Centre subject to the following.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tThe Research Centre should not be the same as the Ph.D. Research Centre.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tTenable only in R&D institutions (National/State level) or University Departments in Kerala and should belong to the category of “Government Institutions” [however, premier National Institutions viz., IISER, IIT, IISc. etc. outside the State shall also be considered].'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '10.\tApplicant should have published at least one research paper in a SCI Journal/ secured patent.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '11.\tThose who have already availed of one Post-Doctoral Fellowship from KSCSTE or elsewhere are not eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme offers a Post-doctoral fellowship of ₹45,000/- + 10% HRA per month along with an annual contingency grant of ₹75,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Duration of the Fellowship is limited to a maximum of 2 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Eligible applicants may apply online in the KSCSTE web portal for new applications in the following link: '}, {'children': [{'text': 'www.submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in'}], 'link': 'https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scrutiny of the Application:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Preliminary scrutiny of the application is carried out for verification of basic eligibility conditions and supporting documents.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Peer review:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All eligible applications are subjected to peer review by five subject experts in the relevant area of research. Proposals with at least three reviews graded greater than 5 (on 10 point scale) are only considered for further processing.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Presentation before Expert Committee:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Proposals which have passed the peer review requirements will be invited for presentation before the Research Advisory Committee. One or two reviewers will serve as additional Subject Expert during the RAC meeting. On favourable recommendation by the RAC, the proposal will be considered for funding by KSCSTE. The applicants will be informed of the decision and will be asked to execute an Agreement as per the guidelines of the scheme'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Contact Details:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Head, Women Scientists Division'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Kerala State Council of Science, Technology and Environment'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom (P.O), Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Ph: 0471 2548208, Fax: 0471 2540085, 2534605'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'E-mail: womenscientistkerala@gmail.com'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'For queries:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'E-mail  : wsd.kscste@kerala.gov.in,  womenscientistkerala@gmail.com, wsd1kscste@gmail.com'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Tel: 0471- 2548208, 0471- 2548346'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': 'Eligible applicants may apply online in the KSCSTE web portal for new applications in the following link: [www.submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in](https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/)\n> **Scrutiny of the Application:**\n\nPreliminary scrutiny of the application is carried out for verification of basic eligibility conditions and supporting documents.\n> **Peer review:**\n\nAll eligible applications are subjected to peer review by five subject experts in the relevant area of research. Proposals with at least three reviews graded greater than 5 (on 10 point scale) are only considered for further processing.\n> **Presentation before Expert Committee:**\n\nProposals which have passed the peer review requirements will be invited for presentation before the Research Advisory Committee. One or two reviewers will serve as additional Subject Expert during the RAC meeting. On favourable recommendation by the RAC, the proposal will be considered for funding by KSCSTE. The applicants will be informed of the decision and will be asked to execute an Agreement as per the guidelines of the scheme\n> **Contact Details:**\n\nThe Head, Women Scientists Division\nKerala State Council of Science, Technology and Environment\nSasthra Bhavan, Pattom (P.O), Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004\nPh: 0471 2548208, Fax: 0471 2540085, 2534605\nE-mail: womenscientistkerala@gmail.com\n> **For queries:**\n\nE-mail  : wsd.kscste@kerala.gov.in,  womenscientistkerala@gmail.com, wsd1kscste@gmail.com\nTel: 0471- 2548208, 0471- 2548346\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:

DESCRIPTION:
Chhattisgarh Saraswati Cycle Yojana has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh in 2004.

DESCRIPTION:
“WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship” is a new programme of the Department of Science & Technology that aims to provide opportunities to women scientists & technologists between the age group of 27-60 years who want to continue their research as bench-level scientists in basic and applied sciences.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Department of Science and Technology (DST) is implementing a dedicated umbrella scheme "Women in Science and Engineering-KIRAN (WISE-KIRAN)" with the aim to support women from all walks of life in the domain of Science & Technology. The Department has re-structured one of the flagship programme "Women Scientists Scheme" and come up with a new programme "WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship (WISE-PDF)" that aims to provide opportunities to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-60 years who want to continue the research as bench-level scientists in basic and applied sciences.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scientific Disciplines:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '(1) Physical & Mathematical Sciences [PM]'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(2) Chemical Sciences [CS]'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(3) Life Sciences [LS]'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(4) Earth & Atmospheric Sciences [EA]'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(5) Engineering & Technology [ET]'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Project Duration:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The maximum duration of the project is 3 years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Employment:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Candidates in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-PDF. However, women scientists who are temporarily employed in research or academics may apply for the scheme but they have to leave their earlier assignment if the WISE-PDF project is approved. The position of research staff in any project, Post-Doctoral Fellow, Research Associate, etc. will be considered a temporary assignment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Age:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The minimum age to apply is 27 years and the maximum is 60 years. Women scientists, less than 27 years of age are NOT eligible.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Educational Qualification:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Women Scientists having a Ph.D. in Basic/ Applied Science or an equivalent degree like MD, MS, MDS, etc. are eligible for WISE-PDF.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Break in Career:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Break in career is not mandatory to apply for WISE-PDF, however, women who have a break are also encouraged to apply for this programme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The fellowship amount under this programme is @₹55,000/- per month with House Rent Allowances as per DST norms.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This Programme also provides a Research Grant of ₹2.0 Lakhs per year and the cost of small equipment (up to a maximum of ₹3.0 Lakhs) along with Institutional overhead charges.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' The proposals should be submitted at the DST-WISE portal “'}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://onlinewosa.gov.in/'}], 'link': 'https://online-wosa.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '”. The portal is open throughout the year.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' First of all, aspirants need to register themselves at the online portal with their active e-mail ID to apply to WISE-PDF.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' An auto-generated email will be sent to the applicant with an ID and link to create a password.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:'}, {'text': " After successfully registration, the applicant may login at the 'portal’ and fill in the application form of the Project Proposal under WISE-PDF."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' Before submission, the applicant may preview her full proposal to make sure that everything is correct and in order. The proposal can be edited at this stage but after submission, any editing will not be possible.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 06:'}, {'text': ' Once the applicant finds the proposal is in order, click the "Final Submit" button for the final submission of the proposal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 07:'}, {'text': ' The proposal can be seen after login. It can also be printed and saved in the system for your ready reference.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' There are different Project Proposal Documents (PPDs) that include files to be submitted online as well as to be uploaded.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The file size should not exceed 2MB in any case.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' It would be useful to first prepare uploading files which enable the applicant to submit a proposal in a smooth and time-bound manner.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' The formats of all the PPDs are available on the home page of the portal under ’Formats’ for ready reference of the applicants.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 05:'}, {'text': ' Hard copy of the proposal: There is no need to submit a hard copy of the proposal to DST.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The proposals should be submitted at the DST-WISE portal “[https://onlinewosa.gov.in/](https://online-wosa.gov.in/)”. The portal is open throughout the year.\n**Step 02:** First of all, aspirants need to register themselves at the online portal with their active e-mail ID to apply to WISE-PDF.\n**Step 03:** An auto-generated email will be sent to the applicant with an ID and link to create a password.\n**Step 04:** After successfully registration, the applicant may login at the &#39;portal’ and fill in the application form of the Project Proposal under WISE-PDF.\n**Step 05:** Before submission, the applicant may preview her full proposal to make sure that everything is correct and in order. The proposal can be edited at this stage but after submission, any editing will not be possible.\n**Step 06:** Once the applicant finds the proposal is in order, click the &quot;Final Submit&quot; button for the final submission of the proposal.\n**Step 07:** The proposal can be seen after login. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The “Unique Disability ID (UDID)” has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Government of India, aiming to create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and issue a Unique Disability Identity Card to each individual to ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits. Through this scheme, Disability Certificates and Unique Disability Identity Cards are provided to Persons with Disabilities across the country. The scheme is implemented by competent medical authorities notified by the respective State Governments and Union Territories through the centralised UDID portal. The project supports online application submission, assessment of disability percentage by hospitals or Medical Boards, online renewal and updating of information, and integrated management of government schemes and benefits for PwDs. It also eliminates duplicate records and enables tracking of the physical and financial progress of beneficiaries at the village, block, district, state, and national levels. District Welfare Officers assist in registration camps and application management, while District Collectors monitor implementation through reporting features available on the portal.'}], 'type': schemeName: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research

SHORT TITLE:
WISER

CATEGORY:
Women and Child, Education & Learning

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Woman, WISER, Germany, IGSTC, STEM

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)” aims to build scientific capacity, retain and promote women researchers in India & Germany by utilizing complementary expertise in science, technology, innovation and research partnerships. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)” aims to build scientific capacity, retain and promote women researchers in India & Germany by utilising complementary expertise in science, technology, innovation and research partnerships. This scheme is designed for women researchers holding a regular/long-term research position in academia/research institute/industry in India or Germany.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '            Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC), established by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India and the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF), Government of Germany invites applications from women researchers in India/Germany to participate and collaborate in an ongoing R&D&I project without applying for fresh project grant in partnering countries.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This programme intends to:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Enhance the representation and progression of women researchers in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Bring gender equity and inclusion in STEM research.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Create avenues for networking, interaction and long-term research collaboration.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Improve existing projects by adding an additional research component to get new and better results.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Promote women to lead consortium-based bilateral projects for IGSTC programmes and other funding schemes.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Tenure:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The tenure of the grant is for 3 years or till completion of the project whichever is earlier and will cover one visit per year for a short stay up to 1 month.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be working either in India or Germany.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Through this scheme, women researchers/entrepreneurs holding regular positions in academic/research institutions/industrial research organizations in India/Germany may apply to be a part of an ongoing R&D project of interest with acceptance from the host team.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The programme is open to all areas of STEM.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The programme has no age-limit (Preference to Early/Mid-career researchers).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The applicant must define her role in the project, and provide details of the objective, execution strategy, and expected outcome.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The applicant shall specify the value addition to the project in the host country.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' Choice and acceptance from the host is the sole responsibility of the applicant. The applicant should ensure an endorsement/consent letter from the host at the time of the application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' The applicant shall submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC)/Endorsement letter from the head of the institution (present organization).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 05:'}, {'text': ' The awardee shall commence her visit within 12 months from the date of the award letter.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 06:'}, {'text': ' The awardee will abide by the conduct, rules & regulations of the host and the host country. IGSTC will not be responsible for the violation of any Rules and regulations by the awardee.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 07:'}, {'text': ' The awardee and host must intimate IGSTC through email/letter in case of discontinuation by the awardee.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 08:'}, {'text': ' The awardee must recognize and acknowledge IGSTC in all online/print documents, communications, reports, publications, conferences, theses, etc. on work emanating from the grant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The grant will cover basic project assistance (including research staff for the Indian awardee, consumables, and contingency) for the awardee in the parent country and a one-month research stay in the host country (single round-trip airfare, visa fee, medical insurance, per diem for the stay).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Indian awardee:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Travel (including visa fee and insurance) approximately ₹1 lakh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Project cost up to ₹12 lakhs/year (including research staff, consumables, contingency, and per diem @ €2300/month in Germany).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'German awardee:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Travel (including visa fee and insurance) approximately €1500.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Project cost up to €14500/year (including consumables, contingency, and per diem @ € 2300/month in India).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Application Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' Applications are accepted throughout the year and eligible candidates can apply '}, {'children': [{'text': 'online'}], 'link': 'https://indo-germansciencetechnologycentre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ApplicantDashboard?campaign=Landing_Page_Wiser', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' If you are a new user, click on the ‘Create an Account” link at the portal and register yourself by filling details. Existing users can click on the ‘Login’ button.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' Enter your email ID and password to apply for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:'}, {'text': ' Fill out the application form completely and submit it.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Evaluation:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applications will be evaluated by a Joint Committee based on merit and compliance with the eligibility conditions. Evaluation will be based on the credentials of the applicant, relevance to STEM, scope, feasibility, content, and quality of the proposed plan, expected outcome, and future potential. The decision of the Committee will be considered as final and binding.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Contact:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'For queries', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Phone: +91-011-26543500'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'E-mail: wiser@igstc.org'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Mailing Address:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Indo-German Science & Technology Centre'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Ground Floor, Block – II, Technology Bhavan,'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi – 110016, India'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '> **Application Process:**\n\n**Step 01:** Applications are accepted throughout the year and eligible candidates can apply [online](https://indo-germansciencetechnologycentre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ApplicantDashboard?campaign=Landing_Page_Wiser).\n**Step 02:** If you are a new user, click on the ‘Create an Account” link at the portal and register yourself by filling details. Existing users can click on the ‘Login’ button.\n**Step 03:** Enter your email ID and password to apply for the scheme.\n**Step 04:** Fill out the application form completely and submit it.\n> **Evaluation:**\n\nApplications will be evaluated by a Joint Committee based on merit and compliance with the eligibility conditions. Evaluation will be based on the credentials of the applicant, relevance to STEM, scope, feasibility, content, and quality of the proposed plan, expected outcome, and future potential. The decision of the Committee will be considered as final and binding.\n> **Contact:**\n\n**For queries**\nPhone: +91-011-26543500\nE-mail: wiser@igstc.org\n**Mailing Address:**\nIndo-German Science &amp; Technology Centre\nGround Floor, Block – II, Technology Bhavan,\nNew Mehrauli Road, New Delhi – 110016, India\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:


REFERENCES:
{'title': 'Guideline', 'url': 'https://www.igstc.org/home/wiser_basic_guidelines'}, {'title': 'Official Website', 'url': 'https://www.igstc.org/home/wiser'}, {'title': 'Application Link', 'url': 'https://indo-germansciencetechnologycentre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ApplicantDashboard?campaign=Landing_Page_Wiser'}

schemeName: Nari Shakti Puraskar - National Award for Women
text:
SCHEME NAME: Nari Shakti Puraskar - National Award for Women SHORT TITLE: NSP-NAW CATEGORY: Women and Child LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry of Women and Child Development SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Woman, Nari Shakti, Puraskar, Award, Women Empowerment DESCRIPTION: The award aims to acknowledge the achievements of women & recognize their contributions to society and the nation. The award is conferred annually on individuals in recognition of their exceptional service towards the cause of women’s empowerment, particularly for vulnerable and marginalized women. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Nari Shakti Puraskar” has been introduced by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India, to acknowledge the achievements of women and recognize their contributions to society and the nation. The award is conferred annually on individuals in recognition of their exceptional service towards the cause of women’s empowerment, particularly for vulnerable and marginalized women.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "The recipients of the “Nari Shakti Puraskar” shall be declared every year by 20th February and awards will be conferred on 8th March on the occasion of International Women's Day (IWD)."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'In the past few years, there have been concerted efforts by the Government to recognize and encourage women to participate in all spheres and issues related to women have gained utmost importance and focused attention. "Nari Shakti Puraskars" shall showcase the Government\'s commitment towards women with the aim of strengthening their position in the society.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': '“Nari Shakti Puraskar” will also provide an opportunity to Young Indians to understand the contribution of women in building of society and the nation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The awards will inspire the citizens to follow the league of awardees.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The awards are open to individuals only.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicants must be at least 25 years of age on 1st July of the award year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be a recipient of the same award earlier (including Stree Shakti Puraskars as were awarded by the Ministry earlier).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Nari Shakti Puruskar may be awarded for outstanding work, preferably in exceptional circumstances, to individuals in the areas of: economic and social empowerment of women or pertaining to this theme or incidental thereto.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The Nari Shakti Puruskar may be awarded to individuals who encouraged women to participate in decision making roles; encouraged women's skill development in traditional and non-traditional sectors; facilitated basic amenities for rural women; promoted women in non-traditional sectors like science and technology, sports, art, culture, concretely and significantly towards safety and security, health and wellness, education, skill development, life skills, respect and dignity of women etc."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'An award may also be given to a State or Union Territory, which has appreciably improved Child Sex Ratio (CSR).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Normally the awards shall not be presented posthumously; Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science

PROWIS-II

Science, IT & Communications, Women and Child

Central

All

Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
French, Mobility, Woman, Science, France, Scientist, Researcher

DESCRIPTION:
This programme will encourage women candidates to work with the Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science (PROWIS-II)” is dedicated to the young women scientists of both India and France. This programme will encourage women candidates to work with the Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Programme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of the Programme will be for two weeks.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Women applicants must be Indian or French citizens (citizens residing in France) from a recognized university or research institution in India/France.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Indian applicants should hold a PhD degree & sanctioned/tenured post in a scientific/academic institution and be willing to undertake collaborative research projects in French institutions/universities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'French women applicants holding a PhD degree and currently completing a postdoctoral project & willing to undertake collaborative research projects in Indian institutions/universities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The mobility should take place during the employment period of the applicant in the concerned institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have availed of any visiting fellowship in France/India during the last 5 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This fellowship cannot be availed simultaneously with any other fellowship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': " Preference will be given to those candidates who don't have any international exposure."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' CEFIPRA may relax the eligibility conditions in case of potential candidates.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Return airfare (economy class), accommodation & per diem allowances, local travel in India/France, airport transfer, insurance, and visa charges shall be given to the selected candidates.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{"id": 2, "label": "In Kind", "value": "in-kind"}

{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The eligible candidates need to register and apply at '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://www.cefipra.org/'}], 'link': 'https://www.cefipra.org/indo-french-programme-for-women-in-science-prowis/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' or log on to: '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://cefipra.org/prowiss/ '}], 'link': 'https://cefipra.org/prowiss/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': 'The eligible candidates need to register and apply at [https://www.cefipra.org/](https://www.cefipra.org/indo-french-programme-for-women-in-science-prowis/) or log on to: [https://cefipra.org/prowiss/ ](https://cefipra.org/prowiss/)\n'}

It offers free comprehensive antenatal care services at government health facilities. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan" was launched on 9th June 2016 by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, aims to provide fixed-day assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care universally to all pregnant women (in 2nd and 3rd trimester) on the 9th of every month, addressing the critical need for standardized maternal healthcare services and reducing maternal and infant mortality rates across the country. The scheme provides assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care, free of cost, universally to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month and includes a minimum package of antenatal care services provided by Obstetrics and Gynaecology specialists, Radiologists, and Physicians at government health facilities. The applicant must be a pregnant woman in her 2nd or 3rd trimester of pregnancy and must be willing to visit designated government health facilities on the 9th of every month for antenatal care services. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India through National Health Mission at state and district levels and applications for this scheme are accepted schemeName: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Indira Amma Bhojanalya

SHORT TITLE:
IABUK

CATEGORY:
Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Uttarakhand

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Canteen, Cheap Food, Affordable Food, Food At Subsidized Rate, SHG, Women Self-help Group

DESCRIPTION:
The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Indira Amma Bhojanalaya" was introduced by the Rural Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to arrange and operate cheap food canteens in the state.  The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women\'s self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens. The canteens are operated by women\'s self-help groups under the supervision and control of the Chief Development Officer (CDO). The canteens will be established in the headquarters of each district.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a women Self-Help Group (SHG) formed according to the guiding principles of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Self-Help Groups (SHGs) formed as per NRLM guidelines that are actively functioning and have received the minimum Revolving Fund (RF) — either under the restructured SGSY scheme or directly under NRLM, if not previously covered under SGSY — shall be eligible to operate the canteen.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ' In urban areas, self-help groups (SHGs) under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) are also eligible to operate Indira Amma Canteens. The Rural Development Department provides grants to support these groups in running the canteens.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Notes:', 'underline': True}, {'italic': True, 'text': ' ', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'It is essential for self-help groups to maintain complete records of beneficiaries, including their names and places of residence, to ensure transparency and prevent any irregularities in receiving contributions provided by the state government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'SHGs formed under NRLM guidelines and having received the Community Investment Fund (CIF) or a Micro Credit Plan specifically for operating an Indira Amma Canteen will be given preference.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The tenure of operation of State Government funded/aided canteens operating in Municipal Corporation areas shall be maximum of 01 year and thereafter they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 02 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Except Municipal Corporation areas, the tenure of operation of canteens funded/aided by the State Government in other institutions/offices/bodies etc. will be maximum 02 years. Thereafter, they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 04 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': '1. Nutritious and affordable food at subsidized rates.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.'}, {'bold': True, 'text': ' Subsidized Rates: '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The consumer pays ₹25/- per plate in hilly areas.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The consumer pays ₹20/- per plate in Dehradun, Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar, and Nainital districts.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A subsidy of ₹10/- per plate is borne by the State Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': '3. The Urban Development Authority, Municipal Corporation, or Municipality provides free space, furniture, and other essential resources required for the operation of the canteen.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4. Uttarakhand Power Corporation and Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan provide electricity and water, respectively, free of cost.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5. The arrangement of fuel/LPG gas for running the canteen is made through the District Supply Officer.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '6.'}, {'bold': True, 'text': ' '}, {'text': "Provides continuous income-generating employment, leading to economic strengthening for women's Self-Help Groups (SHGs)."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Conditions:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Maximum 1,200 plates of food are to be provided per day in high-population districts like Dehradun, Haridwar, and Udham Singh Nagar.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A maximum of 800 plates of food are to be provided per day in other districts.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Canteens opened solely for employees within office premises are not eligible for subsidy.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The State Government reserves the right to determine future subsidies based on the canteen's annual income or profit."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Canteens aiming to become self-sustainable will continue to receive facilitator support from the State Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 2, "label": "In Kind", "value": "in-kind"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'text': 'The concerned district will publish advertisements in at least two national newspapers for the selection of Self-Help Groups (SHGs). Visit your nearest Chief Development Officer under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note: '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'For opening any Indira Amma Canteen, advertisement will be given in at least 02 national newspapers by the concerned district for the selection of self-help group.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In selection, priority will be given to the self-help group of the same Nyaya Panchayat that wants to establish canteen in the Nyaya Panchayat or in the adjoining municipal body.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If more than one self-help group is found eligible for the same canteen then in such a case, the group will be selected on a lottery basis.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The records of the selected self-help group, like bank account number, MIS number, copy of passbook, photocopy of proposal for opening canteen of SHG, photograph of all the members of the group, etc., will be preserved after selection of the group in the concerned district.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate will also ensure that every member of the group to which Indira Amma Canteen is being allotted, and that group is completely as per the NRLM standards. Under no circumstances should anyone else be given the benefit under the said scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'More than one canteen cannot be allotted to a Self-Help Group.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'process_md': 'The concerned district will publish advertisements in at least two national newspapers for the selection of Self-Help Groups (SHGs). Visit your nearest Chief Development Officer under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM).\n> **Note:** \n\n\n1. For opening any Indira Amma Canteen, advertisement will be given in at least 02 national newspapers by the concerned district for the selection of self-help group.\n1. In selection, priority will be given to the self-help group of the same Nyaya Panchayat that wants to establish canteen in the Nyaya Panchayat or in the adjoining municipal body.\n1. If more than one self-help group is found eligible for the same canteen then in such a case, the group will be selected on a lottery basis.\n1. The records of the selected self-help group, like bank account number, MIS number, copy of passbook, photocopy of proposal for opening canteen of SHG, photograph of all the members of the group, etc., will be preserved after selection of the group in the concerned district.\n1. The committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate will also ensure that every member of the group to which Indira Amma Canteen is being allotted, and that group is completely as per the NRLM standards. Under no circumstances should anyone else be given the benefit under the said scheme.\n1. More than one canteen cannot be allotted to a Self-Help Group.\n\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant self-help group cannot be allotted more than one Indira Amma Canteen.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The use of any type of intoxicant or smoking within the Indira Amma Canteen premises is strictly prohibited; violation will lead to termination of the canteen operation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Canteens opened within government office premises will not receive a subsidy.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

The application form can be obtained from the departmental office or downloaded from the official website [https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in](https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in/provider/state-government/) - After obtaining the form, applicants are required to attach the necessary documents, which include a self-declaration certificate of belonging to a minority community, an income certificate, a permanent residence certificate, an affidavit declaring unmarried status and confirming that only two daughters of the family have received or will receive the benefit, details of an Aadhaar-linked or seeded bank account, a copy of the Aadhaar card, and a mobile number. \n - The completed form along with these documents must be submitted at the development block office or the district office. DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Swasraya Scheme for Parents/Mothers of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Swasraya Scheme for Parents/Mothers of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to find self-employment, whose husbands have died/abandoned, and who have to take care of their sons/children with severe physical and mental challenges.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Parents of severely mentally retarded and differently-abled persons require emotional strength and flexibility. Older parents can find themselves overwhelmed by various medical, caregiving, and financial responsibilities. Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded (PH/MR) persons always need special care and attention since they cannot perform their day-to-day activities without someone else’s assistance. Sometimes it can be quite challenging for older parents in BPL families, especially mothers, who have to take care of household tasks and work apart from taking care of MR persons.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Looking after such a Mentally challenged/PH person is expensive. These expenses can arise from medical equipment and supplies, medical care, caregiving expenses, specialized transportation, etc. Even though an amount of ₹600/- is being provided as “Aswasakiranam Pension” to caregivers (family members) of bedridden PH/MR persons, it cannot cover the expenses completely. Single mothers face tremendous challenges. Often, a custodial parent must fulfill the roles of primary provider and caregiver without the benefit of a partner. It is a difficult task under the best of circumstances.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

DESCRIPTION:
The "Griha Aadhar Scheme" addresses the problem of spiralling prices and provides support to the housewives/homemakers from the middle, lower-middle and poor sections of society, to maintain a reasonable standard of living for their families.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The "Griha Aadhar Scheme" is one of the flagship programmes of the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to address the problem of spiralling prices and to provide support to the housewives/homemakers from the middle, lower middle and poor sections of society, to maintain a reasonable standard of living for their families. Under this scheme, a monthly disbursement of an amount as prescribed under the scheme will be provided every month directly to the hands of the housewives/homemakers to achieve the objective.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

DESCRIPTION:
The Punjabi government has established the Punjab Ashirwad Scheme to offer financial support for a girl's marriage.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'There are many members of the economically disadvantaged part of society who are unable to plan their daughters’ weddings owing to their precarious financial situation. And they deal with several issues relating to this. The Punjab Ashirwad plan has been introduced by the Punjab government by keeping such a situation in mind. Girls from economically disadvantaged parts of society will get financial aid under this program. so that they won’t have to worry about any financial obligations when planning their daughter’s wedding. The scheme aims not only to help girls but also to encourage such families who are raising girls and want to marry them.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Girl should be 18 years old or above.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Annual income of the family from all sources does not exceed ₹32,790/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Parents/Guardians of the girl should be domiciled in Punjab State.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The application can be given before the fixed date of marriage or after the 30 days of the marriage by the applicant for getting financial assistance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The amount of Ashirwad is limited up to two girls of the concerned family under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Financial assistance is given to Scheduled Castes/Christian girls, Backward Classes/Castes, Economically weaker sections girls, daughters of widows of any caste at the time of their marriage, and Scheduled Castes widows/divorcees at the time of their re-marriage.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Mukhya Mantri Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana" was launched by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, in September 2013. With this objective, this scheme has been launched in the state.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To help women in Emergency Situations.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To re-establish the sufferers/victim woman.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To encourage women for self-employment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To make women independent.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To increase the Social, Economic, and educational levels of women.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To make the distressed/victimized/helpless/destitute women self-reliant and rehabilitate them in the mainstream of society.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

State

Married, Family, Pension, Woman

DESCRIPTION:
The Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana, launched on 08-07-2015 by the Jharkhand Government, provides financial assistance to primitive tribal families. The pension is given to the adult married woman or, if none, the male head of the family. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:

DESCRIPTION:
"Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '"Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years as this group is not getting benefits under the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme. In Manipur, there are many widows of this age group due to the armed conflict and HIV/AIDS. Therefore, this scheme is indispensable for such widows to prevent difficulties and hardships to bear the daily need for survival. Widows who are domiciled in Manipur and have been residing in Manipur for more than 5 years continuously preceding the date of application are eligible under the scheme. This is a State Sponsored Scheme and only the citizens who are domiciled in the State of Manipur can apply for this scheme. The application should be submitted through the respective District Social Welfare Officer.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The financial assistance will be at the rate of ₹ 2,000/- per annum per widow.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme will cover all the eligible beneficiaries within the State of Manipur.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Financial assistance will be continued with the fresh/Renewal application every year if the fund is available.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

DESCRIPTION:
Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT students of UT domicile with parental income below ₹2.5 lakh p.a. Academic allowance ₹5,000–₹20,000 p.a. for eligible courses. Online/correspondence students get tuition fees only. Institutes must have AISHE/UDISE code and NAAC/NBA accreditation.

Through this scheme, academic allowance and tuition fee assistance are provided to eligible students pursuing recognized post-matriculation and post-secondary courses in India. The scheme is implemented by the State Governments and Union Territory Administrations. Scholarships are available only for studies in India and are awarded by the State/Union Territory to which the applicant permanently belongs. The scheme covers recognized courses including senior secondary, diploma, vocational training, graduate, postgraduate, and professional courses pursued in recognized institutions. Scholarship assistance is released directly into the bank accounts of students through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Until the above system is brought into effect, the documents may be scanned and uploaded which include: a passport size photograph, copy of each of the certificates for diploma, degree, etc. in respect of all examinations passed, Caste certificate duly signed by the authorized officer, valid Income certificate issued by the competent authority as prescribed by the State Govt. etc.\n  - After the registration on the Portal, if the student is found eligible, all States/UTs will complete the verification process within 30 days from the receipt of the registration request from the students and issue the Freeship Card through the IT portal, mentioning the course for which application is made so that the eligible students are not denied admissions due to delay in depositing tuition fees. It should be possible for the student to download the Free Ship Card from the portal itself. Once complete digitization of all the required certificates is done, such a Freeship Card shall be automatically generated immediately on registration, if the student is found eligible.\n  - The Freeship Card shall contain the details given in [Annexure-1](https://socialjustice.gov.in/public/ckeditor/upload/65661651839791.pdf) and shall be digitally signed. For the purpose of admission, the Freeship card will remain valid for period of one year from the date of issue.  - If a student wants to change his/her course before taking admission to an institution, he can do so by logging on IT portal and a fresh Freeship Card shall be issued automatically for all eligible students.\n  - In case of renewal students, there shall be no need for fresh registration for the Freeship card and a card once issued to him/her shall be valid for the entire duration of the course.\n\n\n<br>\n\n'}

It aims to appreciably increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of Scheduled Caste students in higher education, with a focus on students from the poorest households. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees and academic allowance is provided to Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation and post-secondary education in India. The scheme is implemented by the UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The scholarships are available for recognised post-matriculation and post-secondary courses pursued in recognised institutions. The scheme covers both fresh and renewal cases. Benefits are available for the complete duration of the approved course, subject to fulfilment of prescribed conditions. DESCRIPTION:
The Union Territory of Daman & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli has successfully launched the “Swabhimaan Scheme” scheme to tackle the problems of Malnutrition, Anemia, and other relevant issues. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': "The Union Territory of Daman & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli has successfully launched the “Swabhimaan Scheme” scheme to tackle the problems of Malnutrition, Anemia, and other relevant issues. The Hon'ble Prime Minister launched the scheme in Daman on 25th February 2018 and Hon'ble Home Minister in Dadra and Nagar Haveli on 20th April 2018. Under this scheme, a take-home ration (7.5kgs nutritious) is provided every month to Pregnant Women, Lactating Mothers, and Sabla (Adolescent Category girls in the age group of 11-14 years). "}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '       The nutritional status of women and children in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli is alarming. The UT Administration decided to wage war against undernutrition and came up with the "Swabhimaan Scheme” as one of the potent tools. The scheme builds on the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) being implemented by the government of India. One of the components of ICDS is the provision of supplementary nutrition to children, pregnant women, lactating mothers, and adolescent girls. However, this nutrition was being provided as a cooked meal and the beneficiary had to visit the Anganwadi daily to avail of this benefit. Loss of wages or working time coupled with poor condition of Anganwadis, and poor attendance of Anganwadi workers led to low enrollment and poor uptake of supplementary nutrition.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Improve the nutritional status of pregnant women, lactating mothers, and adolescent girls'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Provide a monthly quota of supplementary nutrition to pregnant women, lactating mothers, and adolescent girls on a fixed day of every month as a take-home ration.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Increase the number of beneficiaries availing of the scheme. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Increase attendance of women in the Anganwadis where they can also avail of benefits of other schemes and be made aware of health and hygiene issues.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Reduction in stunting, Premature deliveries, and low-weight babies.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Agnipath Yojana

SHORT TITLE:
AY

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Defence

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Youth, Armed Forces, Military, Agniveer, Employment, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, Indian Army

DESCRIPTION:
A welfare scheme by the Department of Military Affairs, MoD under which rigorous military training will be imparted to the youth aged between 17.5 to 23 years and meeting other educational, physical, and medical criteria, who are aspirational to be a part of the armed forces.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Union Cabinet on 14th June 2022 approved an attractive recruitment scheme for Indian youth to serve in the Armed Forces called AGNIPATH and the youth selected under this scheme will be known as Agniveers. AGNIPATH allows patriotic and motivated youth to serve in the Armed Forces for a period of four years. The AGNIPATH scheme has been designed to enable a youthful profile of the Armed Forces.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '          "Agnipath Yojana" is a new HR Management scheme for the Armed Forces. Candidates inducted through this scheme will be called Agniveers. These Agniveers once enrolled into the Indian Air Force, will be governed under the Air Force Act 1950, for a period of four years. Endeavour will be made to enroll candidates as Agniveers from all parts of the nation, utilising contemporary technology (online STAR exam and associated testing methods), specialized rallies, and campus interviews at recognized technical institutes such as Industrial Training Institutes, NSQF, etc. Agniveers would form a distinct rank in the IAF, different from any other existing rank.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '           As part of the enrolment process, each ‘Agniveer’ will be required to formally accept all terms and conditions of the AGNIPATH Scheme. For personnel below the age of 18 years, the enrolment form will need to be signed by the parents/guardians, in accordance with extant provisions.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '        Post the period of four years, all Agniveers will go back to society. However, based on organizational requirements and policies promulgated by the IAF, Agniveers who have exited will be offered an opportunity to apply for enrolment in the IAF in the regular cadre. The skills gained by each Agniveer will be captured in a certificate to form part of his resume. These applications will be considered by a centralized board in a transparent manner and not more than 25% of the strength of the specific batch of original Agniveers will be enrolled in the IAF based on performance during their four-year engagement period as Agniveers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '           Agniveers will not have any right to be selected for further enrolment into the Armed Forces. Selection will be the exclusive jurisdiction of the Government. The enrolment as airmen into the regular cadre of Indian Air Force except for Medical tradesmen, will be available only to those personnel who have completed their engagement period as Agniveers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a citizen of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For the 2022 intake, the age of the applicant should be between 17.5 to 23 years. For the subsequent intakes, the age of the applicant should be between 17.5 to 21 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must fulfill the educational qualifications and physical and medical standards set by the Indian Army / Indian Navy / Indian Air Force.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The Agniveers will be enrolled in the Forces under respective Service Acts for a period of four years. The selection will be the exclusive jurisdiction of the Armed Forces.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' Agniveers will meet the medical eligibility conditions laid down for enrolment in the armed forces as applicable to respective categories/trades.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 05:'}, {'text': ' The educational qualification for Agniveers will remain as in vogue for enrollment in various categories.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Industrial Skill Development Allowance To The New Employees Employed In Industries In H.p

SHORT TITLE:
Isdane

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Himachal Pradesh

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Skill, Training, Youth, Allowance

DESCRIPTION:
The Industrial Skill Development Allowance scheme, as announced in the Budget Speech of the Hon'ble Chief Minister for the Financial Year 2018-19, aims to provide financial assistance to eligible individuals employed in industries in Himachal Pradesh for their on-the-job skill upgradation

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'a) The Industrial Skill Development Allowance scheme aims to support eligible Himachali youth in enhancing their skills while working in an Industry or Industrial Establishment. This scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to individuals seeking on-the-job skill upgradation opportunities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b) By participating in this scheme, the Himachali youth will have the chance to develop their skills and gain valuable experience in their respective employment sectors. This, in turn, will significantly enhance their employability prospects and open doors to better employment opportunities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'c) Under the provisions of this scheme, all apprentices and fresh recruits who meet the eligibility criteria will be entitled to receive the Industrial Skill Development Allowance. This allowance serves as a financial aid to assist the youth in meeting their living expenses while actively engaged in skill development activities within the industry. The scheme recognizes the importance of continuous skill enhancement and aims to support the youth in their pursuit of professional growth and development.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Age: The scheme is open to individuals between the ages of 18 and below 36 years. Those falling within this age range are eligible to participate in the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Educational Qualification: The scheme primarily targets individuals with limited formal education. The specific educational qualifications required may vary depending on the type of skill development program. Generally, individuals with lower levels of educational attainment are given priority.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Residence: The scheme is specifically designed for residents of Himachal Pradesh. Applicants must be permanent residents of the state to be eligible for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Employment Exchange Registration: Eligible individuals should be registered with the Employment Exchanges in Himachal Pradesh. This registration is necessary to avail the benefits and opportunities provided by the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Unemployed Status: The scheme primarily aims to provide skill development opportunities to unemployed individuals. Therefore, applicants should be currently unemployed and seeking employment to be eligible for participation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Skill Development: The scheme provides an opportunity for new employees in industries in Himachal Pradesh to upgrade their skills through on-the-job training. It enables them to gain practical experience and enhance their employability.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Better Employment Prospects: By participating in the scheme, eligible individuals can develop their skills and improve their chances of securing better employment opportunities. The scheme aims to equip them with the necessary skills demanded by industries, making them more competitive in the job market.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Inclusive Approach: The scheme does not impose any minimum educational qualification requirements, making it accessible to individuals with various educational backgrounds, including those with limited formal education. This inclusive approach ensures that even individuals with lower qualifications can benefit from the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Financial Support: Through the Industrial Skill Development Allowance, eligible participants receive a monthly allowance. This financial support helps them meet their living expenses while they focus on their skill development and training, reducing the financial burden during the learning period.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Disability Support: The scheme recognizes the needs of physically challenged individuals by providing them with a higher allowance rate if they have a minimum of 50% permanent disability. This provision promotes inclusivity and supports the skill development of persons with disabilities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Age Flexibility: The scheme caters to individuals aged 18 to below 36 years, providing an opportunity for young adults and those in their early career stages to enhance their skills. It targets the age group where skill development and employment opportunities are crucial for personal and professional growth.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}
