schemeName: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities
text:
SCHEME NAME: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities SHORT TITLE: SESUMC CATEGORY: Skills & Employment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Minority, Self Employment, Loan, Subsidy, Unemployed DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount (for loans ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh) to individuals belonging to minority communities, who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand, for the purpose of self-employment. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities” was launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount to individuals belonging to minority communities who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand. The grant is available when a loan of ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh is taken for starting self-employment activities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 55 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-, or the applicant should be a member of a BPL family.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, a grant is provided for self-employment. On taking a loan of ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh, a grant of 25% of the loan amount is given, with a minimum grant of ₹25,000/- and a maximum of ₹2,50,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The benefit of the scheme is available only on taking a loan, in which 60% of the project cost is provided as a loan, 25% as grant/subsidy by the department, and 15% as contribution by the applicant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Interest on the loan will be charged according to the current prevailing rates of the bank.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Advertisement is issued by the department to select the beneficiary. Thereafter, the application form can be obtained from the district offices of the state (District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the prescribed income certificate / BPL certificate, caste certificate, permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account details, and a project report for the proposed scheme. The completed application form should then be submitted to the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer of the concerned district.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Thereafter, an interview is conducted by a selection committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Chief Development Officer at the district level. The application forms of candidates who are successful in the interview are forwarded to the applicant’s bank for loan sanction.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After the bank sanctions the loan, the district office sends the application form to the corporation headquarters for the release of 25% of the grant amount upon completion of all formalities. The grant amount is made available to the district office after approval from the Managing Director at the Corporation Headquarters.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Thereafter, the district office, after receiving 15% of the beneficiary’s share, transfers 40% of the total amount to the concerned bank, after which the bank releases the loan to the applicant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Currently, the application process is offline, while the online process is under development.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '\n - Advertisement is issued by the department to select the beneficiary. Thereafter, the application form can be obtained from the district offices of the state (District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer).\n - Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the prescribed income certificate / BPL certificate, caste certificate, permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account details, and a project report for the proposed scheme. The completed application form should then be submitted to the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer of the concerned district.\n - Thereafter, an interview is conducted by a selection committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Chief Development Officer at the district level. The application forms of candidates who are successful in the interview are forwarded to the applicant’s bank for loan sanction.\n - After the bank sanctions the loan, the district office sends the application form to the corporation headquarters for the release of 25% of the grant amount upon completion of all formalities. The grant amount is made available to the district office after approval from the Managing Director at the Corporation Headquarters.\n - Thereafter, the district office, after receiving 15% of the beneficiary’s share, transfers 40% of the total amount to the concerned bank, after which the bank releases the loan to the applicant.\n\nCurrently, the application process is offline, while the online process is under development.\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 42)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf'} SLUG: msesu

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The "Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme" was launched by the Department of Labour, Employment & Training, Government of Jharkhand. text:
SCHEME NAME:
SITARE-Appreciation Grant

SHORT TITLE:
SITARE-AG

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
SITARE, Appreciation, Grant, Residential Workshop, BIIS, Undergraduate Student

DESCRIPTION:
SITARE-Appreciation Grant: Residential workshops called as Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) for undergraduate students are organized to provide hands-on technical training and mentorship for problem identification in 3-4 weeks duration.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '“Students Innovations for Translation & Advancement of Research Explorations (SITARE)” Scheme is started by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) for supporting innovative student projects in the area of biotechnology. The scheme’s mandate is to promote and encourage young students for embracing translational research to develop innovative products and technologies addressing unmet needs. The scheme has two components: SITARE-Gandhian Young Technological Innovation Award Grant (SITARE-GYTI) and SITARE-Appreciation Grant. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'SITARE-Appreciation Grant:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Residential workshops called as Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) for undergraduate students are organized to provide hands-on technical training and mentorship for problem identification in 3-4 weeks duration. Out of 30-40 students per workshop, 10 students are selected and provided grant support of up to INR 1 lakh each to encourage their inquisitiveness and sustained efforts. The recipients are recognized as BIRAC’s SITARE-Appreciation beneficiaries. In a year, 3 such workshops are conducted. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'About BIIS:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The mandate of Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) is to provide exposure and orientation for the entrepreneurial journey through hands-on-technical training, interactive sessions with experts, access to a bio incubation center, etc. This is to promote grassroots innovations and nurture ideas with societal impact, pioneered by undergraduate students, especially from Tier II/III cities. The selected few would receive financial support of INR 1 lakh as an encouragement to pursue their inquisitive entrepreneurial idea. The fund recipients would be recognized as SITARE-Appreciation recipients and may also receive follow-up training and mentoring.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The BIIS is a national-level programme to provide up to 4 weeks of residential training benefitting up to 40 students in each session.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Students pursuing Bachelors programme in any discipline are eligible to apply under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The student should have a valid ID issued by the Institution/University.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A student can avail of only one opportunity for BIIS workshop training across all SITARE Partners, except for the SITARE-Appreciation Award Grantees who will be eligible to avail access to subsequent workshops by other Partners on recommendation by SITARE Partner/BIRAC.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' The preference will be given to the students who are from Tier II/Tier III cities and aspirational districts within India.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Technical Internship Programme SHORT TITLE: TIP CATEGORY: Education & Learning, Skills & Employment LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Internship, Live Projects, Stipend, Engineering Students, NeGD Projects, Internship Certificate DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide practical technical experience through live projects. Under this programme, a 6-month internship with a stipend of ₹20,000/- per month is offered to eligible engineering students. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Technical Internship Programme” has been implemented by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, which offers students a valuable platform to gain practical experience in a real-world, professional environment. By working on live projects and collaborating with experienced professionals, interns develop critical technical and problem-solving skills. SCHEME NAME: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers SHORT TITLE: PMSTGC CATEGORY: Skills & Employment, Health & Wellness LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Training, Skill, Health, Certification DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. The scheme aims to bridge the gap in supply and increasing demand in the field of geriatric caregivers, provide more professional services to senior citizens, and create a cadre of professional caregivers in geriatrics. The scheme provides training in four specific job roles: Geriatric Caregiver (Institutional & Home Care), Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical), Elderly Care Companion, and Wellness Therapist for Elderly, with an emphasis on physical, mental, and overall well-being of the elderly through a multi-disciplinary approach, including on-job training for specific courses. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment with the help of the National Institute of Social Defence. DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to support livelihood enhancement in the Himalayan region through the application of need-based, eco-friendly technologies. These sessions, focused on skill development, aim to create awareness and equip trainees with techniques to improve their income generation capacities using low-cost and environmentally compatible tools. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana

SHORT TITLE:
CM YKY

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Arunachal Pradesh

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Youth, Training, Job, Stipend, Employment

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY)” was launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh on 1st April 2018 to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY)” has been launched in the state of Arunachal Pradesh with effect from 1 April 2018 to provide high-end training to youth across the country. The programme is fully funded under the state plan with a specific focus on providing job linked high end training programme to the youth. The objective of the scheme is to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Important Features: '}, {'text': 'There are 2 categories of training provided under CM YKY:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\tTraining within the state by inviting reputed Vocation Training Providers and providing them with suitable incentives.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '2.\tTraining outside the State by identifying high-end reputed Vocational Training Providers and courses.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe applicant should have a minimum qualification of class X.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme provides high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A guarantee of a minimum 70% placement to the youth.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A Stipend of ₹3000/- is to be given to the trainees undergoing the course.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Cost of Uniforms/ Books to be borne by the state government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Boarding and Lodging are to be provided during on-the Job Training within the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The boarding/ lodging, transportation cost, training fee, etc. shall be borne by the State Govt. @ ₹300/- per day per candidate if training to be outside the State.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A job portal for the youth, registration through which would provide a platform and linkage between prospective employers mostly from outside the State, and job seekers of the state in consultation with the Dept. of Labour & Employment'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Arrangement of Annual Skill Mela in the State of Arunachal Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Step 01: The applicant may contact the nearest Skill Centre under "Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana".'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Step 02: The applicant can get the application form at the concerned Skill Centre and fill the form completely.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Step 03: The applicant must ensure that the filled information should be correct before submitting the application form to the concerned authority.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Step 04: After successful verification, the applicant can avail of the benefit of the scheme and the amount of stipend through DBT mode.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'url': ''}

EXCLUSIONS:

{'title': 'Guideline', 'url': 'https://ahvdd.arunachal.gov.in/pdf/eBook/Government%20Scheme%20Handbook.pdf'}, {'title': 'Website', 'url': 'https://skillarunachal.nic.in//UserPortal/Home.aspx'}

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Reimbursement of Expenditure Incurred on Visa for Employment Abroad to Construction Workers is a scheme implemented in the state of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to construction workers who are seeking employment abroad. Under this scheme, registered construction workers in Rajasthan who have secured employment in foreign countries are eligible for reimbursement of expenses incurred on obtaining the necessary visa and related documentation. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To be eligible for this scheme, the construction worker must be registered with the Construction Workers Welfare Board in Rajasthan and provide proof of employment in a foreign country. This scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and support them in their efforts to secure employment opportunities abroad.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

For getting contract employment abroad, it is necessary to take permission for migration from the office of Protectors of Emigrants (POE) under the Migrant Act, 1983.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ' 2. It provides Grants-in-Aid to organisations and industry associations for conducting studies, seminars, and workshops. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Chemical Promotion Development Scheme" was launched by the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India. The scheme aims to facilitate the growth and development of the chemicals and petrochemicals industry by creating knowledge products, disseminating knowledge, and incentivizing research and innovation. The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid to conduct workshops, seminars, and studies, offering financial assistance up to ₹7,50,000/- for study reports and up to ₹7,00,000/- for two-day events. The applicant must be an eligible government agency, industry association, or specialized organisation, and non-governmental entities must be registered with NITI Aayog. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must schemeName: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme 

SHORT TITLE:
ESDP

CATEGORY:
Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Entrepreneurship, Skill Development, MSME, ESDP, Self-employment

DESCRIPTION:
The O/o DC-MSME under "Development of MSMEs" vertical has launched the "Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)". The Programme is being organized regularly to nurture the talent of youth by enlightening them on various aspects of industrial/business activity required for setting up 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The O/o DC-MSME under the "Development of MSMEs" vertical has launched the "Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)". The Programme is being organized regularly to nurture the talent of youth by enlightening them on various aspects of industrial/business activity required for setting up MSMEs. These Programmes are conducted for youth and other people interested in setting up their own industrial/self-employment venture. Such activities are also organized in ITIs, Polytechnics and other technical institutions/business schools, where skill/talent is available to motivate them towards self-employment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Aims and objectives:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To make aware/train entrepreneurial culture among people.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To motivate young persons (Men and Women) representing different sections of society, including SC, ST, Women and Physically Handicapped, Ex-Servicemen and BPL persons, to consider entrepreneurship or self-employment as one of the career options.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To enable the target group to think and act in an entrepreneurial way by imparting technical and business skills at an early stage in their career, so that it not only encourages them to consider entrepreneurship as a career opportunity but also helps them become successful in any profession.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To provide basic entrepreneurship training aimed at helping entrepreneurs to put their ideas into action, bring an attitudinal & behavioural change in the target group and build their personal entrepreneurial skills.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To provide advanced entrepreneurship and advanced management training aimed at helping entrepreneurs by providing high-end/advanced training in the domains of e-commerce, BPO, software, Biotech, Modern Agricultural & Animal Husbandry and processing, Drug Discovery, Genomics, Tech. acquisition from premier labs like BARC/CSIR/DRDO, etc. with the help of premier institutes such as IIMs/IITs/ICAR/CSIR/NIT/Administrative Training Institutes (ATIs), post harvesting and Food Processing institutes, Engineering Institutes, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To develop technical and vocational skills or upgrade existing skills of the target group.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To support the establishment of new MSMEs and enhance growth of existing ones which will result in improved productivity and job creation. The Implementing Agencies (IAs) will be entrusted with the task of Udyam Registration of ESDP beneficiaries.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To support MBA/Engineering students by providing opportunities for Vocational Training and in-depth study and outcome of a few typical ESDP programmes conducted, preparing a compendium of available technology with premier lab for dissemination of technology, etc. to MSMEs. Besides, they will be assigned other work which will be an opportunity to work in the Govt. setup. The hired students will be provided with an experience certificate and stipend.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The age of the participants will be 18 years and above.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Youth and other people interested in setting up their own industrial/business/self-employment venture.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The qualification of the participants and structure of the fees will be decided by the Implementing Agencies i.e. Director/Officer in charge of the programme conducting organization.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'About 40% of the targeted beneficiaries of E-SDPs should be from weaker sections of the Society (SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' Payment of fee will be exempted for SC, ST, Differently- Abled Persons, Ex-Servicemen, Below Poverty Line (BPL) category participants and women.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Assistance under the ESDP Scheme:'}, {'text': ' The programme includes the following modules-'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': '1.\tEntrepreneurship Awareness Programme (EAP): '}, {'text': 'One Day Entrepreneurship Awareness Programme is an activity to identify and motivate traditional/non-traditional entrepreneurs, who have the potential to set up MSEs with the objective of leading them towards entrepreneurship/self-employment. It consists of formal inaugural and technical sessions and one-to-one discussions with interested participants for counselling and mentoring. At least one EAP should be organized in each district. The intake capacity for the programme will be 50 to 100 persons.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': '2.\tEntrepreneurship-cum-Skill Development Programme (E-SDP)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Existing E-SDP:'}, {'text': ' This six-week activity is aimed at conducting special entrepreneurship development programmes for new livelihood enterprise creation and rural enterprise development. This is a product-cum-process oriented activity-based programme. Comprehensive training programmes will be organized to upgrade the skills of prospective entrepreneurs coupled with specific skills in hands-on practice or demonstration relating to activities. The programme is suitably tailored to the needs of trade or specific activity and the target group of trainees covered under the specific training programme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Advanced E-SDP:'}, {'text': ' The Minimum One-Week Advanced E-SDP Programme will have to be conducted with the intake capacity for the programme will be about 20 participants. The advanced ESOP programmes will be conducted through IIMs/IITs/ICAR/CSIR/BARC/IISC/NIT/Agricultural University of Central and State government etc. of repute will be roped in to provide ESDP training.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': '3.\tManagement Development Programme (MDP)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Existing MDP:'}, {'text': ' This one-week activity is aimed at capacity building of MSMEs through inputs on management practice systems to improve their decision-making capabilities resulting in higher productivity and profitability of existing and potential entrepreneurs and developing new enterprises. Inputs on a variety of topics of managerial functions will be provided to the participants by experts, which aim at the dissemination of knowledge of scientific/modern management techniques/practices. The intake capacity for the programme will be 25-30 participants. The age of the participants will be 18 years and above.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Advanced MOP:'}, {'text': ' The Minimum One-week Advanced MOP Programme will have an intake capacity for the programme will be about 25 participants. The Advance MDP Training Programmes will be conducted through State Administrative Training Institutes (ATIs) and/or other reputed institutions in this domain of Central or State Governments/NITs/Regional Engineering Colleges/Agricultural colleges/Autonomous bodies of Central/State Governments to provide MDP training to MSMEs promoters/executives. In this programme Central/State Governments (including the Ministry of MSME)/Bank officers and other stakeholders can also participate to enhance their knowledge with a minimum of 75% MSME participants.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The activities/programmes will be conducted through different field offices of the office of DC (MSME), MSME-DIs, Technology Centres and State Government Agencies, as approved by the Empowered committee headed by AS&DC( MSME) from time to time.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' Information on flagship programmes/schemes such as MUDRA, Start-up India and Stand-up India, ASPIRE, PMEGP and SC/ST Hub shall be provided to the participants.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' While providing in-puts on financing, a couple of sessions on alternate sources of funding like Angel Funding, Venture Capital, Crowd Funding etc. may be included in the programme syllabus.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' Some State Governments have introduced schemes for new entrepreneurs. Adequate care should be taken to provide information on these schemes as well.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 05:'}, {'text': ' Special programmes should be organized in Aspirational, Backward Districts and the North Eastern Region (NER) based on the local strength and potential.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 2, "label": "In Kind", "value": "in-kind"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Application Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The interested & eligible candidates may please contact the nearby MSME Development Institute, MSME-Technology Centre.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Addresses and contact details of these organizations are available on Web Portal: '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://dcmsme.gov.in/All_MSME_DIs_TCs.aspx'}], 'link': 'https://dcmsme.gov.in/All_MSME_DIs_TCs.aspx', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Procedure for selection of candidates:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': "Web-based MIS shall be developed for developing an integrated database of existing and potential entrepreneurs. Aadhaar's authenticated attendance is mandatory to prevent duplication of beneficiaries under the scheme. All the field offices of DC MSME shall be involved in identifying the candidates for the programme, through inviting online applications."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The minimum age of participants in the programmes should be 18 years. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)

SHORT TITLE:
PM-DAKSH

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Skill, Training, Employment, Stipend, Scheduled Caste, Other Backward Class, Economically Weaker Section

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme "PM-DAKSH", launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoSJ&E), aims to empower socially, educationally, and economically marginalized groups like SCs, OBCs, EWS, DNTs, Safai Mitras, and Waste Pickers by enhancing their skills through high-quality training.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi" (PM-DAKSH) scheme, launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India in 2020-21, is designed to uplift the marginalized sections of society by offering skill development programs. It targets SCs, OBCs, EWS, DNTs, and Safai Mitras, providing upskilling, reskilling, short-term training, and entrepreneurial development courses. The scheme aims to empower these groups by boosting their skills to improve their employability and income prospects. Training is aligned with the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF), and post-training support is provided for employment or self-employment opportunities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

schemeName: IT Saksham Yuva Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME:
IT Saksham Yuva Scheme 

SHORT TITLE:
ITSYS

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications, Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Haryana

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Employment Opportunity, IT Skills, Enterpreneurs, Startup, Unemployment Allowance, Saksham, Yuva

DESCRIPTION:
The Haryana Government is to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of a minimum of 3 months offered.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "IT Saksham Yuva Scheme" was launched by the Citizen Resources Information Department, Government of Haryana to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of minimum 3 months offered by Haryana State Electronics Development Corporation Limited (HARTRON), Haryana Knowledge Corporation Limited (HKCL), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), or any other agency notified by Government from time to time.       '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '        Under this scheme, skilled and eligible youths shall be given employment opportunities in various Departments/ Boards/ Corporations/Registered Societies/ Agencies, etc. under the Haryana Government or private entities. The first phase of the scheme shall provide employment opportunities to 5,000 youths in the State by training them through specially designed IT courses such as:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Secure coding in Java, DotNet, PHP, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'DBA in SQL, Postgre SQL, etc. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'UI/ UX design, web design'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Networking – Network support, LAN/ WAN '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Server Administration Microsoft/ Linux '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Web and mobile application development '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Digital Marketing & social media handling '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Any other course, in the field of Emerging Technologies, can be added as per need. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'This scheme is envisioned to provide the youth of Haryana a much-needed career-readiness for the digital world of work, and imbibement of desired skills necessary to enter effectively into the 21st Century workplaces in various digital domains. The Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID) will facilitate providing employment opportunities to these trained IT Saksham Yuva and the eligible applicant will be employed for up to 2 years. Based on the order of merit & role preference, the applicant would be employed in the Indenting Government / private entities on a first-come-first-serve basis.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The objective of the scheme is to position Haryana as a leading IT powerhouse by leveraging its human capital potential, fostering innovation, creating a conducive ecosystem for technology-driven growth, and strengthening e-governance in the State.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to the eligible youths of Haryana by training them under the IT program intended to upgrade their skills. This is further expected to enable the youth to develop their skill which in turn will give them the needed experience thereby enabling them to take up better employment or self-employments in the IT sector.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should be a domicile of Haryana having a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra ID.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant’s age should be between 18 to 35 years. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants should not be in any kind of employment e.g., public/government/private sector/ quasi-government or self-employment at the time of applying for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants should be graduate or post-graduate (B. Tech./ BCA/ BSc. IT) / (M.E./M. Tech./MCA/MSc IT/MBA IT) from recognized institutes/ colleges/ universities. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The candidates will be eligible for unemployment allowance only if the annual family income of the candidate does not exceed rupees three lakhs (₹ 3 lakhs) from all sources.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The unemployment allowance will only be commenced post 1 month from the Date of issuance of the passing certificate for the assessment test of the course completed. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Employment opportunities for unemployed youths.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Provides digital literacy and IT-related skills to improve employability.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Eligible candidates may receive an unemployment allowance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Entrepreneurial/Startup support after successful completion of employment tenure of one year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The eligible candidates who cleared/passed the exam will be given remuneration/allowance of ₹ 20,000/- pm (for first 6 months) / ₹ 25,000/- (7th month onwards). '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Note:- However, if the candidate has cleared/ passed the assessment test and is awaiting deployment, the unemployment allowances of ₹ 10,000/- pm will be paid by the CRID.'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1:'}, {'text': ' Check eligibility criteria before applying for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 2: '}, {'text': 'Visit the official website of the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'IT Saksham Yuva scheme'}], 'link': 'https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/HomePage.aspx', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 3:'}, {'text': ' Click on ‘Candidate Corner’ and register under the ‘Register Here’ tab.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 4: '}, {'text': 'Enter your Family ID Details and enter OTP.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 5: '}, {'text': 'Enter Basic Details, Education Details, IT Course Selection Details and upload the photograph.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 6: '}, {'text': 'Submit Fee Payment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '**Step 1:** Check eligibility criteria before applying for the scheme.\n**Step 2:** Visit the official website of the [IT Saksham Yuva scheme](https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/HomePage.aspx).\n**Step 3:** Click on ‘Candidate Corner’ and register under the ‘Register Here’ tab.\n**Step 4:** Enter your Family ID Details and enter OTP.\n**Step 5:** Enter Basic Details, Education Details, IT Course Selection Details and upload the photograph.\n**Step 6:** Submit Fee Payment.\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Applicants in any employment government/private are not allowed to apply to the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Once the eligible applicant crosses the age limit (35 years), as prescribed for employment under all the categories, the remuneration/allowance shall be immediately discontinued.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

REFERENCES:
{'title': 'Official Website', 'url': 'https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/'}, {'title': 'Guideline', 'url': 'https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/Docs/ITSYS_Scheme.pdf'}, {'title': 'Candidate Registration', 'url': 'https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/CandidateRegistration1.aspx'}, {'title': 'Candidate Login', 'url': 'https://infotechsakshamyuva.haryana.gov.in/CandidateLogin.aspx'}

SCHEME NAME: Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme SHORT TITLE: PMRDFS CATEGORY: Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Skills & Employment LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Rural Development SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Youth, Professional, Fellowship, Rural, Training DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide short term catalytic support to the District Administration in backward districts to improve programme delivery and simultaneously develop a cadre of Development Facilitators. Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme" by the Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, aims to provide a short-term work opportunity for young women and men who possess academic or professional expertise that will serve the district administration in improving programme delivery and interface with the marginalized section of the population, thereby aiming to reduce developmental and governance deficits. The scheme provides structured learning and hands-on professional experience in rural development and poverty reduction, offering Fellows opportunities to act as Development Facilitators and assist District Administration, particularly in backward districts, while participating in a post-graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessions, leading to a post-graduate degree in Development Practice.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a citizen of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The applicant's age must be between 22 years and 27 years at the time of application."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must hold at least a graduate degree from a recognized University with a four-year degree course.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must hold a post-graduate degree from a recognized University in case the graduate degree course duration was less than four years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The applicant's one-year post graduate course will also be considered valid for eligibility if it is regular, full time, and if the degree/equivalent diploma is recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education/Medical Council of India/University Grants Commission."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must have achieved at least 50% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade at the graduate or Post-graduate level, whichever is qualifying.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must possess physical fitness, certified by Government Medical Hospital, for the arduous nature of the work.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The maximum age limit will be 32 years for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe category.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Other Conditions', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'italic': True, 'text': '*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'italic': True, 'text': '*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Stipend Package', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Fellow shall be entitled to a consolidated stipend package of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) per month during the orientation period.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Fellow shall be entitled to ₹75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) per month during the first year of the Fellowship (post-orientation).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Fellow shall receive a 10% increment during the second year, subject to satisfactory performance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This package is deemed to cover the Fellow’s honorarium, boarding and lodging expenses during orientation, accommodation/house rent during the rest of the Fellowship period, health insurance, life and disability insurance cover, and any other contingency expenses.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Travel reimbursement will be based on actual costs and restricted to AC-II tier train fare by the shortest route or equivalent, plus local transport cost. Women Fellows with children below five years are allowed the travel cost of a care-giver if the care-giver accompanies the Fellow with her child.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Other Benefits', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Participation in a post graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessions leading to a post graduate degree in Development Practice.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Award of a Fellowship Certificate and an appropriate post graduate degree in Development Practice upon satisfactory completion of engagement and course requirements.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Office facilities made available by the District Collector, including suitable space, a computer/laptop, and internet connectivity free of charge.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Provision of suitable modes of transport by District administration while travelling within the district for regular work.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Disbursement of Stipend', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'heading_five'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'During the orientation programme, the stipend shall be paid by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society through the Programme Mentor.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Post-placement, the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society shall pay the monthly stipend to the Fellows by providing budgetary support to the State Rural Livelihood Mission society.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The State Rural Livelihood Mission society shall make direct deposits into the bank account of each Fellow immediately upon confirming the attendance of the Fellow from the District Collector at the end of the month.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The second-year increment is subject to the Fellow’s satisfactory performance as determined by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society in consultation with the Programme Mentor.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Conditions', 'underline': duration of the Fellowship, including the orientation period.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'italic': True, 'text': '*The Fellow shall not take up any type of employment with any other 'text': '*Failure to join or complete the required one year of public service mandates the Fellow to return to the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society the entire amount spent on academic \n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant, who has been provisionally selected in the final result sheet for Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellowship in an earlier stint, will not be allowed to avail the fellowship if he/she did not complete the full term of that prior Fellowship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s330ef30b64204a3088a26bc2e6ecf7602/uploads/2018/11/2018111655-1.pdf'} SLUG: pmrdfs

It offers reimbursement for 60% of training costs up to ₹60,000/- per trainee. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme” was launched by the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create manpower suitable to the needs of the Industry and to provide specific skill training to Goan youth to improve their employability by optimally utilizing the infrastructure available in Government and private institutions. The scheme provides reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees subject to a maximum of ₹60,000/- per employee and ₹7,20,000/- per unit per year. \n\n##### ***Step 1: Prepare and Submit a Training Proposal to the Skill Training Provider***\n\n- The employer shall draft and submit a detailed proposal for the training to the Skill Training Provider (STP), specifying the contents (theory and/or practical), duration, number of trainees, details of on-site training (if any), and the required physical infrastructure.\n- The approved STP will use this proposal to determine the course fees, which the employer must then pay.\n\n##### ***Step 2: Access and Complete the Application Form***\n\n- The applicant must obtain and fill out the [specified application format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/target-schemes.pdf) for the Incentives to Industries for Training Prospective Employees Scheme.- The form requires specific details, including the unit's registration number under the umbrella scheme, Skill Training Provider details, course name, number of eligible Goan trainees (aged 18 to 42 years), fees paid, and the amount claimed.\n\n##### ***Step 3: Submit the Claim Application and Supporting Documents***\n\n- The applicant shall submit the completed application form, along with all supporting documents listed in the scheme's checklist, to the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce.\n\n##### ***Scrutiny by the Task Force Committee***\nThe application will undergo scrutiny, and the eligible units will be recommended by the Task Force Committee (TFC).\n##### ***Reimbursement of Benefits***\nUpon successful recommendation and subject to budgetary allocation, the approved amount shall be disbursed to the eligible unit.\n##### ***Where to Apply***\nApplications should be submitted to the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce (DITC), Udyog Bhavan, Panaji.\n

text:
SCHEME NAME: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) SHORT TITLE: ASIIM CATEGORY: Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Youth, Scheduled Caste, Student, Incubation, Startup DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to boost entrepreneurship and innovation among SC students and SC differently-abled youth by providing focused support to translate innovative, technology-oriented business ideas into successful commercial enterprises. It offers equity funding and hand-holding support. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission" was launched on 30th September 2020, by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme aims to promote innovation and enterprise in Scheduled Caste students studying in higher educational institutions and to support 1,000 innovative ideas through synergistic work with the Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) set up by the Department of Science and Technology (DST). The scheme provides equity support to young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs so they can translate their start-up ideas into commercial ventures, with successful ventures potentially qualifying for venture funding. The scheme is implemented by the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC). Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections.\n**Step 3:** Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message.\n
\n\n##### ***Post-Application Processes***\n**Step 1:****** ***Recommendation and Submission of Proposals***\n\n- To identify potential entrepreneurs, Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) (set up under the aegis of the Department of Science and Technology) shall be contacted and informed to recommend potential young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs for assistance.\n- Other Technology and Management Schools shall also be contacted and informed for the purpose of recommending potential young entrepreneurs working in their Incubation Centres.\n- Other applications/proposals received directly from various Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Caste Divyang Start-ups will also be taken up as per the guidelines of the fund.\n\n**Step 2:****** ***Selection and Automatic Incubation***\n\n- The start-up ideas presented by Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Caste Divyang students that have been selected by the Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) will be automatically selected for incubation under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM).\n\n**Step 3:****** ***Company Formation and Compliance***\n\n- Prior to receiving assistance, selected participants who are not already incorporated must convert their Proprietary Firms, Partnership Firms, One Person Company (OPC), Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), or other establishments into a Private Limited or Public Limited company.\n- The incorporated company must ensure that the Scheduled Caste entrepreneur maintains at least a 51% shareholding, along with management control, which must be sustained until the assistance under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) remains in the company.\n\n
\n\n##### ***Fund Disbursement and Monitoring***\n\n- Financial assistance, provided as equity, Optionally Convertible Preference Shares (OCPS), or Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS), shall be released to the Companies promoted by these young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs.\n- The disbursement of equity assistance, which totals ₹30,00,000/- over 3 years (₹10,00,000/- annually), is contingent upon the satisfactory evaluation of the progress by the concerned Technology Business Incubator (TBI).\n\n##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support***\n\n- Official contact details for the Investment Manager, IFCI Venture Capital Funds Limited, are provided: 16th Floor, IFCI Tower, 61, Nehru Place, New Delhi – 110019.\n- Applicants can call 011 - 4173 2507/09/18/67/70/76/81/82/90 or 011 - 26453359/46/19/43.\n- The official email address for queries regarding the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) is asiim@ifciventure.com.\n- Additionally, a Grievance Redressal portal is available.\n\n

SCHEME NAME: The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme SHORT TITLE: GHLRS CATEGORY: Public Safety,Law & Justice, Skills & Employment LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Puducherry MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Researcher, Assistant, Law, Honorarium, Advocate, Legal DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to engage Legal Research Assistants to handle legal issues and court matters for major Departments of the Administration, thereby ensuring timely submission of defense documents and reducing departmental embarrassment in Courts. It gives fixed honorarium of ₹25,000/- per month. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme" was launched by the Law Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to address the high volume of cases before various fora where Departments find it very hard to submit their defense documents (Affidavits/Reply Statements/Counter Affidavits) at the appropriate time through the Law Officers, leading to officers of the Administration facing unnecessary embarrassment before the Courts. The scheme provides for engaging 15 Legal Research Assistants on a fixed honorarium for an initial period of two years, potentially extendable for one more year, in order to obtain the services of the best incumbents and to follow up all legal issues including Court matter pending. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Under Secretary to Government, Law Department, Chief Secretariat, Puducherry.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': schemeName: Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts

SHORT TITLE:
TKGTHE

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Kerala

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Tool Kit, Grant, Handicrafts, Self-employment, Training, Stipend, OBC, Craftsman

DESCRIPTION:
The “Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts” scheme is launched for the purpose for improving the productivity and competitiveness of the traditional OBC craftsmen ensuring quality goods for enhanced income and thereby qualitative improvement in their living conditions.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Introduction:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A sizeable population of OBCs is engaged in traditional occupations like handicrafts, jewellery making, metalwork, weaving, etc. Due to these low-paid occupations and due to modern technological intervention they face tough competition in the market which creates a feeling of inferiority and incapacity threatening their very existence. In order to have the traditional occupation as a sustainable self-employment and income-generating source for the families of traditional craftsmen their traditional skills need to be upgraded and they need to be equipped with modern technology to meet the market demands. The scheme is intended for the above purpose of improving the productivity and competitiveness of the traditional OBC craftsmen ensuring quality goods for enhanced income and thereby qualitative improvement in their living conditions.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '    There are several craftsman communities among OBCs such as Viswakarma, Padmasaliya chekkala etc. The Scheme envisages providing modern skill training and Tool  Kits for these groups.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Aims/Objectives:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\tTo create awareness among the skilled and semiskilled OBC workers on the need to adopt new technology in the highly technological era, for meeting the market needs.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tTo ensure sustainable self-employment for fair livelihood.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tTo ensure social justice through the overall economic development of the traditional craftsmen communities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Implementation:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Director, the Backward Communities Development Department will implement the scheme through Regional Deputy Directors of the Department. Tie-up shall be made with KSBCDC for training and loan for the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Monitoring and Evaluation:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Director, BCDD will monitor and evaluate the scheme periodically.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Traditional craftsmen community:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\tViswakaramas (Asari Chaptegra, Kallassary, Kalthachan, Kammala, Kamsala, Kannan, Karuvan, Kitaran, Kollan, Malayala Kammala, Moosari, Pandikammala, Pandithattan, Perumkolllan, Thachan, Thattan, Vilkurup, Villasan, Viswabrahmanan or Viswabrahmanar and Viswakarmala)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tSaliya, Chaliya (Chaliya)'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tTholkollans'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tMoopar or Kallan Mooppan or Kallan Mooppar.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe applicant should be a permanent resident of the Kerala State.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe applicant should belong to the State Backward Communities of Kerala State.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tThe applicant should be engaged in traditional craftwork/skilled work.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tThe upper age limit of the applicant should be 60 years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5.\tThe annual family income of the applicant should be ₹1,00,000/-.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' Those having more than two girl children shall get preference.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02: '}, {'text': 'The differently abled person shall get preference.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' Those having more than 10 years of experience shall get preference.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tThe training costs, stipend (if found necessary), and tool kit grant together shall be limited to ₹25000/-.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe training and stipend portion is limited to ₹5000/-.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tThe maximum period of training will be three months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The focus will be on machinery and equipment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The tools developed by reputed institutions will be encouraged amongst the craftsmen.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' The choice of tools and machinery will be based on the occupation.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04'}, {'text': ': The beneficiaries can freely select whichever agency to procure equipment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 05:'}, {'text': ' The grant is for modernization of traditional occupation i.e. for procurement of modern tools and machinery.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 06:'}, {'text': ' The grant should not be used as working capital.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' The application will be invited through public notification in all the leading news dailies. If it is necessary an advertisement will be published.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' The applicants should apply in the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'prescribed form'}], 'link': 'https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/8-01.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' with all relevant documents and submit it to the Regional Deputy Director.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' On receipt of the applications, the scrutiny will be carried out at the Regional level.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:'}, {'text': ' A draft list will be prepared on the basis of certificates and preliminary field inquiries. This will be subjected to further scrutiny by the Director, BCDD and a final list will be drawn up.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' Those selected will undergo training in their respective field of work if it is necessary.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The training will be arranged in various localities of the state according to the number of applicants.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' Those who successfully complete the training or those who already have the competency to adopt the new technology for each work will be selected for a tool kit grant. The choice of tools will be vested with the applicant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' The cash bill for the tools purchased has to be submitted to the Department and the Department will reimburse the eligible amount to the concerned beneficiaries.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Address for applying:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Applicants from Trivandrum to Ernakulam:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Regional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development Department'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Civil Station, 2nd Floor, Kakkanad'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Ernakulam- 682030'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Applicants from Thrissur to Kasargode:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Regional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development Department'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Civil Station, Kozhikide- 673020'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The application will be invited through public notification in all the leading news dailies. If it is necessary an advertisement will be published.\n**Step 02:** The applicants should apply in the [prescribed form](https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/8-01.pdf) with all relevant documents and submit it to the Regional Deputy Director.\n**Step 03:** On receipt of the applications, the scrutiny will be carried out at the Regional level.\n**Step 04:** A draft list will be prepared on the basis of certificates and preliminary field inquiries. This will be subjected to further scrutiny by the Director, BCDD and a final list will be drawn up.\n**Step 05:** Those selected will undergo training in their respective field of work if it is necessary.\n**Note 01:** The training will be arranged in various localities of the state according to the number of applicants.\n**Note 02:** Those who successfully complete the training or those who already have the competency to adopt the new technology for each work will be selected for a tool kit grant. The choice of tools will be vested with the applicant.\n**Note 03:** The cash bill for the tools purchased has to be submitted to the Department and the Department will reimburse the eligible amount to the concerned beneficiaries.\n> **Address for applying:**\n\n**Applicants from Trivandrum to Ernakulam:**\nRegional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development Department\nCivil Station, 2nd Floor, Kakkanad\nErnakulam- 682030\n**Applicants from Thrissur to Kasargode:**\nRegional Deputy Director, Backward Classes Development Department\nCivil Station, Kozhikide- 673020\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{'title': 'Official Website', 'url': 'https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/en/schemes/development-schemes/toolkit-grant/'}, {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/8-02.pdf'}, {'title': 'Application Form', 'url': 'https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/8-01.pdf'}, {'title': 'Agreement Model', 'url': 'https://bcdd.kerala.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/8-03.pdf'}

SCHEME NAME:
Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers

SHORT TITLE:
ATPM

CATEGORY:
Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Kerala

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Financial Assistance, Pottery, OBC, Pottery Worker

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers” provides financial assistance to Traditional Pottery makers belonging to the state OBC category for the purchase of modern machinery for job modernization.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Certain communities among the Other Backward Classes are engaged in traditional occupations including pottery. Traditional pottery workers are following conventional methods for manufacturing products and face tough competition in the market. In this circumstance, this traditional industry has to be revived by imparting training to pottery workers on modern methods/techniques of production and also by providing financial assistance to mechanize and modernize the sector.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In view of the above, the scheme “Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers” is launched by the Backword Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala. State

Bihar

Individual

Social Security, Unorganised Worker, Craftsmen

DESCRIPTION:
“Total Permanent Disability” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹75,000/- to the families of workers or craftsmen in case of permanent disablement.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” launched by the Labour Resources Department, Bihar, aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years."}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note', 'underline': True}, {'bold': True, 'text': ': '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': "Applicant's age will be calculated as of the 1st of July of any year."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Total Permanent Disability: '}, {'text': 'Total permanent disability means that due to an accident, both the eyes or both hands or both legs of a worker or artisan become useless or one eye, one hand and one leg become useless. Apart from this, if both the eyes become useless due to paralysis or the brain stops working, then it will also be considered as permanent disability.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Financial Assistance:'}, {'text': ' ₹75,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Aama Kuni Pilaa” has been launched by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Odisha. SCHEME NAME: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition SHORT TITLE: MSPYMN CATEGORY: Women and Child, Health & Wellness LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Pregnant Woman, Lactating Mother, Take Home Ration, Nutrient Rich Food, Daily Ration, Mother DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Maternal Nutrition” scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" scheme, introduced by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state. Additionally, essential services such as antenatal care (ANC) check-ups during Mamata Diwas, immunisation, and IFA and calcium supplementation are also provided. schemeName: PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment
text:
SCHEME NAME:
PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment

SHORT TITLE:
PM POSHAN

CATEGORY:
Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry of Education

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
School, Children, Health, Govt Scheme, Nutrition India

DESCRIPTION:
PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to the children studying in Government and Government – aided schools. The Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to the children studying in Government and Government – aided schools. The Scheme is implemented across the country covering all the eligible children without any discrimination of gender and social class. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The main objectives of the PM POSHAN Abhiyaan are to address two of the pressing problems for the majority of children in India, viz. hunger and education by improving the nutritional status of eligible children in Government and Government-aided schools as well as encouraging poor children, belonging to disadvantaged sections, to attend school more regularly and help them concentrate on classroom activities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'POSHAN Abhiyaan is one of the many schemes under the umbrella scheme "Integrated Child Development Services Scheme (ICDS)". ICDS also includes Anganwadi Services Scheme, Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, and Scheme for Adolescent Girls.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a citizen of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be studying in a Primary or Upper Primary class (Class 1st to Class 8th) in a Government or a Government-aided school.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Nutrition norm per child per day:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Primary: Calorie – 450; Protein - 12 gms'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Upper Primary: Calorie – 700; Protein - 20 gms'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Food norms per child per day:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Primary: Food grains - 100 gms; Pulses - 20 gms; Vegetables - 50 gms; Oil & fat - 5 gms, Salt & condiments - As per need.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Upper Primary: Food grains - 150 gms; Pulses - 30 gms; Vegetables - 75 gms; Oil & fat – 7.5 gms, Salt & condiments - As per need.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Under the Scheme, there is the provision of hot cooked meals to children of pre-schools or Bal Vatika (before class I) in primary schools also in addition to the 11.80 crore children of classes I to VIII studying in 11.20 lakh schools.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"label": "In Kind", "value": "in kind"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'text': 'There is no application process for this scheme. PM POSHAN is equally applicable to all children who are studying in Government and Government – aided schools.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'There is no application process for this scheme. PM POSHAN is equally applicable to all children who are studying in Government and Government – aided schools.\n', 'url': ''}

EXCLUSIONS:

{'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://www.india.gov.in/spotlight/poshan-abhiyaan-pms-overarching-scheme-holistic-nourishment'}, {'title': 'PIB', 'url': 'https://pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1812421#:~:text=The%20Government%20has%20approved%20the,by%20the%20Ministry%20of%20Education.'}
