SCHEME NAME: AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens SHORT TITLE: AVYAY-NAPSC-HSSC CATEGORY: Housing & Shelter, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Shelter, Healthcare, Welfare, Senior Citizen, Health DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior Citizens, particularly those who are indigent, by providing basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and entertainment opportunities. The scheme provides financial assistance for projects such as maintenance of Senior Citizen Homes. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The scheme is a component of the umbrella scheme " Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)". The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior Citizens, particularly those who are indigent, by providing basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and entertainment opportunities. existing homes and upload the details of Gap Districts or Districts of having insufficient capacity onto the [E-anudaan Portal.](https://grants-msje.gov.in/)- If the State/Union Territory Government records that it is unable to establish the Home on its own, the Central Government publishes an open notification inviting applications with wide publicity.\n\n##### ***Step 2: Submission of Proposal***\n\n- **New Proposals:** All fresh proposals for project sanction must be submitted online on the E-anudaan portal in the prescribed proforma along with relevant documents within the stipulated timeline.- **On-going/Renewal Proposals:** Applications for the release of grants must be made in the prescribed proforma along with relevant documents and the Utilization Certificate of expenditure from the previous Financial Year before April 30th each year.\n##### ***Step 3: Verification and Approval***\n\n- **District Level Authentication:** Once uploaded, the proposal is made available to the Central Ministry and the District Administration/State Government level for examination. The District Collector (or representative) is required to authenticate all certificates submitted by the applicant.- **Recommendation:** District Administration/State Government shall recommend New/Fresh proposals, along with Inspection reports, by June 15th each year.- **Screening and Sanction:** The Screening Committee meeting is held by June 20th each year to assess and recommend new proposals based on fund availability. After approval by the Secretary, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment and concurrence of the Finance Division, sanction orders are issued by the programme division in one lot by June 25th each year.\n##### ***Step 4: Fund Disbursement***\n\n- **First Instalment Release:** Grants should be released before June 30th each year. The total annual grant is released in two equal half-yearly instalments.- **Recurring Grant Calculation:** Recurring Grant-in-aid is calculated based on the number of days of attendance of beneficiaries, using a contactless IT system that seamlessly ports data into the E-anudaan portal.- **Second Instalment Release:** The second half-yearly instalment (balance based on attendance) is released before December 31st each year, only after the inspection report of the State Government, Central Ministry officers, or the Project Monitoring Unit is received.\n

The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'Launched on 12th February 2022, “Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons” is a component of the “Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons” sub-scheme of the “Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE)” scheme. The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide health Insurance coverage to all Transgender persons living in India to improve their health condition through proper treatment including sex re-assignment surgeries as well as medical support. The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus, inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery and comprehensive transition-related healthcare, covering hormone therapy and post-operation formalities, redeemable at all private and government healthcare facilities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be Transgender.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not be availing similar benefits from any other schemes of the Central Government or State Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Health insurance cover of ₹5,00,000/- (Five Lakh Rupees) per year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Coverage is provided in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus health insurance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Coverage is inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery within the health benefit package under Ayushman Bharat Yojana.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The comprehensive package covers all aspects of transition related healthcare for Transgender persons.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Coverage specifically includes hormone therapy and Sex Re-assignment surgery inclusive of post operation formalities.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Treatment for the beneficiary shall be cashless. It benefits rural population by offering essential laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography services without charge at nearby government healthcare centers. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 2015-16, the scheme "Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana" (also known as "Free Laboratory Testing Scheme") by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide quality diagnostic facilities without charge at all government health institutions and ensure timely and accurate diagnosis of diseases like malaria, tuberculosis, cancer, diabetes, hypertension to reduce morbidity and mortality in communities. The scheme provides free essential pathology, biochemistry, hematology, microbiology testing services at all government health institutions and strengthens existing laboratory facilities with quality equipment and trained staff along with regular supply of reagent kits. The applicant must be seeking healthcare services at government health facilities and require diagnostic testing for medical conditions. The scheme is implemented through a three-tier healthcare structure consisting of Sub Health Centers, Primary Health Centers, Community Health Centers, Sub-District Hospitals, District Hospitals and Medical Colleges with a total budget allocation of ₹200.94 crores, and applications are accepted offline at respective government healthcare facilities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance for the treatment of ex-servicemen and their dependents (wife & children) who have a disability of 40% or more and are suffering from serious illnesses such as cancer, leprosy, tuberculosis, kidney and cardiac ailments, paralysis, etc.

DESCRIPTION:
Gujarat Chief Minister Shri Vijay Rupani here today announced the Atal ‘Screening of Newborn for Enhancement of Health’ (SNEH) Yojna to be started in the state from the former Prime Minister Atal Behari Vajpayee’s birthday on December 25, 2016.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Detailed '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Atal Sneh Yojana in Gujarat is the scheme that has launched on the 25th of December 2016 on the occasion of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s ninety-second birthday. The scheme is launched by the Chief Minister of Gujarat, Mr. Vijay Rupani. The scheme will look forward to a healthy child after their birth. It was decided at the Gandhinagar Civil Hospital and it will look upon the children up to two months after their birth.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After focusing on the health of the children and covering some major diseases the government has now shifted its focus to core issues. Basically, the Atal Sneh Yojana will replace the decades-old Annual School Program which was being carried out by the health and education departments.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For this new scheme, newborn children will be screened specifically to look for health defects and improve them. This is being launched wide across Gujarat. Under this scheme, the newborn kids will be screened and given treatment immediately if there is any illness found. It will be carried out for two long months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Through this scheme, children can be provided with better health. Better health will lead to avoiding malnutrition, disorders, and diseases.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Around seven percent of newly born babies every year are suffering from certain disorders and that has created a serious issue in the international platform. So by preventing such trouble, the country can be in a better position in international health conferences.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'With such schemes, the government is also looking for a stronger young generation and this young generation would lead to having a stronger nation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'some of the dire diseases kids suffer from'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The children suffer from some very grave diseases such as complicated birth defects such as Down’s syndrome, congenital deafness, club foot, neural tube defect, etc.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'These are not all. There are some diseases, which are there present in the dormant state within the genes. By checking the kids at their tender age, the doctors will be able to better treat them.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Chief Minister of the state launched that all of the diseases that are detected at the maternity homes by the government will be taken care of by the government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'All Newborn children are eligible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Age should be up to two months after their birth.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Benefit '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'In this scenario, the newborn children will be referred to a doctor. If the case is not very serious, then they will be referred to a local facility for treatment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Children who are ill or born with some genetic diseases will receive proper treatment from experts. They will also receive follow-ups after their treatment from family health workers.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The newborn babies will get a thorough health checkup from these health workers and the Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK). This will be done at both private and government hospitals.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If there are noninstitutionalized deliveries that have taken place, then the social health care activists and the RBSK members will arrange a proper screening for the child in their center.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Minister of State for Health in Gujarat has also announced that there will be a special cochlear implant surgery provided to kids that are being born with hearing and speech impairment.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The funds for reimbursement are drawn from various sources, including destitute funds collected at the district level, Public Health and Family Welfare Department funds, District Rogi Kalyan Samiti funds, District Red Cross Society Treasury funds, or amounts collected from social workers and donors.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '##### **Step 1:****** ***Application Submission to District Authorities***\n\n- Such eligible disabled persons must obtain and fill out the required [application form](https://sparsh.mp.gov.in/Common/SJ/PDFFiles/form-sgry.PDF), which includes providing personal details, residency information, citizenship status, family details, disability nature and percentage, annual income proof, and details of the recommended surgery. - The applicant must submit their complete application along with all required documents to the Joint Director or Deputy Director, Panchayat and Social Justice at the district level.\n\n##### **Step 2:****** ***Submission to Medical Authorities for Authentication***\n\n- The applications that have been received from each side by the District Magistrate will subsequently be submitted to the nearest Medical College or District Hospital for official authentication and recommendation. \n- The hospital or institution must also provide a recommendation that includes the estimated expenditure on the surgical treatment.\n\n##### **Step 3:****** ***Approval by District Collector***\n\n- Based on the necessary recommendation provided by the Medical College or District Hospital, the proposed surgery will proceed only upon receiving the final approval from the District Collector.\n\n##### **Step 4:****** ***Reimbursement/Financial Assistance Disbursement***\n\n- Financial assistance is provided through the reimbursement of expenses incurred on the surgery of eligible disabled persons. \n- The funds for reimbursement are drawn from various sources, including destitute funds collected at the district level, Public Health and Family Welfare Department funds, District Rogi Kalyan Samiti funds, District Red Cross Society Treasury funds, or amounts collected from social workers and donors.\n\n

DESCRIPTION:
The “National Post Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF)” was launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Government of India to identify motivated young researchers and provide them support for doing research in frontier areas of science and engineering.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “National Post Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF)” was launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Government of India to identify motivated young researchers and provide them support for doing research in frontier areas of science and engineering. The fellows will work under a mentor, and it is hoped that this training will provide them with a platform to develop as independent researchers.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment and is tenable for a period of 2 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be an Indian citizen.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must have obtained PhD/M.D/M.S degree from a recognized University. Those who have submitted their PhD/M.D/M.S. thesis and are awaiting the award of the degree are also eligible to apply. However, such candidates, if selected, will be offered a lower fellowship amount till they qualify for the eligible degree.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The upper age limit for the fellowship is 35 years at the time of the submission of the application, age will be calculated by taking the date of closure of the respective call. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'NPDF can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The mentor must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India. Should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A mentor shall not have more than two SERB NPDF fellows at any given time.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized academic institutions, national laboratories, and other recognized R&D institutions. The host institution should provide the necessary administrative and infrastructural support.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The fellows will not be allowed to work with the Ph.D. guide/co-guide. It is also normally not availed at the same Department/institution where the candidates have earned their PhD/M.S./M.D degree.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'The fellows will be entitled to receive the grants as given below:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Sl. No.'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Budget Head'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Amount'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}], 'type': 'table_row'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Fellowship'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': '₹55,000/- per month (consolidated) and ₹35,000/- per month for candidates who have submitted the thesis but degree not awarded'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}], 'type': 'table_row'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '2'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Research Grant'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': '₹2,00,000/- per annum'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}], 'type': 'table_row'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '3'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Overheads'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}, {'children': [{'text': '₹1,00,000/- per annum'}], 'type': 'table_cell'}], 'type': 'table_row'}], 'type': 'table'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01: '}, {'text': 'Research grants can be used for minor equipment, consumables, contingencies, and domestic travel. There is no provision for providing research personnel support under this scheme. The Fellow is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the fellowship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Governmental source during the tenure of the fellowship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' The fellows must seek the consent of SERB if he/she intends to be away from the implementing institute (except for field work related to the project) continuously for a period of more than eight weeks.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Leave:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'SERB PDFs are entitled to leave as per the rules of the host institution. Maternity leave as per the Govt. of India instructions issued from time to time would be available to female candidates in all categories.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

After login, the Mentor is required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile. which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute Address, etc.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 06'}, {'text': ': Details including Project Title (max 500 characters), Project summary (max 3000 characters), Keywords (max 6), Objectives of the project (max 1500 characters), Expected output and outcome of the proposal (max 1500 characters) should be provided online at the time of submission of the application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 07'}, {'text': ': Work Methodology and Research plan has to be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 3 pages (max 10 MB).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01: '}, {'text': 'Please ensure that your proposed Mentor is registered into the system by following the same procedure as PI. After login, the Mentor is required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute Address, etc.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' Applicants of NPDF can submit their proposal only once in a calendar year in any of these schemes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Selection Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selection will be based on the recommendations of an Expert Committee that will be constituted by the Board. If required, the applicants may be called for personal interviews.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Termination of the Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'If any fellow wishes to terminate the fellowship, he/she shall inform the SERB through the mentor and host institute immediately. The implementing institute should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the PI. The institute will also arrange for the submission of the documents mentioned above.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'SERB reserves the right to terminate the Fellowship at any stage if it is convinced that appropriate progress is not being made or the grant has not been utilized properly.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}, {'children': [{'text': 'Complete guidelines for Principal Investigator for SERB-online system'}], 'link': 'https://www.serbonline.in/SERB_Help/pi/Multiscreen_HTML5/desktop/Login.htm', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '> **Application Process:**\n\n**Step 01:** The call for applications for SERB-N PDF will be notified through the website [www.serbonline.in](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/npdf?HomePage=New) and [https://serb.gov.in/](https://serb.gov.in/page/awards_fellowship#National%20Post%20Doctoral%20Fellowship)\n**Step 02**: The application form along with a research proposal highlighting the objectives of the research work to be undertaken should be submitted online through the website [www.serbonline.in](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/npdf?HomePage=New)\n**Step 03:** Applicants should first register on the online website, [click here to register](https://serbonline.in/SERB/Registration)\n**Step 04:** After login, applicants are required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile. which includes Bio-data, Photos, Institute Address, etc.\n**Step 05:** Please ensure that your proposed Mentor is registered into the system by following the same procedure. After login, the Mentor is required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile. which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute Address, etc.\n**Step 06**: Details including Project Title (max 500 characters), Project summary (max 3000 characters), Keywords (max 6), Objectives of the project (max 1500 characters), Expected output and outcome of the proposal (max 1500 characters) should be provided online at the time of submission of the application.\n**Step 07**: Work Methodology and Research plan has to be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 3 pages (max 10 MB).\n**Note 01:** Please ensure that your proposed Mentor is registered into the system by following the same procedure as PI. After login, the Mentor is required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute Address, etc.\n**Note 02:** Applicants of NPDF can submit their proposal only once in a calendar year in any of these schemes.\n> **Selection Process:**\n\nThe selection will be based on the recommendations of an Expert Committee that will be constituted by the Board. If required, the applicants may be called for personal interviews.\n> **Termination of the Fellowship:**\n\n\n  - If any fellow wishes to terminate the fellowship, he/she shall inform the SERB through the mentor and host institute immediately. The implementing institute should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the PI. The institute will also arrange for the submission of the documents mentioned above.\n  - SERB reserves the right to terminate the Fellowship at any stage if it is convinced that appropriate progress is not being made or the grant has not been utilized properly.\n\n[Complete guidelines for Principal Investigator for SERB-online system](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB_Help/pi/Multiscreen_HTML5/desktop/Login.htm)\n'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence

SHORT TITLE:
TARE

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
TARE, Teacher, Research, Faculty, Fellowship, SERB

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate mobility of faculty members working in State Universities /Colleges/Private Academic institutions.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate the mobility of faculty members working in a regular capacity in State Universities / Colleges and in private Academic Institutions to carry out research work in an established public-funded central institution such as IITs, IISc, IISERS, National Institutions (NITs, CSIR, ICAR, ICMR labs and other central institutions) and Central Universities, located preferably nearer to the institution where the faculty member is working. Research work will be carried out in such a manner to ensure that the PI continues to work in the host institute as well as his / her parent institute on mutually agreed terms between the PI and Mentor.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Areas Covered under the scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme covers areas under Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, and Mathematical Sciences, including interdisciplinary areas.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Support:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of support is three years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Indian citizens residing in India holding a Ph.D. degree in Science/Engineering or MS/MD in Medicine are eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/ Colleges and private Academic Institutions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should not hold any ongoing research projects or any fellowship at the time of submission of application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The upper age limit for the award is 45 years at the time of the submission of the application. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Mentor should be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist E, or higher level.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Only one candidate will be allowed to work with a mentor at any given point of time. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Research fellowship of ₹60,000/- per year (in addition to the researcher’s own salary) will be provided subject to completion of a minimum of 90 days of research work per year in the host institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Research grant of ₹5 lakhs per annum (50% each to host and parent institution) and overheads (as per SERB norms) will be provided.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Training/Capacity Building Programmes/Research work on Remote Sensing and GIS Applications” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Space Application Centre (USAC) under the Science and Technology, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to strengthen scientific and technical capacity of researchers, students, and government personnel in the field of Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (GIS) applications by providing training, conducting capacity-building programmes, and supporting research initiatives.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The following are eligible to participate in the Training and Capacity Building Programme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Students who have passed a Postgraduate degree (preferably in the Science stream) with First Division from any recognized university in India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Final semester/year postgraduate students (preferably from the Science stream) of any recognized university (private, state, or central) in India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Personnel from the Central Government and various line departments of the State Government.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Graduate and higher-level students from government, private, and central universities or colleges within the state.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Researchers are selected for scientific research projects funded by the Central and State Governments and trained in Remote Sensing and GIS applications. Researchers are required to make their own arrangements for food and accommodation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The program also offers training in Remote Sensing and GIS applications to postgraduate students in their final semester/year of study at various universities across the state, as well as to undergraduate students through internships. Upon successfully qualifying in the interview, the researchers are awarded a research fellowship. - The Vice-Chancellor/Dean/Registrar/Head of Department of the concerned University sends a request letter to the Director, U-SAC, on behalf of the final semester/year postgraduate students (mainly from the science stream) for dissertation/internship at the Centre. Based on this request, and upon receiving the recommendation from the Director, U-SAC, the students are invited for training. For registration, the trainees are required to submit all necessary documents such as Aadhaar card, educational certificates, and mobile number.\n - Departmental personnel may send a request letter to the Director, U-SAC, through their respective Head of Department. text:
SCHEME NAME:
KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme 

SHORT TITLE:
KSCSTE-ESS 

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Kerala

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Emeritus, Scientist, Superannuated, Research, Fellowship

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide opportunity to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective field of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of State.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide an opportunity for superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective fields of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of the State. Scientists/Academicians from Kerala State in the field of Science/Engineering who have retired from service or completed their assignments from reputed institutions with research publications in reputed journals are eligible to apply. Selection through review/evaluation by an expert committee.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives of the scheme:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Tap knowledge and provide support to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective fields of specialization.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To utilize their talent and use their experience in addressing state-level important issues.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should be a Permanent Resident of Kerala.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Candidates should be retired scientists/academicians in Kerala by birth or domicile and should have worked as a scientist/academician in reputed institutions with commendable scientific achievements.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Candidate should apply within 5 years of superannuation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The candidate should have published a minimum of 3 peer-reviewed research papers with SCI-indexed journals with an impact factor greater than 2.0 or should have filed at least one patent in the last 3 years of application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Those who have availed Emeritus Scientist Fellowship earlier (from KSCSTE or elsewhere) are not eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Research Centre selected for the proposed work should be the R&D Centres of KSCSTE.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Selected candidates are eligible for:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1.\tMonthly fellowship of ₹31,000/- for a maximum period of 3 years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tAn annual Contingent grant of ₹1,00,000/- eligible for the entire project duration.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tTechnical Assistance in the form of a Project Fellow can be appointed to support research activity.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tFellowship will be given for a period not exceeding three years, (Maximum duration of the project - 3 Years).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Eligible applicants may apply online in the KSCSTE Web Portal for New applications at the following link: '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/'}], 'link': 'https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scrutiny of the Application:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Preliminary scrutiny of the application is carried out for verification of basic eligibility conditions and supporting documents.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Peer review:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'All eligible applications are subjected to peer review by five subject experts (3 within & 2 outside the state) in the relevant area of research. Proposals with at least three reviews graded greater than 5 (on 10 point scale) are only considered for further processing.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Presentation before Expert Committee:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Proposals that have passed the peer review requirements will be invited for presentation before the Programme Advisory Committee. One or two reviewers will serve as additional Subject Expert during the PAC meeting. On favorable recommendation by the PAC, the proposal will be considered for funding by KSCSTE. The applicants will be informed of the decision and will be asked to execute an Agreement as per the guidelines of the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Contact Details:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Scientist-in-charge (KSCSTE-ESS), Kerala State Council for Science Technology and Environment,'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695004,'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Tel: +91 471 2548402, E-mail : jaya.kscste@kerala.gov.in, sasthrabodhini2011@gmail.com'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'For queries:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'E-mail : jaya.kscste@kerala.gov.in, sasthrabodhini2011@gmail.com'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Tel: 0471-2548402'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': 'Eligible applicants may apply online in the KSCSTE Web Portal for New applications at the following link: [https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/](https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/)\n> **Scrutiny of the Application:**\n\nPreliminary scrutiny of the application is carried out for verification of basic eligibility conditions and supporting documents.\n> **Peer review:**\n\nAll eligible applications are subjected to peer review by five subject experts (3 within &amp; 2 outside the state) in the relevant area of research. Proposals with at least three reviews graded greater than 5 (on 10 point scale) are only considered for further processing.\n> **Presentation before Expert Committee:**\n\nProposals that have passed the peer review requirements will be invited for presentation before the Programme Advisory Committee. One or two reviewers will serve as additional Subject Expert during the PAC meeting. On favorable recommendation by the PAC, the proposal will be considered for funding by KSCSTE. The applicants will be informed of the decision and will be asked to execute an Agreement as per the guidelines of the scheme.\n> **Contact Details:**\n\nScientist-in-charge (KSCSTE-ESS), Kerala State Council for Science Technology and Environment,\nSasthra Bhavan, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695004,\nTel: +91 471 2548402, E-mail : jaya.kscste@kerala.gov.in, sasthrabodhini2011@gmail.com\n> **For queries:**\n\nE-mail : jaya.kscste@kerala.gov.in, sasthrabodhini2011@gmail.com\nTel: 0471-2548402\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:

DESCRIPTION:
The Mobility Scheme is aimed to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city).

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. Any proposals that fail to meet the foundational legal, financial, and technical prerequisites are systematically filtered out at this stage.\n**Step 5:** The applicant must professionally present the comprehensive proposal before the Selection Committee for Biofoundries and Biomanufacturing Hubs. The successfully selected beneficiary must then sign the necessary grant agreements to formally initiate the biomanufacturing project.\n**Step 8:** The applicant will undergo continuous performance monitoring facilitated by the Project Monitoring Committee to ensure milestone adherence. Third-party evaluations will additionally be carried out periodically to stringently review the ongoing progress and infrastructural utilization.\n

text:
SCHEME NAME:
Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 

SHORT TITLE:
RVP

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Science, Technology, Scientists, Awards, Development

DESCRIPTION:
The objective of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (RVP) is to recognise the notable and inspiring contribution made by the scientists, technologists and innovators individually or in teams in various fields of science, technology and technology- led innovation. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': "Science and Technology are essential tools for development of the society. Scientists play a very important role in selflessly driving the systematic quest for truth and the development of new knowledge. They are the backbones of the nation who contribute tirelessly to the society's development. The exemplary and outstanding contributions of scientists need to be recognized so that they can serve as an inspiration to others."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The objective of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (RVP) is to recognise the notable and inspiring contribution made by the scientists, technologists and innovators individually or in teams in various fields of science, technology and technology- led innovation. The RVP shall be one of the highest recognition in the field of science, technology and innovation in India. DESCRIPTION:
The main aim of the scheme is to recognise active eminent senior resident Indian superannuated scientists for their outstanding contributions both nationally and internationally, in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM) & Medicine, to promote excellence and growth in R&D.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'There are a few chairs/professorships available in the country instituted by various ministries/departments/ academies with public funds. Considering the limited number of such opportunities, Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) has been catering to one such scheme - National Science Chair: Scientific Excellence & Science Leadership. The main aim of the scheme is to recognize active eminent senior resident Indian superannuated scientists for their outstanding contributions both nationally and internationally, in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM,) and Medicine, to promote excellence and growth in R&D.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Mode-2: Science Leadership:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This mode has more to do with recognition for thought leadership made by the awardee during the most active part of professional life and also in the recent period. The nominee will be an active researcher with a tangible impact of work carried out and developing an international reputation as a Research and development leader. This may include mentoring younger colleagues, conducting innovative research, publishing results in SCI journals and assisting in policy formulation. The exact nature of work may be any one or a combination of all the aforesaid activities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To recognize outstanding contributions made by any of the resident Indian superannuated Scientists toward excellence at the national and global levels. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Advisory Committee:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A committee referred to as the National Science Chair Advisory Committee (NSCAC) has been constituted to oversee the development of the Chairs, make recommendations for the selection of the awardees, review their progress /extension, undertake assigned activities to ensure promotion, relevance, and quality of R&D, as well as to meet the goal of the awards.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Number of Positions:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The maximum number of positions is restricted to a total of five (5).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Tenure and Commencement:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The award will be given initially for a period of 3 years and is extendable for a maximum of another two years, subject to the recommendations of the NSCAC.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Selected Chairs will have to join within a period of six months from the date of issue of the offer letter.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility for nomination:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The nominee should be a distinguished resident Indian scientist/ academician in any one or more areas of expertise in STEM and Medicine, particularly during the last 10 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The nominee must be a Science Leader and have recognition for his/her work from national/international scientific bodies such as fellowship in prestigious academies and S&T awards.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The nominee could be affiliated with an academic institutions/R&D lab or should have consent on the subject from the future host institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' The nominee should not hold any administrative roles and functions and is not in receipt of any honorarium/fellowship/salary from any other institute or organization at the time of initiation of the NSC award, if offered by SERB.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Assessment Criteria:'}, {'text': ' The assessment criteria for the selection of the awardee will be decided by NSCAC and it will be generally based on the following considerations:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Outstanding research track record of the nominee and international standing in the field.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Quality/originality of proposed research plan.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Ability to mentor young researchers and implement proactive approaches towards the advancement of S&T talent in the country.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'An amount of ₹1.5 lakhs per month will be given to the awardee as a fellowship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Research Grant in this case will be ₹5 lakhs per annum.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For overhead expenses, ₹1.0 lakh per annum will be given to the host institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' The grant shall be used for manpower, equipment, travel (including international), contingency, etc. It needs to be utilized as per the norms of the Host Institute. Items purchased out of the contingency grant will be the property of the Host Institute after the completion of tenure. However, in certain listed items, their retention by the awardee will be decided in accordance with the existing government rules and regulations on the subject. DESCRIPTION:
"Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" aims to improve the welfare of working journalists retired from service in Goa and their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family pension benefits for eligible journalists and their dependents.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 1st February 2002, the scheme "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" by the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa, aims to improve the welfare of working journalists, who are working in Goa, after retirement, and their families. The two significant benefits include a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family welfare providing 50% of the pension in the event of the journalist\'s death. The two significant eligibility criteria are working as a journalist in Goa under the definition of the Working Journalists and Newspaper Employees Service Conditions and Miscellaneous Conditions Act, 1955, and having retired after fifteen years of service, being not below 50 years of age in Goa, with continuous or interval service.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

schemeName: Swarnajayanti Fellowships Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Swarnajayanti Fellowships Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
SJFS

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Swarnajayanti, Fellowship, Young Scientist, Research, PhD

DESCRIPTION:
Under this scheme, a selected number of young scientists, with proven track record, are provided special assistance and support to enable them to pursue basic research in frontier areas of science and technology.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Government of India had instituted a scheme "Swarnajayanti Fellowships Scheme" to commemorate India\'s fiftieth year of Independence. Under this scheme, a selected number of young scientists, with a proven track record, are provided special assistance and support to enable them to pursue basic research in frontier areas of science and technology. Scientists selected for the award will be allowed to pursue unfettered research with freedom and flexibility in terms of expenditure as approved in the research plan. The project should contain innovative research ideas and it should have the potential of making an impact on R&D in the discipline. The fellowships are scientist-specific and not institution-specific, very selective, and have close academic monitoring.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of the fellowship will be for a period not exceeding five years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The fellowship is open to Indian Nationals having a regular position in a recognized Indian academic/research organization.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should possess a Ph.D. in Science/Engineering/Medicine and should not be drawing Fellowship from any other Scheme of Government of India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Scientists should be active in the frontier area of science and engineering with outstanding contributions in the form of research publications and/ or patents, peer recognition from the scientific community, awards, etc. in his/ her area of research.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The organization/institute should also undertake financial and other management responsibilities of the project throughout the five-year term in case a fellowship is awarded to the scientist.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The fellowship is open to scientists between 30 to 40 years of age.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The award consists of a Fellowship of ₹25,000/- per month in addition to the salary drawn from the parent Institute for a period of 5 years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The fellows selected along with their projects will be considered for funding by the Science & Engineering Research Board (SERB) as per SERB norms, for fellowship, recurring and non-recurring heads.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' Applications for the “SwarnaJayanti Fellowships Scheme” are invited from eligible candidates in the format as given on DST online portal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' Candidates may log on to '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://onlinedst.gov.in/'}], 'link': 'https://onlinedst.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' to access the home page of the “DST e-PMS Portal” for details and submit the application in online mode only.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01: '}, {'text': 'There is no need to send a hard copy.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note text:
SCHEME NAME: National Quantum Mission (NQM) SHORT TITLE: NQM CATEGORY: Science, IT & Communications LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Science And Technology SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Technologies, Startups, Research, Development Labs DESCRIPTION: The National Quantum Mission (NQM) supports research and development of advanced quantum technologies (like quantum computing and secure communication) so India can build cutting-edge capabilities and stay competitive in future tech. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': "The National Quantum Mission (NQM), under the Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India, supports research and development in advanced quantum technologies, such as quantum computing and secure quantum communication. The mission aims to build India's cutting-edge capabilities and strengthen its global competitiveness in future technologies."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'OBJECTIVES', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '• The National Quantum Mission (NQM) aims to seed, nurture and scale up scientific and industrial R&D and create a vibrant & innovative ecosystem in Quantum Technology (QT) in the country.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '• As part of the mission, four Thematic Hubs (T-Hubs) will be established as Section-8 Companies, not-for-profit entities, within premier academic institutions and national research and development labs. These T-Hubs will specialize in four distinct technology verticals: Quantum Computing, Quantum Communication, Quantum Sensing & Metrology, and Quantum Materials & Devices'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'text': '(a) A startup, should be registered by DPIIT at the time of application. If not registered, funds will only be released after successful registration by DPIIT.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(b) The startup must have a business idea to develop a product or a service with a market fit, viable commercialization, and scope of scaling.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(c) The startup should be using technology in its core product or service, or business model, or distribution model, or methodology to solve the problem being targeted.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(d) Only for ‘Indian Companies’ defined as ‘holding company registered in India’, and ‘IP resides in India’, and ‘majority owned in India’.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '(e) Shareholding by Indian promoters in the startup should be at least 51%, as per Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'text': '• Funding and institutional support for quantum R&D, prototypes, product development, and commercialisation through NQM T-Hubs.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '• Startup support can include seed/prototype funding and scale-up support routed through T-Hubs/TIHs.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '• Creation of skilled manpower, research infrastructure, and industry-academia collaboration in quantum technologies.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': ' Startups apply through online calls/challenges; applications are evaluated on need, feasibility, impact, novelty, team strength, and fund-utilization plan.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Other applicants apply through DST/NQM calls or the relevant Thematic Hub (T-Hub) based on the focus area.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_left'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '\n - Startups apply through online calls/challenges; applications are evaluated on need, feasibility, impact, novelty, team strength, and fund-utilization plan.\n - Other applicants apply through DST/NQM calls or the relevant Thematic Hub (T-Hub) based on the focus area.\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://dst.gov.in/sites/default/files/Guidelines%20to%20support%20start-ups.pdf'}, {'title': 'Scheme Details Page No.40', 'url': 'file:///C:/Users/ruchi/Downloads/1782664511911.pdf'} SLUG: nqm

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) Fund, under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, provides financial support to technology startups during their initial stage of operations. schemeName: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
text:
SCHEME NAME:
E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)

SHORT TITLE:
E-YUVAS:BIRACIF(FPGA)

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
E-YUVA, Innovation, Fellow, Translational Research, Fellowship, Post Graduate

DESCRIPTION:
BIRAC’s Innovation fellows shall apply as an individual and are required to work full time at EYC. BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Empowering Youth for Undertaking Value Added Innovative Translational Research (E-YUVA)” was started by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) to promote a culture of applied research and need-oriented (societal or industry) entrepreneurial innovation among young students and researchers. The scheme provides funding support (through fellowship and research grant), technical and business mentoring, exposure to bio incubation model, orientation to an entrepreneurial culture, etc. to students at various levels including undergraduates, post-graduates, and post-doctoral.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'The scheme provides support under the following two categories:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above):', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC’s Innovation fellows shall apply as an individuals and are required to work full-time at EYC. BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with the potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Areas covered:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC Innovation Fellowship proposals can be submitted in any domain including Healthcare, Lifesciences, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Drugs, Vaccines, Drug Formulations and delivery systems, Industrial Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Agriculture, Secondary agriculture, Waste Management, Sanitation, Clean Energy and Artificial Intelligence/IoT/ Automation with application in any of these areas. BIRAC encourages interdisciplinary proposals from any stream that can help the conversion of innovative ideas into biotech products and technologies in any of the above fields.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Nature of Proposals supported:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Translational research proposals to develop innovative products and technologies with the potential to address unmet needs.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with the potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Number and Duration of Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Each EYC can have 3 Innovation Fellows at any given time.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Fellowship is provided for a period of 18 months with a provision of 6 months extension only for deserving cases.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Expected Deliverable:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme’s mandate is to promote and encourage young students to embrace translational research to develop innovative products and technologies addressing unmet needs. The work supported through BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to work towards'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Individual to Company(I to C) conversion'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'IP creation'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:

DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "The Operation of Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing" has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. The scheme provides financial incentives to eligible companies based on their incremental sales of goods manufactured in India over a defined base year. It is a performance-linked scheme where incentives are disbursed only after actual production and sales are achieved, rather than as upfront support. The scheme is applicable to identified sectors and products notified by the Government of India and requires companies to meet specified investment, production, and sales thresholds. A Project Management Agency (PMA) is responsible for handling applications, verification of claims, and monitoring implementation. The scheme also includes a structured approval mechanism involving designated authorities to ensure transparency and ensures that incentives are granted strictly based on verified incremental performance in manufacturing output.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a company text:
SCHEME NAME:
WISE Fellowship for Ph.D.

SHORT TITLE:
WISE-PHD

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications, Women and Child

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
WISE, Fellowship, PhD, KIRAN, Woman

DESCRIPTION:
The "WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PhD)" of the Department of Science and Technology aims to provide an opportunity to carry out Doctoral research in basic and applied sciences to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-45 years who want to pursue research in STEM fields.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PhD)" was started by the Department of Science and Technology under ‘Women in Science and Engineering-KIRAN (WISE-KIRAN)’ Scheme to provide an opportunity to carry out Doctoral research in basic and applied sciences to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-45 years who want to pursue research in STEM fields as a bench-level scientist.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Vision:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'WISE-PhD provides an opportunity for women to pursue higher education, i.e., a Ph.D. through an independent project grant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The main objective of WISE-PhD is to encourage women scientists to conduct Doctoral research in science and engineering and to engage them in knowledge dissemination through SSR.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Target Group:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Women who have Post Graduation in Basic or Applied Sciences or an equivalent degree and wish to pursue Ph.D. in basic & applied sciences can apply to the WISE-PhD programme for financial support. Women in regular employment are not eligible for this programme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Scientific Disciplines:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Under WISE-PhD, support is available in 5 scientific disciplines viz. (1) Physical and Mathematical Sciences (2) Chemical Sciences (3) Life Sciences (4) Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, and (5) Engineering & Technology'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Project Duration:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The project is tenable for a maximum period of five (5) years or till submission of a Ph.D. thesis, whichever is earlier.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Unemployed women who want to pursue a Ph.D. can apply for a fellowship under WISE-PhD. The programme is open for both candidates; those who have not yet registered as well as those who have already registered for a Ph.D., but not availing of a fellowship from any sources. However, candidates who have completed two (2) years duration in Ph.D. as of the date of application are NOT eligible. The following are the primary eligibility criteria:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Qualification:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have an M. Sc./ M. Tech. or equivalent degree like B. Tech., M.Phil., M. Pharm. etc. in basic and applied sciences from a recognized University/Institute.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Age:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The minimum age to apply for the programme is 27 years and the maximum is 45 years (A relaxation of 3 years in the upper age limit is allowed for SC/ ST/ PH candidates). The cut-off date for age calculation would be the date of submission of the WISE-PhD application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Employment: '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Women in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-PhD. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The fellowship amount under this programme is ₹37,000/- per month along with House Rent Allowances (HRA) as per norms.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This Programme also provides a Research Grant of ₹1.00 lakh per year and Institutional overhead charges @₹ 0.50 lakh per year (as per DST norms).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

In the ‘Personal Information’ section, fill – Department, Institute, and Institute Address as per the Host Institute identified for the WISE-PhD programme. Fill in the Designation as ‘WISE-PhD Fellow’'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' After logging in, click on the “Submit proposals” link, which will take you to a page seeking multiple information starting with – General information, Principal investigator, etc. Fill in all the mandatory information sought against each menu, as applicable. (If you belong to the SC/ ST/ PH category and wish to claim age relaxation, select the options accordingly and upload supporting documents).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 06:'}, {'text': ' In the ‘Financial Details’ section, enter the ‘WISE-PhD Fellow’ fellowship amount for each year calculated based on ₹4,44,000/- per year (@₹37,000/-* per month). Calculate and fill the HRA amount based on the applicable rate @ 0/ 9/ 18/ 27 percent of the fellowship amount. The research grant is @ ₹1,00,000/- per year, and Overhead is @ ₹50,000/- per year, which are fixed and have to be filled accordingly.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 07:'}, {'text': ' If you have the PFMS Unique Code of the Host Institute, then fill it in the ‘PFMS Details’; else, leave this section.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 08:'}, {'text': ' After filling in all the above particulars, preview your details before the final submission of the application form by clicking on the “Preview” button. The preview page will display all the facts/ particulars that you have mentioned. If there is something that you wish to update, go back and correct the information, or else proceed with the filled details by clicking on the “Submit” button to finally push data into the server.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 09:'}, {'text': ' Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the FINAL SUBMIT BUTTON.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Selection Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A preliminary screening will be done of the project proposals received under WISE-PhD and a final selection will be made as per the recommendations of the Subject Expert Committees (SECs). The final decision of DST will be communicated to the applicants only after obtaining due administrative and financial approvals.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Last date for Receipt of Application:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tThe online Application portal is open throughout the year for proposal submission.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tFor any enquiry, please contact enquiry-wosdst@gov.in'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' It is mandatory to submit the proposals only through online mode. There is no need to submit the hard copy of the proposal at the DST. Proposal submitted through e-mail will not be entertained.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' The PI is required to see the completeness of the application before it is submitted finally. Once a proposal is submitted, another one can be submitted only when the last one is rejected upon evaluation. The PI shall keep a copy of the submitted proposal for their reference. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': ' Incomplete or wrongly filled-up application format or application with a lack of essential information/ documents will be summarily rejected.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 04:'}, {'text': ' Submission of proposals other than in the prescribed format shall summarily be rejected without any further processing as per programme norms.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The call is open throughout the year for proposal submission under WISE-PhD at ePMS ([https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in)).\n**Step 02:** The proposal format is available at [https://dst.gov.in](https://dst.gov.in), [https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in) and ‘[https://online-wosa.gov.in](https://online-wosa.gov.in)’ under WISE-KIRAN Division.\n**Step 03:** Log on to [https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in)/ to access the home page of the “DST e-PMS Portal”.\n**Step 04:** Click on “New PI Registration” and fill in the requisite details for New user registration. In the ‘Personal Information’ section, fill – Department, Institute, and Institute Address as per the Host Institute identified for the WISE-PhD programme. Fill in the Designation as ‘WISE-PhD Fellow’\n**Step 05:** After logging in, click on the “Submit proposals” link, which will take you to a page seeking multiple information starting with – General information, Principal investigator, etc. Fill in all the mandatory information sought against each menu, as applicable. (If you belong to the SC/ ST/ PH category and wish to claim age relaxation, select the options accordingly and upload supporting documents).\n**Step 06:** In the ‘Financial Details’ section, enter the ‘WISE-PhD Fellow’ fellowship amount for each year calculated based on ₹4,44,000/- per year (@₹37,000/-* per month). Calculate and fill the HRA amount based on the applicable rate @ 0/ 9/ 18/ 27 percent of the fellowship amount. The research grant is @ ₹1,00,000/- per year, and Overhead is @ ₹50,000/- per year, which are fixed and have to be filled accordingly.\n**Step 07:** If you have the PFMS Unique Code of the Host Institute, then fill it in the ‘PFMS Details’; else, leave this section.\n**Step 08:** After filling in all the above particulars, preview your details before the final submission of the application form by clicking on the “Preview” button. The preview page will display all the facts/ particulars that you have mentioned. If there is something that you wish to update, go back and correct the information, or else proceed with the filled details by clicking on the “Submit” button to finally push data into the server.\n**Step 09:** Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the FINAL SUBMIT BUTTON.\n> **Selection Process:**\n\nA preliminary screening will be done of the project proposals received under WISE-PhD and a final selection will be made as per the recommendations of the Subject Expert Committees (SECs). The final decision of DST will be communicated to the applicants only after obtaining due administrative and financial approvals.\n> **Last date for Receipt of Application:**\n\n•\tThe online Application portal is open throughout the year for proposal submission.\n•\tFor any enquiry, please contact enquiry-wosdst@gov.in\n**Note 01:** It is mandatory to submit the proposals only through online mode. There is no need to submit the hard copy of the proposal at the DST. Proposal submitted through e-mail will not be entertained.\n**Note 02:** The PI is required to see the completeness of the application before it is submitted finally. Once a proposal is submitted, another one can be submitted only when the last one is rejected upon evaluation. The PI shall keep a copy of the submitted proposal for their reference. \n**Note 03:** Incomplete or wrongly filled-up application format or application with a lack of essential information/ documents will be summarily rejected.\n**Note 04:** Submission of proposals other than in the prescribed format shall summarily be rejected without any further processing as per programme norms.\n'}

EXCLUSIONS:
