DESCRIPTION:
The Scheme for Funding "High Risk - High Reward Research" aims at supporting proposals that are conceptually new & risky, & if successful, expected to have a paradigm-shifting influence on the S&T. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Scheme “High Risk - High Reward Research” is implemented by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Department of Science and Technology, Government of India with the aim to support proposals that are conceptually new and risky, and if successful, expected to have a paradigm-shifting influence on the S&T. This may be in terms of formulating a new hypothesis, or scientific breakthroughs which aid in emergence of new technologies. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Nature of Proposals to be Supported:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': "The scheme is aimed at supporting proposals that are new, challenge existing hypothesis, and provide 'out of box' thinking on important problems. It should contain significant risk elements but promise of high reward if the difficulties could be circumvented. It is expected that the success of such proposals will have far-reaching implications in S&T. Outcome could be new and significant theoretical or experimental advances, formulation of new hypothesis, or breakthrough science which will lead to new technologies. Proposals that address scientific issues which will result in 'incremental' knowledge will not be supported. Ideally, the proposal must contain bold research ideas which will have wide-ranging impact and potential for new scientific and technological innovations."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Support:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The funding is provided normally for a period of three years. DESCRIPTION:
The “Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award (BYE)” is a programme to promote commercialisation of bioscience ideas among graduate/post graduate students in Biotechnology and to encourage them to develop biotechnology entrepreneurship.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award (BYE)” is a programme to promote commercialisation of bioscience ideas among graduate/postgraduate students in Biotechnology and to encourage them to develop biotechnology entrepreneurship. This is an annual competition organized along with a workshop. The participants will then develop a Business Plan which will be judged by a panel of experts.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Students who are pursuing post-graduate programmes (including integrated PG degree programmes), doctoral degrees, B.E. or B.Tech. in Biotechnology or in the area of life sciences related to biotechnology (bioinformatics/Molecular biology/microbiology/biochemistry/Genetics and/or related subjects) from universities/Institutes in the State of Kerala are eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The winning teams will be given cash awards by the Kerala Biotechnology Commission.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Cash award for winners - first prize ₹1,00,000/-, second prize ₹50,000/- and third prize ₹25,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The awardees will be encouraged to establish start-ups through facilitation and support after evaluation and recommendation by an Expert Committee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

These 15 teams will attend a high-quality Entrepreneurship Workshop of 3-4 day’s duration that will familiarize them with matters related to starting a business venture like Business Plans, IP &amp; Patenting Strategies, Raising Finance, Business Strategies and HR Practices, and other aspects of entrepreneurship development.\n**Step 02:** After the workshop, each team may go back, consult among themselves and with their mentor, and develop a business plan based on their concept and learning experience from the workshop within 3 weeks after the workshop.\n**Step 03:** Each team then will have to make a presentation to a panel of Experts. The panel will evaluate each of the business plans and identify three winning teams.\n**Note 01:** The applicants should form a team of five students.\n**Note 02:** At least three members in the team of five should be with a Life Science background and other members can be from disciplines other than life sciences/Biotechnology. Each team has to nominate a member as the team leader and may identify a mentor as a guide.\n**Note 04:** The Proposals need to be submitted in the core areas of biotechnology which include: Agriculture, Aquaculture, Bio-energy, Biologicals and Applications, Bioprocess Engineering, Biosensors, Drug discovery &amp; Development, Environment, Food, Medical Diagnostics/Devices, Nanobiology/Nanobiotechnology, Nutraceuticals, Vaccines and other related areas. The proposals could be either for a product, service or an application.\n**Note 05:** Each team should submit a Concept Note in response to the notification, to the Chairman, Kerala Biotechnology Commission, KSCSTE, Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom, TVPM–4. \n**Contact Details:**\nThe Advisor Kerala Bio-Technology Commission\nKerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE), \nSasthra Bhavan, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004 \nTelephone: (0471) 2548406, 2548259 \nE-mail: kbc.kscste@kerala.gov.in\n'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
SERB Research Scientist Scheme 

SHORT TITLE:
SERBRSS

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
SERB, Research Scientist, INSPIRE, Faculty, Ramanujan, Fellowship

DESCRIPTION:
SERB Board has launched a new ‘SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme’ for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellowships, who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The INSPIRE Faculty Scheme of the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Ramanujan Fellowship Scheme of the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) offer opportunities for young scientists to initiate and sustain research careers in various fields of science and engineering. These schemes do not offer an extension of the fellowship after the completion of five years. The support link is broken after the end of the tenure of the respective fellowships.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '        In order to provide a platform for the sustainment of their research for some more time, the  SERB Board has recently approved a new ‘SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme’ for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellowships, who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes. The fellows will be called ‘SERB Research Scientists’. DESCRIPTION:
The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)".

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)". This Program aims to impart high-end research training in frontier areas of Science and Technology, which are of interest to India by providing an opportunity to visit leading institutions/universities across the globe for a period of 02-06 months. The SERB under this program selects candidates in frontier areas of S & T and supports their visit to top institutions around the globe, preferably to the institutions where internationally acclaimed scientists are working.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To build national capacity in frontier areas of Science and Technology by providing opportunities for International R&D experience by SIRE fellows.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To tap the expertise gained by SIRE fellows to strengthen/initiate national programmes in their domain knowledge.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To encourage research activities in priority areas that are still less explored in the Indian context.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme is open to Indian nationals only.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should have a Ph.D. degree in the area of Science and Engineering from recognized institutions in India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must hold a permanent position in any Indian research and academic institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants having MBBS/MD degrees and Veterinary doctors are also eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants having a Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE) award are also eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant must submit a letter of support from the overseas host institution along with the application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The age limit for applying under this scheme shall be 40 years (as of the date of submission of application). Age relaxation of 5 years will be given to applicants belonging to SC/ST/OBC/physically challenged and women categories.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The selected fellows will be paid a monthly fellowship amount equivalent to US $ 3000.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'One-time Contingency/Preparatory allowances of ₹75,000/- to cover visa fees, airport transfer charges, insurance, etc.,'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Overseas Medical Insurance in India and abroad of ₹20,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selected fellows will also be provided the shortest route economy class airfare from their place of work in India to the place of the host institute and back.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The maximum duration of the abroad visit is limited to 06 months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' For scientists/researchers in regular employment, rules governing payment of salary, leave, medical, gratuity, GPF pension, etc. of the organization/ institution/ university to which the fellow belongs would continue to be applicable as per their institutional norms. [Click here to register](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/Registration)\n**Step 03:** After successful registration, the user will be sent a confirmation mail on the registered email ID. Users must click on the URL provided in the mail to confirm registration.\n**Step 04:** After login, the applicant(s) are required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile, which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute Address, etc.\n**Step 05:** Details like Qualification, Research Experience, Fellowships (if any), Employment, Patent (if any), Publications (if any), Projects (if any), and Research Collaborations (if any) have to be provided.\n**Step 06:** Some of the details of your proposed work like Title (max 500 characters), Keywords (max 6), Expected output and outcome (max 1500 characters) and Tentative dates of visit, etc. have to be entered at the time of submission.\n**Step 07:** The Research Plan has to be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 10 MB.\n**Note 01:** Applicant must submit the endorsement letter duly signed by the head of the organization/ institute where the applicant is employed.\n**Note 02:** The candidate should also submit a letter of approval of the research plan from the host.\n> **Selection:**\n\nThe selection would be made among faculties who gained approval of the research plan from overseas institutions. The Board will constitute a selection committee to select the candidates.\n**Note:** The candidates selected under this programme should commence their research in an overseas institution within one month from the date of the offer letter, and if not, the offer will be automatically withdrawn and no correspondence will be entertained thereafter.\n'}

DESCRIPTION:
VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '“Visiting Advanced Joint Research (VAJRA) Faculty Scheme” was launched by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India to bring a strong international connection to the R&D ecosystem of India. The scheme offers adjunct/visiting faculty assignments to overseas scientists, faculty members, and R&D professionals including Non-resident Indians (NRI) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) to undertake high-quality collaborative research in publicly funded academic and research Institutions of India. VAJRA Faculty will engage in collaborative research in cutting-edge areas of science and technology including interdisciplinary areas of priority such as energy, water, health, security, nutrition, materials and manufacturing, etc. with one or more Indian Collaborators. VAJRA Faculty is expected to co-guide research students and may also be involved in technology development, innovation, start-ups, etc. The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a Statutory body of the Department will implement the Scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana SHORT TITLE: MMUSSPY CATEGORY: Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Research Grant, Research, Higher Education, Student, Research Scholar, Professor DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana" was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across the state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The regular professors working in state government colleges and state university campuses of Uttarakhand, as well as students and research scholars enrolled in regular programs at recognized institutions within the state, are eligible to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A research proposal may also include a co-investigator alongside the principal investigator.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while interdisciplinary subjects will also be accepted. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Research related to the state that proves to be productive and useful in social, economic, contemporary, or other areas of special importance will be encouraged. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Priority will be given to problem-oriented, solution-driven, and action-based research topics (Problem and Action-Based Research Programme).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Research proposals may also be invited based on requests for specific issues raised by any department of the state government. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A maximum period of two years will be allowed for completing the research work, which may be extended by one additional year under special circumstances.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Only one research project will be permitted for any teacher or research scholar at a time.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The maximum research grant provided by the state government is ₹15 lakh, which may be increased up to ₹18 lakh in special circumstances.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Researchers must submit their research proposals online through the Samarth portal ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index/site/login'}], 'link': 'https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index.php/site/login', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '). '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'During the application process, the proposal must be uploaded and forwarded by the institution’s Principal or Registrar within fifteen days of submission; otherwise, it will automatically move to the next level. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The proposal will then be evaluated by the Evaluation Committee, and the research grant will be released in three installments via DBT to the institution’s Research and Development Cell account.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Upon the written request of the Principal Investigator, the Principal or Registrar must make the grant available to the Principal Investigator or Researcher within three days. If this is not done, the State Research and Development Cell Committee must be informed through the Director of Education with clear written reasons, and the final decision will rest with the Secretary, Higher Education/Committee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The first installment, amounting to 50% of the grant, will be released upon approval of the research proposal. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The second installment, amounting to 30%, will be released only after submission of the utilization certificate. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The third and final installment, amounting to 20%, will be released upon completion of the research work. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The research must be original and in accordance with UGC standards. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A Research Assistant will receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month from the release of the first installment until the completion of the research work.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': '\n - Researchers must submit their research proposals online through the Samarth portal ([https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index/site/login](https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index.php/site/login)). - During the application process, the proposal must be uploaded and forwarded by the institution’s Principal or Registrar within fifteen days of submission; otherwise, it will automatically move to the next level. \n - The proposal will then be evaluated by the Evaluation Committee, and the research grant will be released in three installments via DBT to the institution’s Research and Development Cell account.\n - Upon the written request of the Principal Investigator, the Principal or Registrar must make the grant available to the Principal Investigator or Researcher within three days. If this is not done, the State Research and Development Cell Committee must be informed through the Director of Education with clear written reasons, and the final decision will rest with the Secretary, Higher Education/Committee.\n - The first installment, amounting to 50% of the grant, will be released upon approval of the research proposal. \n - The second installment, amounting to 30%, will be released only after submission of the utilization certificate. \n - The third and final installment, amounting to 20%, will be released upon completion of the research work. \n - The research must be original and in accordance with UGC standards. \n - A Research Assistant will receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month from the release of the first installment until the completion of the research work.\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines (Page No. 87)', 'url': 'https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf'} SLUG: cmherps

schemeName: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Raman-Charpak Fellowship

SHORT TITLE:
R-CF

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Fellowship, Raman, Charpak, France, Student

DESCRIPTION:
The “Raman-Charpak Fellowship Programme” is in honour of two Nobel Laureates in Physics, Prof C.V. Raman, Indian Nobel Laureate (1930) & Prof Georges Charpak, French Nobel Laureate (1992). The Fellowship was launched during the State visit of the President of France to India in February, 2013.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Raman-Charpak Fellowship Programme” is in honour of two Nobel Laureates in Physics, Prof C.V. Raman, Indian Nobel Laureate (1930) and Prof Georges Charpak, French Nobel Laureate (1992). The Fellowship was launched during the State visit of the President of France to India in February 2013. The aim is to facilitate the exchange of doctoral students between the two countries, in order to broaden the scope and depth of future engagements in Science, Technology and Innovation.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "         This programme implemented by the Indo-French Centre for Promotion of Advanced Research/ Centre Franco-Indien pour la Promotion de la Recherche Avancée (IFCPAR/CEFIPRA) aims at improving the doctoral skills of Indian and French students by providing them with  an opportunity to carry out part of their research work in a University / Research & Development Institute based in France or India respectively. This programme is now also open to French Master Students, who wish to spend some time in India following their curriculum. It aims at improving the Master's skills of French students by providing them an opportunity to carry out internship work in a University/Research Institute based in India. "}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Target Group:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'This fellowship programme is dedicated to highly qualified PhD students registered in an Indian or French Research Institute/University and Master Students from France. The programme offers them an excellent opportunity to carry out a part of their respective PhD/Masters’ research project in each other countries and to further establish professional relationships, promote new S&T cooperation, and experience another cultural context.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Areas covered under the Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tAtmospheric Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tEarth Sciences and Environmental Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tMaterials Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tPhysical Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tChemical Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tEngineering Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tBiological Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tLife and Medical Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tMathematical and Computational Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Applicants from India must be Indian citizens residing in India and have registered for a PhD in a recognized university or research institution in India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicants from France must be residing in France and have registered for a PhD/Master’s Degree in a recognized university or research institution in France.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Maximum age 30 years as of 1st April of the call year.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Students once supported by CEFIPRA and students who have a permanent position in institutions/universities are not eligible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Pre-authorization or prior consent from his/her Institute/University to apply for a foreign fellowship program.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To and fro air ticket in economy class between India and France.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Insurance coverage (travel & health) wherever is required & Carte de Sejour (if any).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Any administrative costs for Visa and Registration (if any).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Support for attending conferences/seminars/workshops during the stay.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Value of Fellowship for Indian Fellow:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Fellowship Support of 1500 Euros per month for daily expenses, local travel, accommodation charges plus Social Security charges.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Value of Fellowship for French Fellow:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Fellowship support ₹40,000/- per month for daily expenses, local travel, etc. plus accommodation charges not exceeding ₹45,000/- per month.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFIT TYPES:

schemeName: Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti- Bursary Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME: Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti- Bursary Scheme SHORT TITLE: SSADS-BS CATEGORY: Education & Learning, Science, IT & Communications LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Goa MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Higher Education, Financial Assistance, Graduation, Post Graduation, Diploma, Student, Technical DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to universalize higher and technical education in Goa by improving access and increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio. It provides financial assistance for eligible course fees and textbooks to support students pursuing higher and technical education in the state. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The "Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti- Bursary Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote higher and technical education in the State by increasing access and improving the Gross Enrollment Ratio. It provides financial assistance towards eligible fees, textbooks, and reference books for students pursuing diploma, graduation, and post-graduation courses in recognized institutions in Goa. The scheme is implemented by the Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC). '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objective of the scheme'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Quality higher education is the area of concern for the state government. The Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2005, implemented countrywide, basically focuses on primary and secondary education. The Government of Goa has a laudable objective of universalizing higher and technical education in the state, thereby raising the Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) to around 45 from the present 32.2. It is desired that higher and technical education not become the privilege of the selected few. Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research scheme is a prestigious initiative of Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India towards the advancement of university research engagements in line with industry requirement.

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research scheme is a prestigious initiative of the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India towards the advancement of university research engagements in line with industry requirements. This scheme is aimed at encouraging young, talented, enthusiastic, and result-oriented scholars to take up industry-relevant research by partnering with institutions of academic excellence. The intent was to leverage research with the industry’s innovative capacity by providing access to know-how and facilities. These are critical in advancing expertise and technologies leading to tangible economic outcomes like patents, licenses, non-patented and non-licensed new products, and processes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '        Under this scheme, there are 100 slots of fellowships available annually to researchers to pursue PhD in reputed technology and research institutions in India. The first batch of fellowships commenced in 2013. The  Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) on behalf of SERB implements the scheme.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Aim:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To encourage and inspire promising young Indian Ph.D. researchers to pursue industry-relevant research in the areas of Science, Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, and medicine.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To build industry-academia partnerships for advancing R&D.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To boost research on industrially relevant subject areas.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Key Features of the Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In addition to the attractive scholarship, the Prime Minister’s Fellowship emphasizes providing a unique and invigorating experience to selected fellows. It ensures the best national and international exposure for them and provides mentoring through industry and academic experts through the mechanism of annual review meetings. In addition, periodic mentorship sessions are also organized with the help of expert external agencies.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '•'}, {'bold': True, 'text': '\tAs '}, {'text': 'per the provisions of the scheme, the scholarship is given for a maximum period of four years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be Indian.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a full-time PhD scholar in any recognized Indian university/institute/research laboratory.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scholar’s PhD registration date should not be more than 14 months from the date of submission of application i.e. the applicant should apply within 14 months of PhD admission/registration whichever date is earlier.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should have a valid industry partner who should be ready to support the research project financially as well as provide guidance and mentorship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The mutually agreed topic of research, between the applicant and the supporting company, should be innovative, have practical relevance, and have industrial application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selected applicant should be willing to work with/in the supporting company as and when required during the project period.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not draw any other fellowship after the selection.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, full-time PhD scholars get double the JRF/SRF fellowship amount, as a scholarship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme has the provision to award up to 100 new scholarships every year. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship

SHORT TITLE:
WISE-SCOPE FELLOWSHIP

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications, Women and Child

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
WISE, SCOPE, Fellowship, Woman, Research, Scientist

DESCRIPTION:
The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities (WISE-SCOPE) Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India to provide opportunities to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their Science & Technology knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society. This program promotes projects that directly deal with challenges at the grassroots level and address them through Science & Technology interventions.  Projects under WISE-SCOPE (WISE-Societal Challenges with Opportunities) should provide Science & Technology solutions to our social problems, livelihood generation, drudgery reduction, health and nutrition-related issues, management of natural resources, sustainable agriculture, climate change, disaster management, etc.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '    The project proposal should include the development of viable technology/technique with the possibility of lab-to-land transfer, adaptation and scaling up for the benefit of society under the following identified broad thematic areas.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Energy, Water and Waste Management (EWWM)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Engineering and Technology Development (ETD)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development (ECSD)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Agriculture and Allied Sciences (AAS)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Health, Food, and Nutrition (HFN)'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Project Tenure: '}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The project tenure shall be up to 3 years.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Employment:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Candidates in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-SCOPE.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' The women scientists who are temporarily employed in research or academics may apply to this program but they have to leave earlier assignments, if, selected for the WISE-SCOPE program.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02: '}, {'text': 'The position of the applicant in any project, as Post-Doctoral Fellow, Research Associate, etc. will be considered a temporary assignment.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Age:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The minimum age to apply is 27 years and the maximum is 60 years as of the date of submission.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Educational Qualification:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Women Scientists who have completed a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences or have equivalent degrees like MD/MS/MDS are eligible for the WISE-SCOPE fellowship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this Program, a fellowship amount of ₹55,000/- and HRA (as per norms) per month will be given to the eligible candidates.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selected fellow will also be eligible for a Research Grant of ₹2.00 Lakhs per year, a Field Demonstration, etc. of ₹1.00 Lakh (for project tenure), and the cost of small equipment (up to a maximum of ₹2.00 Lakhs) along with Institutional overhead charges as per DST norms.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

Submission of proposals other than in the prescribed format shall summarily be rejected without any further processing as per programme norms.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Last Date for Receipt of Application:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tThe online Application portal is open throughout the year for proposal submission.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tFor any enquiry, please contact enquiry-wosdst@gov.in'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The call is open for proposal submission under WISE-SCOPE at ePMS ([https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in)).\n**Step 02:** The proposal format is available at [https://dst.gov.in](https://dst.gov.in), [https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in).\n**Step 03:** Log on to [https://onlinedst.gov.in/](https://onlinedst.gov.in/) to access the home page of the “DST e-PMS Portal”.\n**Step 04:** Click on “New PI Registration” and fill in the requisite details for New user registration. In the ‘Personal Information’ section, fill in- department, Institute, and Institute Address as per the Host Institute identified for the WISE-SCOPE Fellowship project. Fill in the Designation as ‘WISE-SCOPE Fellow’.\n**Step 05:** After logging in, click on the “Submit proposals” link, which will take you to a page seeking information like – General information, Principal Investigator, Mentor detail, Suggested Referees (Those who are working and also experts in the proposed area), Financial Details, PFMS Details, Ongoing Project Details (if any), Programme details, then finally Submission. DESCRIPTION:

The selected students will be provided financial support for successfully completing the project.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': '      The grant will be released to the Head of the institution in which the students are enrolled after successful completion of the work, subject to submission of signed terms and conditions, final project report, Statement of Expenditure (SE,) and Utilization Certificate (UC). DESCRIPTION:
This programme is initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant” is a program initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. It aims to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To empower and support the early career researchers in their pursuit of research excellence, providing them with an enabling environment to effectively conduct research with ease and flexibility.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To contribute in positioning the country as a global leader in science and technology as well as creating a vibrant research ecosystem.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To produce research of the highest quality, bringing in new skills, breakthrough ideas and the zest to explore new frontiers, thereby expanding the boundaries of knowledge.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be an Indian citizen.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) or Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) working as regular employees in any publicly funded and recognized R&D laboratories/institutions in India are eligible to apply as Principal Investigator (PI), in collaboration with an Indian Co-PI, provided they meet the eligibility criteria specified by ANRF (ANRF Funding Guidelines for PIO/OCI).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should hold a Ph.D. 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Other conditions', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, The institute must also arrange for the submission of relevant documents.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'ANRF reserves the right to terminate the project at any stage if it is convinced that (i) appropriate progress is not being made (ii) the grant has not been utilized properly (iii) furnishing of false information or suppression of factual information.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Projects sanctioned under this programme cannot be transferred to any other person/s.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Transfer of approved/sanctioned PM ECRG project to another institution will be considered only in the following cases: (i) From private/public/government institution to any other public/government institution (ii) General administrative transfers in government or public funded institutions. {'children': [{'bold': True, 'italic': True, 'text': 'Nature & duration of support:', 'underline': True}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Research rant up to ₹60 lakh plus overheads for a period of three years.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The measures for ease of doing research include flexibility to utilize resources under recurring head; flexibility in manpower recruitment; enhanced travel, contingency and overhead charges; and support for expenses related to open access publications and patent filing charges.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'International travel for project related activities is also permitted.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Maximum of 700 grants would be awarded per year across all subject areas.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

schemeName: Partial Travel Support Scheme
text:
SCHEME NAME:
Partial Travel Support Scheme

SHORT TITLE:
Patss

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Himachal Pradesh

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Partial, Travel, Scientist, Scholar

DESCRIPTION:
The Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE), has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in state

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'text': 'The Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE), has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in an academic or research institution located in Himachal Pradesh for participating in a National/ and International Conference/ Seminar/ Symposium/ Workshop held within India or abroad. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme does not provide assistance towards lodging, boarding, maintenance, registration fees, taxi fare and other costs'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Educational Qualification: The applicant should have passed at least M.Sc./B.E./B.Tech/MBBS or an equivalent degree from a recognized University/Institute.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "Age Limit: The applicant's age should not exceed 40 years on the date of commencement of the Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "Paper Acceptance: The applicant's paper should have been accepted for presentation. The application must include a copy of the full paper, an abstract, the schedule of the conference, and an acceptance letter from the organizer."}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Previous Travel Support: Scientists and Research Scholars who have not received travel support under PATSS in the previous three years are eligible for consideration.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'International Reputation: The Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop should have an international character and repute. Applications to attend annual meetings of professional societies will not be considered.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Publication Requirement: Scientists and Research Scholars must have published at least one paper in a refereed journal to be eligible for consideration.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Forwarding of Application: The application, along with all necessary documents, should be forwarded through the proper channel from the Head of the Institution.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Application Deadline: Complete applications should reach the office one month before the event takes place.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Research Paper Reprint: The Scientist/Research scholar sanctioned travel grant under the scheme is required to provide one reprint of the research paper presented at the Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop after its publication.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Notification of Selection: The applicants recommended by the Committee/Experts will be informed of their selection via email or post, using the email ID provided by the candidate.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Partial Coverage: The scheme provides support for a portion of the total travel expenses incurred by the beneficiaries.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Financial Assistance: For international travel, the scheme offers support up to a maximum of Rs. 60,000/- or 60% of the total travel expenses, whichever is lower. This financial assistance helps offset a significant portion of the travel costs for international trips.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In-Country Travel Support: For travel within the country, the scheme provides a maximum support of Rs. 10,000/- or 60% of the total travel expenses, whichever is lower. This assistance helps beneficiaries cover a portion of their travel costs within the country.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Flexibility: The scheme allows beneficiaries to utilize the financial support as per their travel requirements, be it international or in-country travel.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'State Council Support: The State Council is responsible for providing the specified travel support under this scheme, ensuring that beneficiaries receive the designated financial assistance.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

BENEFIT TYPES:
{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

APPLICATION PROCESS:
{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Obtain and Fill Application Form: Obtain the application form for the PATSS scheme. Complete the application form and provide your bio-data as required.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Attach Essential Documents: Ensure that the following essential documents are properly attached and tagged with the application:'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'One copy of the completed application form and bio-data.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Degree certificate (proof of eligibility).'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Date of birth certificate.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Copy of the letter from another national or international agency committing to bear partial travel costs.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Detailed letter of invitation from the conference organizers.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Abstract of the paper you will be presenting at the conference.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Certificate from the concerned airline indicating the cost of return airfare by economy class via the shortest route'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': '3. Check for Completeness: Double-check that all the necessary documents mentioned above are properly attached to the application. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4. Submit the Application: Send the completed application, along with the required enclosures, to the Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE) at least one month prior to the commencement of the conference. The application must be forwarded by the Head of the Institution.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "5. Selection Process: The HIMCOSTE will review the applications and communicate the decision about one week before the conference's commencement. No interim correspondence will be entertained."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': "6. Commitment Letter and Reimbursement: If selected, the HIMCOSTE will issue a commitment letter agreeing to provide the support. The committed amount will be reimbursed to the scientist upon their return to India after participating in the conference. The scientist must submit a detailed report, a copy of the air ticket, etc., within two months from the conference's date."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'url': ''}

EXCLUSIONS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Lodging and Boarding: The scheme does not provide assistance for expenses related to lodging and boarding during the conference, seminar, symposium, workshop, or any other event.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Maintenance: The scheme does not cover maintenance expenses, which include costs for meals, daily allowances, or any other personal expenses incurred during the travel period.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Registration Fees: The scheme does not provide financial assistance for registration fees associated with the conference, seminar, symposium, workshop, or any other event. The participants are responsible for covering these fees themselves.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Taxi Fare: The scheme excludes assistance for taxi fares or any other transportation costs incurred during the travel, including local transportation at the destination or airport transfers.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Other Costs: The scheme does not cover miscellaneous costs that may arise during the travel, such as visa fees, travel insurance, printing of conference materials, or any other expenses not directly related to the travel itself.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}

REFERENCES:
{'title': 'Pplication Guidelines And Information', 'url': ' https://himcoste.hp.gov.in/RnD_Website/pdf/PATSS%202018-19-I.pdf'}

text:
SCHEME NAME:
ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship 

SHORT TITLE:
AI-RTF

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Science And Technology

SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
ASEAN, Research, Fellowship, FICCI, Science, Technology, Innovation

DESCRIPTION:
The “ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF)” is a fellowship scheme initiated by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India under ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF)” is a fellowship scheme initiated by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India. The scheme is launched as an initiative under the ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund (AISTDF) to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries (namely Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam) to carry out research at any of the Indian research/academic Institution.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The AI-RTF scheme is a fellowship scheme with the following objectives:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'To promote the mobility of scientists and researchers from the ASEAN-Member Countries to India and provide them the opportunity to work at Indian R&D/ academic institutions to upgrade their research skills and expertise.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'To facilitate the exchange of information and contacts between the scientists and researchers of India and ASEAN Countries and create a network for building research collaborations.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': 'As a spin-off, the Fellowship awardees may also have the opportunity to get co-supervisors from India for their research projects for Ph.D. or Master’s degrees on their return to their home countries.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Number of fellowships:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Fifty (50) fellowships per year shall be awarded to young scientists and researchers from ASEAN-Member States to get affiliated with Indian academic and R&D institutions.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Duration of fellowships:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months. No request for extension \\ reduction in the duration period shall be entertained after the award of the fellowship.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Management & execution:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF) program shall be managed and coordinated by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI), New Delhi.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Areas in which fellowships are available-'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The area/topic of research for availing AI-RTF must be ASEAN-centric and must be aligned with the ASEAN Plan of Action on Science, Technology, and Innovation (APASTI). The fellowship is offered for working on research topics under any of the following broad disciplines:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tAgricultural Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tBiological and Medical Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tChemical Sciences & Engineering'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tComputer Science & Engineering'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tPhysical Sciences and Mathematics'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tOcean, Earth & Atmospheric Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tEngineering Sciences'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tMaterials, Minerals and Metallurgy'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tScience Policy/IPR Management/Technology Transfer & Commercialization'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '•\tOther multi-disciplinary areas of Science, Technology and Innovation in alignment with APASTI.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note:'}, {'text': ' The fellowship is available in all fields of natural & engineering sciences, including mathematics & statistics, except humanities and behavioral sciences.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Indian nationals are not eligible for the Fellowship.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant must be holding the nationality of any of the ASEAN Member Countries.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should possess at least a Master’s Degree in any Natural Sciences or an equivalent degree in Technology/Engineering/Medicine / allied disciplines.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Applicant should be working/studying and/or affiliated with any national R&D or academic institution in his/her home ASEAN Member Country.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The application should be endorsed by the Head of his/her institution confirming that if selected, he/ she will be sanctioned leave for the Fellowship period and will join his/ her duties back in the institution on completion of the Fellowship in India.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The upper age limit for the applicant is 45 years as of the date of submission of the application.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be fluent in the English language.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'ASEAN applicants who have availed of any fellowship scheme of the Government of India during the last 3 years are not ELIGIBLE to apply.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The proposed research work in India must be linked/ connected and add value to any of the ongoing research projects/schemes of the Indian host Institute.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 01:'}, {'text': ' It is strongly advised that the applicant, in his/ her interest, should make prior contact with an Indian institution, where work is in progress in his/her area of interest, or with a concerned scientist in India, and obtain consent that the applicant, if selected for the Fellowship, will be accepted to work in the institution on the proposed research project. A copy of such consent letter should be enclosed with the application.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 02:'}, {'text': ' In this connection, a suggestive list of Indian academic and R&D institutions has been enclosed with this Announcement to help the applicant, but the applicant is free to contact any other institution in India for his/her affiliation.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note 03:'}, {'text': " Securing prior consent from an Indian institution/scientist does not guarantee the selection of an applicant. All applications received shall be scrutinized scientifically by DST. DST shall make the final decision based on the quality of the research proposal submitted by the applicant, the applicant's academic merit, and available slots in the Fellowship scheme."}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Obligations of the AI-RTF fellows:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Fellows will observe the regulations and procedures stipulated below. If they fail to do so, the Fellowship shall be withdrawn.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'During their tenures, Fellows shall not, either in or outside the host institution, infringe in any way on the human rights of others, including racial or gender discrimination or other forms of abuse.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Fellows shall stay in India continuously during the tenure of the fellowship and concentrate on their scientific work at the host institution. Fellows shall not engage in other work, either paid or unpaid, during their tenure.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The Fellows shall follow the rules of the host institution and shall not undertake any acts of research misconduct, e.g., fabricating or falsifying research results and misuse of research funds.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A Fellow shall submit a fellowship completion research report to the DST/FICCI and ASEAN Secretariat on completion of his/ her tenure.  ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'Format for AI-RTF completion report'}], 'link': 'https://aistic.gov.in/ASEAN/AbstractFilePath?FileName=Fellowship_(completion%20report).pdf&PathKey=imrcd_files', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ')'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Transfer of any type of biological material during the tenure of availing the Fellowship is NOT permissible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\t Full financial assistance will be provided to the selected Fellows which includes the following:-'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a) Round trip international airfare by lowest economy class and by the shortest route from the international airport in the home country of the applicant to the international airport nearest to the host institution in India; visa fees, overseas medical insurance, etc.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b)\t A consolidated Fellowship amount of Indian Rupees (INR) 60,000/- per month.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'c)\tOne-time grant of INR 40,000/- as research contingency expenses, airport transfers, domestic travel for attending scientific /events, and field trips within India.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'd) Institutional overhead charges @ INR 2,500/- per month.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'e)\tThe allowance as in (a), (b) & (c) will be released to the host institution in India for disbursement to the Fellow. The host Institution will arrange appropriate accommodation for the Fellow on a payment basis.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tThe selected Fellow is advised to take an appropriate policy for health insurance coverage for the period of stay in India. The cost of obtaining an overseas insurance policy is covered and reimbursable under AISTDF.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\t Individual Fellow, or his/ her government/institution, is required to bear the following costs:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a) All expenses in the home country incidental to travel abroad, including expenditure incurred to obtain passport and visa and for medical examinations and vaccinations as may be required as well as other miscellaneous expenses such as internal travel to/ from the international airport of departure in the home country.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b)\tSalary and other related allowances in the home country, if applicable, during the Fellowship period.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tNeither the AISTDF nor the host institution in India will assume any responsibility whatsoever for the following expenditure of the Fellows during the tenure of the Fellowship:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a) Compensation in the event of death, disability, or loss of personal belongings or compensation for damage caused by climatic or other conditions.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b)\tTravel and other costs incurred by the dependents, who might accompany the Fellows.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

It also offers access to incubation infrastructure, mentorship, technical and financial guidance, and industry linkages through Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) and PRAYAS Shalas (Fab Labs). SCHEME NAME: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship SHORT TITLE: INSPIRE-FF CATEGORY: Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning LEVEL: Central BENEFICIARY STATE: All MINISTRY: Ministry Of Science And Technology SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Research, Fellowship, Faculty, Science, PhD DESCRIPTION: The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences for establishing themselves as independent researchers. It grants an attractive fellowship for a duration of 5 years. The objective of the scheme is to encourage young researchers to continue research in areas of S&T, Medicine, Agriculture, Pharmacy, and Veterinary Sciences.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Purpose'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '1. It provides Grants-in-Aid to academicians, universities, laboratories, government departments, and Non-Governmental Organizations to fund basic, applied, and action research projects. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Research and Development Programme in Water Sector" was launched by the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation. The scheme aims to provide solutions to the problems related to the water sector through effective research and development for achieving sustainable development and self-reliance. The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for basic research, applied research, and action research, detailing key provisions such as remuneration for research personnel, travel expenses, infrastructure costs, experimental charges, and overhead charges. The applicant must submit a well-written research proposal clearly stating a synopsis of the work already done, objectives, methodology, estimated cost, duration of the scheme, milestones, and the phasing of physical and financial progress. Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences was introduced by the UGC. In addition to the existing RA/PDF positions provided by various funding agencies, a need was felt for a PDF scheme running in a flexible mode, with fast track, online handling, and decision-making.

The initiative would offer ₹ 10,00,000/- in financial assistance to 132 selected candidates. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The tenure is 2 years. text:
SCHEME NAME:
Telecom Technology Development Fund

SHORT TITLE:
TTDF

CATEGORY:
Science, IT & Communications, Business & Entrepreneurship

LEVEL:
Central

BENEFICIARY STATE:
All

MINISTRY:
Ministry Of Communication

SCHEME FOR:
Infra

TAGS:
Domestic Companies, Startups, Telecom In Rural, IPR Creation Mentoring, Pilot, Chipset, Grants, Atmanirbhar Bharat, Telecom In Remote Areas, MSMEs, Academic Institutions

DESCRIPTION:
The Telecom Technology Development Fund Scheme (hereinafter referred to as ‘Scheme’) has been
notified for domestic companies and institutions involved in technology design, development,
commercialization of telecommunication products and solutions to enable affordable broadband and mobile services.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Telecommunication technology products require significantly large funding and long gestation periods for R&D and commercialization including the additional efforts and resources for the products to move from prototype to commercial grade. In the cases of high-impact deep-tech projects, elaborated in later sections, there is a need for higher funding to build such products at an affordable cost to enable state of the art services for rural areas in the country. Taking note of this strategic need in the telecom sector and to create a large pool of capital available for R&D in the country, different financing instruments are offered under various schemes of the Government of India to develop indigenous technologies and solutions. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Apart from the existing R&D funding mechanisms, annual collections under the Universal Service Obligation Fund (USOF) will also be utilized by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) for funding research and development of technologies, products, and services for the purpose of providing telecom services in rural and remote areas. An allocation of 5% of annual collections from USOF will be available for funding R&D in the Telecom sector, starting with the funds collected in the financial year 2021-22. Commercialization and adoption of these telecom technologies and solutions developed shall be given priority including through USOF schemes. Induction of new technology developments in the telecom sector in rural and remote areas through pilots and trials.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Deliverables are in line with the objectives, scope, and activities envisaged above. {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide grants to registered institutions for organizing events such as seminars, dialogues, conventions, workshops, and literary festivals. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. Sign the application form and mention the date.\n**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - \n**Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001**\n_*For material holders, indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks, and may also indicate proximate candidates willing to undertake the documentation work._\n_*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment received for future reference._\n
\n\n##### ***Post-Application Processes***\n**Step 1:****** ***Assignment of Tasks***\nTiatr Academy of Goa will assign documentation tasks to candidates according to the requests received from the holders of materials. The academy will match documentation assistants with appropriate holders based on proximity and requirements.\n**Step 2:** ***Work Execution and Certification***\nDocumentation assistants will perform assigned tasks including compilation, organization, digitisation, and conversion of materials under the supervision and certification of the material holder. SCHEME NAME: Sindhu Darshan Scheme SHORT TITLE: SDD CATEGORY: Travel & Tourism, Sports & Culture LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Gujarat MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Culture, Pilgrim, Heritage, Pilgrimage, Travel, Tourism DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, fostering national unity. Intended beneficiaries include native Gujaratis who complete the yatra and apply within 60 days. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'Launched in 2017, the scheme "Sindhu Darshan Scheme" by the Tourism Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, promoting cultural unity. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to eligible pilgrims and supports a maximum of 300 pilgrims per financial year. To be eligible, the applicant must be a native of Gujarat and must submit proof of completing the yatra within 60 days of its conclusion. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board. Sports & Culture, Housing & Shelter

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Rajasthan

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Hostel, Scheduled Tribe, Sports Training, Sports, Tribal Students

DESCRIPTION:
The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national & international competitions. Tribal students from Classes 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, specialized training, nutritious meals & other necessary facilities in the sports hostels.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Operation of Sports Hostels" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan. It aims to encourage tribal students in Scheduled Areas to participate in sports and prepare them for national and international competitions. Under this scheme, tribal students from Class 6 to 12 are provided with free residential facilities, training in archery and athletics by skilled coaches, nutritious meals, uniforms, and modern sports equipment. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The “Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance” scheme has been launched by the Department of Culture, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs. Under this scheme, one-time ex-gratia financial support is provided to the lawful heir to help the family cope with financial hardship after the death of the artist or litterateur. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be the legal heir or dependent of the deceased artist or litterateur.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The deceased should have been an artist or litterateur of Madhya Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant’s (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹20,000/-.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Families of government employees are not eligible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'One-time ex-gratia financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 paid to the legal heir of the deceased artist or litterateur.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'NOTE:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Preference is given to the spouse of the deceased.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Assistance may continue to other dependents until marriage, employment, or attainment of 21 years of age, whichever is earlier.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ul_list'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 1: '}, {'text': 'The interested applicant downloads the '}, {'children': [{'text': 'application form'}], 'link': 'https://www.culturemp.in/pdfs/kalakar-kalyan-kosh-yojna-2023.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ' ('}, {'bold': True, 'text': 'Page No. 8'}, {'text': ') from the official website.
