text:
SCHEME NAME:
Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability

SHORT TITLE:
FASPSCCCSNPPSDPPIE

CATEGORY:
Sports & Culture

LEVEL:
State

BENEFICIARY STATE:
Odisha

MINISTRY:


SCHEME FOR:
Individual

TAGS:
Financial Assistance, Sportsperson, Sports Coaching, SAI, NSNIS, Skill Development, BPL

DESCRIPTION:
The Scheme was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Scheme “Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability” was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant belonging to the BPL or Non-BPL category both are eligible.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Sportspersons who have represented the Districts of Odisha, Odisha State, and its Universities in Sports & Games and who are found eligible to undergo the academic courses as laid down by SAI, NSNIS under its eligibility criteria only will be eligible under the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Sportspersons who apply and get selected to undergo SAl, NSNIS conducted coaching courses will be provided financial assistance as follows:-'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Sportspersons under the BPL category:'}, {'text': ' 100% Course Fee plus an amount of ₹10,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹5,000/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Sportspersons of Non-BPL category:'}, {'text': ' 75% of the Course Fee plus an amount ₹5,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹2,500/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"}

{'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Application Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' SAI, NSNIS, Patiala brings out an advertisement in the month of Jan/Feb every year about its forthcoming Courses and also uploads the details on its website: '}, {'children': [{'text': Registration Process:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' Interested sportspersons can create a new account to register by providing the necessary details such as name, mobile number, email ID, and generate a password.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02:'}, {'text': ' Complete the registration process and fill out the application form with personal and educational details.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' Upload the required documents, including a passport-size photograph, attested BPL card, Aadhaar card, education certificate, achievement certificate, and a medical fitness certificate.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04:'}, {'text': ' Pay the application fee and take a printout of the application form.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' If selected for SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, submit the application form with the selection letter to the commissioner-cum-secretary, sports and Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Note: '}, {'text': 'Sports & Youth Service Department finding the application genuine and eligible, shall sanction the financial assistance and remit the Course Fee directly to the SAI Bank account and the other amount to the bank Account of the applicant.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Modality of implementation of the Scheme:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Names of the applicants who are found eligible to undergo these Courses are uploaded on the SAI, NSNIS website, and individual letters are also sent to the selected applicants by SAI asking them to deposit the required Course Fee.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selected applicant, if desirous of availing financial assistance from the State Government, is required to submit an application to the Sports & YS Dept. for financial assistance under the scheme. The application should be addressed to Commissioner-cum-Secretary, Sports & YS Dept. Govt. of Odisha accompanied with the letter of selection received from SAI, NSNIS, Patiala, or in case the letter is not received in time, print out of the website page displaying his/her selection along with a copy of his/her original application form submitted to SAI, NSNIS, Patiala. The applicant, if belongs to the BPL Category, must also submit a duly attested copy of the BPL Card along with the application failing which he/she will be treated as a non-BPL applicant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In the case of a BPL Category applicant, the concerned District Sports Officer shall be asked to inquire into the BPL status of the applicant and get a certificate to that effect from the respective Block Development Officer and forward the same to the Dept.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Sports & YS Department, on finding the application genuine and eligible, shall sanction the financial assistance and remit the Course Fee directly to the SAI Bank Account and the other amount to the bank Account of the applicant.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'In case of a large number of eligible applicants submitting applications for financial assistance, BPL applicants will get priority over non-BPL applicants. Amongst the BPL and non-BPL categories, an applicant shall be given priority if his/her career sporting achievements are better than others.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The beneficiary candidates who avail financial assistance from the govt. in prosecuting NSNIS course are to render two years’ service in the Sports & Youth Services Deptt. for coaching if the Deptt. will requisition their service with the benefits as per the rule in vogue given to the coaches at that time.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Disclaimer:'}], 'type': 'block_quote'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme is intended only to enhance the employability of sportspersons of Odisha willing to take up sports coaching as a career option. This is just a skill development initiative. Sports & Youth Services Department, Odisha shall not be under any obligation to employ/engage/recruit the beneficiaries under its establishment after completion of their Courses. The Central and State Government share the cost in a 60:40 ratio. Eligible beneficiaries also receive wages for unskilled labor and assistance for constructing toilets under "Mission Nirmal Bangla Prakalpa". The assistance is credited directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

text:
SCHEME NAME: Hostels for ST Boys and ST Girls SHORT TITLE: HSTB/G CATEGORY: Housing & Shelter, Education & Learning LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Nagaland MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Tribal Hostel Infrastructure, Centrally Sponsored Scheme, ST Education, ST Students Welfare DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to attract implementing agencies for undertaking the hostel construction programme for ST Girls to reduce drop out rate. Through this scheme, central assistance for the construction/extension of hostels is provided to ST boys and girls (including Primitive Tribal Groups). DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The scheme "Hostels for ST Boys and ST Girls" by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme which aims to attract the implementing agencies for undertaking hostel construction programme for ST Girls studying in middle schools, higher secondary schools, colleges and universities towards the broader vision of containment and reduction of their drop out rate. Through this scheme, central assistance limited only to the cost of construction/extension of hostels is provided to ST boys and girls (including Primitive Tribal Groups). The scheme is implemented through the State Governments/Union Territory Administrations and the Central/other Universities. The hostels are constructed at places where the educational institutions concerned are situated, keeping in view the concentration of ST population in a particular area or place and are sanctioned as far as possible as a part of the established educational institutions or in close vicinity of such institutions. The hostels can be constructed for middle, secondary, college, and university level of education and also for Vocational Training Centres in tribal areas where State Governments/Union Territory Administrations take initiative to run these centres efficiently. The construction includes boundary walls, two rooms set for the hostel warden, a kitchen, a toilet, a common room, and one room set for Chowkidar as an integral part of the scheme and the cost of construction will be worked out based on the State/Union Territory Public Works Department/Central Public Works Department schedule of rates prescribed for such type of construction. The hostels shall be completed within 2 years from the date of release of the central assistance and extension of existing hostels shall be completed within 12 months, while the implementing agencies text:
SCHEME NAME: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Rent Subsidy SHORT TITLE: SPARSH2.0RENT CATEGORY: Housing & Shelter LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Rental Housing, Economically Weaker Section, Labour, Affordable Housing, Industrial Workers DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to reduce the rental burden on workers and economically weaker section families residing in affordable rental housing complexes. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'text': 'The scheme “Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0)” implemented through verticals "Subsidising the stay of urban poor and labourers in SPARSH 2.0 housing complexes to give such complexes a competitive advantage over other chawls etc. and bring down the rental charges for the Urban poor" by the Labour & Employment Department, UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu aims to reduce the rental burden on workers and economically weaker section families residing in affordable rental housing complexes. Through this scheme, monthly rent subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries residing in registered SPARSH 2.0 housing complexes. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Labour & Employment through designated nodal officers. Subsidy benefits are transferred directly to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of beneficiaries. The subsidy is primarily transferred to female family members wherever applicable. The scheme also allows direct transfer to individual dormitory beneficiaries. The registration process also ensures annual monitoring and compliance verification. SPARSH 2.0 is applicable across Daman, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, and Diu for the period from 2022 to 2027.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Objectives:', 'underline': '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The selection of eligible beneficiaries for housing is done based on the “Social, Economic and Caste Census 2011 (SECC-2011)” and the Awaas Plus Permanent Waiting List.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, selected eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of ₹130,000/- for house construction. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'For families who were left out in the SECC 2011 survey but were eligible for PMAY-G housing, the Government of India conducted the Awaas Plus Survey through a mobile app from July 2017 to 30 June 2018. SCHEME NAME: Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration SHORT TITLE: AUKHSR CATEGORY: Travel & Tourism, Housing & Shelter LEVEL: State BENEFICIARY STATE: Uttarakhand MINISTRY: SCHEME FOR: Individual TAGS: Homestay, Tourism, Guest, Registration, Tourist DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand. DETAILED DESCRIPTION: {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The “Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration” scheme has been introduced by the Department of Tourism, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} ELIGIBILITY: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'For registration under this scheme, a No Objection Certificate (NOC) must be issued by the Development Authority/Local Body in urban areas, and by the Gram Pradhan in rural areas. '}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The accommodation unit must be entirely residential, and the house owner must reside there with their family.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'There must be at least one and a maximum of six rooms available for guests/tourists.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The residential unit must have a toilet, should be clean and well-maintained, equipped with fire safety equipment, and built in a structurally robust manner.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFITS: {'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Under this scheme, any house owner in the state who wishes to make the residential rooms of their house available to tourists can register their home with the Tourism Department as a home-stay. The main objective of this scheme is to offer accommodation and food facilities to tourists and to provide employment opportunities to rural residents at their homes. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'After registration, the respective accommodation is listed on the department’s website under the Home Stay directory, allowing any tourist to obtain information from the website and avail night stay facilities.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'} BENEFIT TYPES: {"id": 3, "label": "Composite", "value": "composite"} APPLICATION PROCESS: {'mode': 'Online', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Registration for Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay has to be done online at '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in'}], 'link': 'https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '> Trade > Homestay Registration, for which Aadhaar number and the Aadhaar-linked mobile number are mandatory, and during the registration process, the applicant must attach the affidavit mentioned in the application form, PAN card, a copy of the approved building map (plan), photographs of the home-stay (including the home-stay name, room interiors, toilet, and kitchen), a copy of land ownership documents (Khata, Khatauni/Registry papers), the old registration certificate of the Paying Guest House (in case of an old unit), the registration fee - ₹500 through NEFT/online/offline, the character certificate issued by the district administration, and the Fire Department NOC/fire extinguisher bill (as specified by the District Tourism Development Officer). '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Thereafter, an inspection is carried out by departmental officers and the registration number is provided to the applicant; Once registered, the owner can offer night stay facilities to guests/tourists by charging the prescribed fee.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'process_md': 'Registration for Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay has to be done online at [https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in](https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in/)> Trade > Homestay Registration, for which Aadhaar number and the Aadhaar-linked mobile number are mandatory, and during the registration process, the applicant must attach the affidavit mentioned in the application form, PAN card, a copy of the approved building map (plan), photographs of the home-stay (including the home-stay name, room interiors, toilet, and kitchen), a copy of land ownership documents (Khata, Khatauni/Registry papers), the old registration certificate of the Paying Guest House (in case of an old unit), the registration fee - ₹500 through NEFT/online/offline, the character certificate issued by the district administration, and the Fire Department NOC/fire extinguisher bill (as specified by the District Tourism Development Officer). \nThereafter, an inspection is carried out by departmental officers and the registration number is provided to the applicant; Once registered, the owner can offer night stay facilities to guests/tourists by charging the prescribed fee.\n

signature, landlord's details, and the affidavit/consent letters, must be submitted to the **Principal of the Industrial Training Institute**.\n##### **Step 2:****** ***Verification And Certification By The Principal of the Industrial Training Institute***\n\n- The Principal of the Industrial Training Institute reviews the application, verifies the student's regular admission, trade details, and confirms their good behavior and character. \n- The Principal must certify that the student has not been provided with hostel facilities at the Industrial Training Institute or any other institute before granting preliminary approval for the housing assistance benefit.\n\n##### **Step 3:****** ***Sanction Of Housing Assistance By The Principal of the Industrial Training Institute***\n\n- Based on the submission of the required affidavit and the landlord's consent letter, the Principal of the Government Industrial Training Institute is authorized to grant the sanction of the housing assistance. \n- The Principal will then submit a proposal requesting the sanctioned funds to the Joint Director, Department of Social Justice and Welfare for Persons with Disabilities, of the district.\n\n##### **Step 4:****** ***Release Of Funds To The Principal By The District Departmental Officer***\n\n- The Departmental District Officer will provide the approved amount to the Principal of the Industrial Training Institute in advance, typically in two installments covering six-month intervals. \n- The District Departmental Officer must utilize their office for the necessary official processing concerning the acceptance or rejection of the application, noting clear reasons if the application is rejected.\n\n##### **Step 5:****** ***Monthly Disbursement To The Student's Aadhaar-based Bank Account***\n\n- The Principal will subsequently make the sanctioned assistance amount available to the disabled student on a monthly basis. \n- This payment will be transferred directly into the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account using the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) method, conditional upon the student's monthly attendance.\n\n
\n\n'} EXCLUSIONS: REFERENCES: {'title': 'Guidelines', 'url': 'https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/uploads/schemes/aawas_sahayta_yojna.PDF'} SLUG: asyf1hvidsstiti

"}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A pucca house means that it should be able to withstand normal wear and tear due to usage and natural forces including climatic conditions.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Key Features:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'NSPGY is a scheme purely funded by the OB&OCVVWB with an annual budgetary outlay to be decided by the Board for each financial year, which is subject to revision from time to time.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The dwelling unit under NSPGY will be sanctioned preferably in the name of the woman head of the household.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'No contractor shall be involved in the construction of houses under NSPGY.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': "The fund under the scheme shall be credited to the beneficiary's account from the bank account maintained at the state level by PR & DW Department through Public Financial Management System (PFMS). State

DESCRIPTION:
This scheme provides financial assistance to landless beneficiaries for purchasing residential land, ensuring housing for the underprivileged in rural Bihar.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The "Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana" launched by the Rural Development Department, Bihar, aims to support landless beneficiaries listed under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Rural (PMAY-G). The scheme helps those without residential land by offering financial aid directly into their bank accounts to purchase land for housing. '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be listed as a beneficiary under PMAY-G.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must be landless and houseless.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must reside in a village where no government land is available for housing allocation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant must have a bank account for direct fund transfer.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{"id": 1, "label": "Cash", "value": "cash"}

{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

Sardar Patel Awas Yojana

SHORT TITLE:
SPAY

Housing & Shelter

State

Gujarat

Individual

TAGS:
Sardar Patel, Awas Yojana, Gujarat, Housing

DESCRIPTION:
Sardar Patel Awas Yojana (SPAY) is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections (EWS) and low-income groups (LIG) of society. 

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Detailed'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Under the Sardar Patel Awas Yojana, the government provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for the construction of their own house. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Housing Board (GHB) and Gujarat Urban Development Mission (GUDM) in urban areas, and by Gujarat Rural Housing Corporation (GRHC) in rural areas.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Sardar Patel Awas Yojana is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections and low-income groups of the society. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for the construction of their own house, and is implemented by Gujarat Housing Board and Gujarat Urban Development Mission in urban areas, and by Gujarat Rural Housing Corporation in rural areas. The scheme aims to improve the living standards of the underprivileged sections of society by providing them with their own homes.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

ELIGIBILITY:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Eligibility '}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'This scheme of the State Govt. being poor-oriented the persons registered Below the Poverty Line in rural areas may avail the benefit of the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'A person who has no plot or house may avail the benefit of the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant should not have taken benefit of any other housing scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The applicant who has a maximum of half a hectare of irrigated land or a maximum of one hectare of unrelated land may also avail advantage of the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If husband and wife live together and if there is a plot or house in the name of the husband or wife and living in the same village for the last five years, either of them may avail the benefit of the scheme.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'If a beneficiary is a native of the village he should hold a card Below the Poverty Line of that village such person should obtain a certificate from the Sarpanch of his native village that “this beneficiary has not taken advantage of Sardar Patel Awas Yojana in our village. A certificate should be produced that there is no house in his name or in the name of his wife in his native place and they should fall in the definition of B.P.L.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Benefit under Sardar Patel Awas Yojana is available to the villager living Below Poverty Line only once.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Benefits'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'Affordable Housing: SPAY provides financial assistance to the economically weaker sections and low-income groups of the society to construct their own homes, thus making housing affordable for them.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Better Living Standards: By providing a pucca house to the beneficiaries, SPAY aims to improve their living standards and ensure that they have access to basic amenities like electricity, water, and sanitation.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Empowerment: Owning a house provides a sense of security and empowerment to the beneficiaries. It gives them a permanent address and a feeling of ownership.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Subsidy: The financial assistance provided by the government in the form of a subsidy reduces the burden of the beneficiaries, making it easier for them to construct their own house.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Employment Generation: The construction of houses under SPAY generates employment opportunities for local laborers, thus contributing to the local economy.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}, {'children': [{'text': 'Economic Growth: The construction of houses under SPAY also contributes to the overall economic growth of the country by creating demand for building materials and services.'}], 'type': 'list_item'}], 'type': 'ol_list'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

PS-WEST BENGAL

Housing & Shelter

State

Individual

Police, House, Flats, Financial Assistance, Housing Assistance

DESCRIPTION:
The Government of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named ” PRATYASHA” for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses.

DETAILED DESCRIPTION:
{'children': [{'children': [{'text': 'The Govt. of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named " PRATYASHA" for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses. The West Bengal State Police Housing Corporation will construct various types of flats with the financial assistance of Housing and Urban Development Corporation Ltd (HUDCO) and all Police Personnel would be welcome to fill in forms for their required housing assistance.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Procedure of allotment:'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'The flats will be allotted to the applicants through a lottery on a random selection basis. Unallotted flats, if any, after the lottery, will be allotted to the eligible allottees on a "first come first served" basis or through lottery on a random selection basis. In case the applications remain less than the no of flats of this project, then the allotments will be made on a first come first served basis'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

{'children': [{'children': [{'text': '1.\tAny Police personnel in the ranks of Deputy Superintendent(Non-WBPS)/ Assistant Commissioner, Inspector, Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant, Assistant Sub-Inspector, 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'a)\tPolice personnel in the ranks of Deputy Superintendent(Non-WBPS)/ Assistant Commissioner, Inspector or Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹ 18,000/- (Rupees eighteen thousand) or more can apply for “A” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 1123 sq. ft. per unit.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'b)\tPolice personnel in the ranks of Inspector/ Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant or Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable, and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹15,000/- (Rupees fifteen thousand) or more can apply for “B” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 926 sq. ft. per unit.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': 'c)\tPolice personnel in the ranks of Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹ 8,840/- (Rupees eight thousand eight hundred forty) or more can apply for “C” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 794 sq. ft. per unit.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '2.\tOne Police personnel in the above-noted ranks will be eligible to submit only one application for this Scheme (No other family member may apply separately).'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '3.\tIn the case of a joint application, only a member of the immediate family (spouse, parents, and children) is eligible to be the second applicant. The first applicant shall be the eligible personnel of West Bengal Police or Kolkata Police only.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '4.\tOnly one flat will be allotted to the eligible applicant if he/she is selected through lottery on a random selection basis.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': '5.\tThe Corporation, however, reserves the right to relax any of these conditions whatsoever without assigning any reason.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}

BENEFITS:
{'children': [{'text': '1. Construction of various types of flats for all Police Personnel of West Bengal.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}

{"id": 2, "label": "In Kind", "value": "in-kind"}

{'mode': 'Offline', 'process': [{'children': [{'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 01:'}, {'text': ' The application form along with Information Guide and General Terms & Conditions may be downloaded from the website of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police ('}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/'}], 'link': 'https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': '). '}, {'children': [{'text': 'https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf'}], 'link': 'https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf', 'type': 'link'}, {'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 02: '}, {'text': 'Application shall be accompanied by an A/C Payee Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque drawn in favour of the “Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited” on any Bank payable at Kolkata as per application money. Application with instruments payable outside Kolkata may be rejected at the discretion of WBPH & IDC Ltd. without citing any reason.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 03:'}, {'text': ' The applicants should provide the details of his/ her Name, Father’s/ Husband’s Name, and Telephone No. on the reverse of the Demand Draft/ Pay Order/ Banker’s Cheque for application money.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 04: '}, {'text': 'Application Form duly filled in and completed in all respect, duly signed by the applicant along with Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque for the amount as mentioned above and other documents of the General Terms & Conditions may be submitted at the office of West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), BlockDJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700 091.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'bold': True, 'text': 'Step 05:'}, {'text': ' Applicants who wish to send their application by post, must send the application form along with application money as mentioned above, and other documents of General Terms & Conditions in the prescribed form, to the following address:- The Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), Block-DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700091.'}], 'type': 'paragraph'}, {'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}], 'type': 'align_justify'}], 'process_md': '**Step 01:** The application form along with Information Guide and General Terms &amp; Conditions may be downloaded from the website of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police ([https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/](https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/)). [https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf](https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf)\n**Step 02:** Application shall be accompanied by an A/C Payee Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque drawn in favour of the “Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing &amp; Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited” on any Bank payable at Kolkata as per application money. Application with instruments payable outside Kolkata may be rejected at the discretion of WBPH &amp; IDC Ltd. without citing any reason.\n**Step 03:** The applicants should provide the details of his/ her Name, Father’s/ Husband’s Name, and Telephone No. on the reverse of the Demand Draft/ Pay Order/ Banker’s Cheque for application money.\n**Step 04:** Application Form duly filled in and completed in all respect, duly signed by the applicant along with Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque for the amount as mentioned above and other documents of the General Terms &amp; Conditions may be submitted at the office of West Bengal Police Housing &amp; Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), BlockDJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700 091.\n**Step 05:** Applicants who wish to send their application by post, must send the application form along with application money as mentioned above, and other documents of General Terms &amp; Conditions in the prescribed form, to the following address:- The Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing &amp; Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), Block-DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700091.\n<br>\n\n', 'url': ''}

{'children': [{'text': ''}], 'type': 'paragraph'}
